  MonoidHom.map_iterate_frobeniusEquiv_symm p (f.toMonoidHom) n x

name: injective_pow_p
statement: theorem injective_pow_p {x y : R} (h : x ^ p = y ^ p) : x = y
proof: := (frobeniusEquiv R p).injective h

name: polynomial_expand_eq
statement:
lemma polynomial_expand_eq (f : R[X]) :
    expand R p f = (f.map (frobeniusEquiv R p).symm) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (f.map (S := R) (frobeniusEquiv R p).symm).map_frobenius_expand p, map_expand, map_map,
    frobenius_comp_frobeniusEquiv_symm, map_id]

name: not_irreducible_expand
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_irreducible_expand (R p) [CommSemiring R] [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p] [PerfectRing R p]
    (f : R[X]) : ¬ Irreducible (expand R p f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomial_expand_eq]
  exact not_irreducible_pow (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one

name: PerfectRing.toPerfectField
statement:
lemma PerfectRing.toPerfectField (K : Type*) (p : ℕ)
    [Field K] [ExpChar K p] [PerfectRing K p] : PerfectField K
proof:
:= by
  obtain hp | ⟨hp⟩ := ‹ExpChar K p›
  · exact ⟨Irreducible.separable⟩
  refine PerfectField.mk fun hf ↦ ?_
  rcases separable_or p hf with h | ⟨-, g, -, rfl⟩
  · assumption
  · exfalso; revert hf; have := Fact.mk hp; simp

name: separable_iff_squarefree
statement: theorem separable_iff_squarefree {g : K[X]} : g.Separable ↔ Squarefree g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Separable.squarefree, fun sqf ↦ isCoprime_of_irreducible_dvd (sqf.ne_zero ·.1) ?_⟩
  rintro p (h : Irreducible p) ⟨q, rfl⟩ (dvd : p ∣ derivative (p * q))
  replace dvd : p ∣ q := by
    rw [derivative_mul, dvd_add_left (dvd_mul_right p _)] at dvd
    exact (separable_of_irreducible h).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left dvd
  exact (h.1 : ¬ IsUnit p) (sqf _ <| mul_dvd_mul_left _ dvd)

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.perfectField
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.perfectField (K : Type*) {L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] [PerfectField K] : PerfectField L
proof:
:= ⟨fun {f} hf ↦ by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hi, h⟩ := hf.exists_dvd_monic_irreducible_of_isIntegral (K := K)
  exact (PerfectField.separable_of_irreducible hi).map |>.of_dvd h⟩

name: PerfectField.of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem PerfectField.of_ringEquiv {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (h : K ≃+* L) [PerfectField K] :
    PerfectField L
proof:
:=
  let := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  Algebra.IsAlgebraic.perfectField K

name: roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius_le
statement:
theorem roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius_le :
    (expand R (p ^ n) f).roots.map (iterateFrobenius R p n) ≤ p ^ n • f.roots
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_iff_count.2 fun r ↦ ?_
  by_cases h : ∃ s, r = s ^ p ^ n
  · obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := h
    simp_rw [count_nsmul, count_roots, ← rootMultiplicity_expand_pow, ← count_roots, count_map,
      count_eq_card_filter_eq]
    exact card_le_card (monotone_filter_right _ fun _ h ↦ iterateFrobenius_inj R p n h)
  convert! Nat.zero_le _
  simp_rw [count_map, card_eq_zero]
  exact ext' fun t ↦ count_zero t ▸ count_filter_of_neg fun h' ↦ h ⟨t, h'⟩

name: roots_expand_map_frobenius_le
statement:
theorem roots_expand_map_frobenius_le :
    (expand R p f).roots.map (frobenius R p) ≤ p • f.roots
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iterateFrobenius_one]
  convert! ← roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius_le p 1 f <;> apply pow_one

name: roots_expand_pow_image_iterateFrobenius_subset
statement:
theorem roots_expand_pow_image_iterateFrobenius_subset [DecidableEq R] :
    (expand R (p ^ n) f).roots.toFinset.image (iterateFrobenius R p n) ⊆ f.roots.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.image_toFinset, ← (roots f).toFinset_nsmul _ (expChar_pow_pos R p n).ne',
    toFinset_subset]
  exact subset_of_le (roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius_le p n f)

name: roots_expand_image_frobenius_subset
statement:
theorem roots_expand_image_frobenius_subset [DecidableEq R] :
    (expand R p f).roots.toFinset.image (frobenius R p) ⊆ f.roots.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iterateFrobenius_one]
  convert! ← roots_expand_pow_image_iterateFrobenius_subset p 1 f
  apply pow_one

name: roots_expand_pow
statement:
theorem roots_expand_pow :
    (expand R (p ^ n) f).roots = p ^ n • f.roots.map (iterateFrobeniusEquiv R p n).symm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ext' fun r ↦ ?_
  rw [count_roots, rootMultiplicity_expand_pow, ← count_roots, count_nsmul, count_map,
    count_eq_card_filter_eq]; congr; ext
  exact (iterateFrobeniusEquiv R p n).eq_symm_apply.symm

name: roots_expand
statement: theorem roots_expand : (expand R p f).roots = p • f.roots.map (frobeniusEquiv R p).symm
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← pow_one p, roots_expand_pow, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_eq_pow, pow_one]
  rfl

name: roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C {y : R} :
    (X ^ p ^ n - C y).roots = p ^ n • {(iterateFrobeniusEquiv R p n).symm y}
proof:
:= by
  have H := roots_expand_pow (p := p) (n := n) (f := X - C y)
  rwa [roots_X_sub_C, Multiset.map_singleton, map_sub, expand_X, expand_C] at H

name: roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C_pow {y : R} {m : ℕ} :
    ((X ^ p ^ n - C y) ^ m).roots = (m * p ^ n) • {(iterateFrobeniusEquiv R p n).symm y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [roots_pow, roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C, mul_smul]

name: roots_X_pow_char_sub_C
statement:
theorem roots_X_pow_char_sub_C {y : R} :
    (X ^ p - C y).roots = p • {(frobeniusEquiv R p).symm y}
proof:
:= by
  have H := roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C (p := p) (n := 1) (y := y)
  rwa [pow_one, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_one] at H

name: roots_X_pow_char_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem roots_X_pow_char_sub_C_pow {y : R} {m : ℕ} :
    ((X ^ p - C y) ^ m).roots = (m * p) • {(frobeniusEquiv R p).symm y}
proof:
:= by
  have H := roots_X_pow_char_pow_sub_C_pow (p := p) (n := 1) (y := y) (m := m)
  rwa [pow_one, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_one] at H

name: roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius :
    (expand R (p ^ n) f).roots.map (iterateFrobenius R p n) = p ^ n • f.roots
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← coe_iterateFrobeniusEquiv, roots_expand_pow, Multiset.map_nsmul,
    Multiset.map_map, comp_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_id']

name: roots_expand_map_frobenius
statement: theorem roots_expand_map_frobenius : (expand R p f).roots.map (frobenius R p) = p • f.roots
proof:
:= by
  simp [roots_expand, Multiset.map_nsmul]

name: roots_expand_image_iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem roots_expand_image_iterateFrobenius [DecidableEq R] :
    (expand R (p ^ n) f).roots.toFinset.image (iterateFrobenius R p n) = f.roots.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.image_toFinset, roots_expand_pow_map_iterateFrobenius,
    (roots f).toFinset_nsmul _ (expChar_pow_pos R p n).ne']

name: roots_expand_image_frobenius
statement:
theorem roots_expand_image_frobenius [DecidableEq R] :
    (expand R p f).roots.toFinset.image (frobenius R p) = f.roots.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.image_toFinset, roots_expand_map_frobenius,
      (roots f).toFinset_nsmul _ (expChar_pos R p).ne']

name: rootsExpandToRoots_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootsExpandToRoots_apply (x) : (rootsExpandToRoots p f x : R) = x ^ p
proof: := rfl

name: rootsExpandPowToRoots_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootsExpandPowToRoots_apply (x) : (rootsExpandPowToRoots p n f x : R) = x ^ p ^ n
proof: := rfl

name: rootsExpandEquivRoots_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootsExpandEquivRoots_apply (x) : (rootsExpandEquivRoots p f x : R) = x ^ p
proof: := rfl

name: rootsExpandPowEquivRoots_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rootsExpandPowEquivRoots_apply (n : ℕ) (x) :
    (rootsExpandPowEquivRoots p f n x : R) = x ^ p ^ n
proof: := rfl

name: pNilradical_le_nilradical
statement:
theorem pNilradical_le_nilradical {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} :
    pNilradical R p ≤ nilradical R
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : 1 < p
  · rw [pNilradical, ite_eq_left hp]
  simp_rw [pNilradical, ite_eq_right hp, bot_le]

name: pNilradical_eq_nilradical
statement:
theorem pNilradical_eq_nilradical {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    pNilradical R p = nilradical R
proof: := by rw [pNilradical, ite_eq_left hp]

name: pNilradical_eq_bot
statement:
theorem pNilradical_eq_bot {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} (hp : ¬ 1 < p) :
    pNilradical R p = ⊥
proof: := by rw [pNilradical, ite_eq_right hp]

name: pNilradical_eq_bot'
statement:
theorem pNilradical_eq_bot' {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ 1) :
    pNilradical R p = ⊥
proof: := pNilradical_eq_bot (not_lt.2 hp)

name: pNilradical_prime
statement:
theorem pNilradical_prime {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    pNilradical R p = nilradical R
proof: := pNilradical_eq_nilradical hp.one_lt

name: pNilradical_one
statement:
theorem pNilradical_one {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] :
    pNilradical R 1 = ⊥
proof: := pNilradical_eq_bot' rfl.le

name: mem_pNilradical
statement:
theorem mem_pNilradical {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ} {x : R} :
    x ∈ pNilradical R p ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ p ^ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : 1 < p
  · rw [pNilradical_eq_nilradical hp]
    refine ⟨fun ⟨n, h⟩ ↦ ⟨n, ?_⟩, fun ⟨n, h⟩ ↦ ⟨p ^ n, h⟩⟩
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel ((n.lt_pow_self hp).le), pow_add, h, mul_zero]
  rw [pNilradical_eq_bot hp, Ideal.mem_bot]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨0, by rw [pow_zero, pow_one, h]⟩, fun ⟨n, h⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 (not_lt.1 hp) with hp | hp
  · by_cases hn : n = 0
    · rwa [hn, pow_zero, pow_one] at h
    rw [hp, zero_pow hn, pow_zero] at h
    subsingleton [subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one h.symm]
  rwa [hp, one_pow, pow_one] at h

name: sub_mem_pNilradical_iff_pow_expChar_pow_eq
statement:
theorem sub_mem_pNilradical_iff_pow_expChar_pow_eq {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {p : ℕ} [ExpChar R p]
    {x y : R} : x - y ∈ pNilradical R p ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ p ^ n = y ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_pNilradical, sub_pow_expChar_pow, sub_eq_zero]

name: pow_expChar_pow_inj_of_pNilradical_eq_bot
statement:
theorem pow_expChar_pow_inj_of_pNilradical_eq_bot (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p]
    (h : pNilradical R p = ⊥) (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective fun x : R ↦ x ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= fun _ _ H ↦
  sub_eq_zero.1 <| Ideal.mem_bot.1 <| h ▸ sub_mem_pNilradical_iff_pow_expChar_pow_eq.2 ⟨n, H⟩

name: pNilradical_eq_bot_of_frobenius_inj
statement:
theorem pNilradical_eq_bot_of_frobenius_inj (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p]
    (h : Function.Injective (frobenius R p)) : pNilradical R p = ⊥
proof:
:= bot_unique fun x ↦ by
  rw [mem_pNilradical, Ideal.mem_bot]
  exact fun ⟨n, _⟩ ↦ h.iterate n (by rwa [← coe_iterateFrobenius, map_zero])

name: PerfectRing.pNilradical_eq_bot
statement:
theorem PerfectRing.pNilradical_eq_bot (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p]
    [PerfectRing R p] : pNilradical R p = ⊥
proof:
:=
  pNilradical_eq_bot_of_frobenius_inj R p (injective_frobenius R p)

name: IsPRadical.pow_mem
statement:
theorem IsPRadical.pow_mem [IsPRadical i p] (x : L) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : K), i y = x ^ p ^ n
proof: := pow_mem' x

name: IsPRadical.ker_le
statement:
theorem IsPRadical.ker_le [IsPRadical i p] :
    RingHom.ker i ≤ pNilradical K p
proof: := ker_le'

name: IsPRadical.comap_pNilradical
statement:
theorem IsPRadical.comap_pNilradical [IsPRadical i p] :
    (pNilradical L p).comap i = pNilradical K p
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x h ↦ mem_pNilradical.2 ?_) (fun x h ↦ ?_)
  · obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := mem_pNilradical.1 <| Ideal.mem_comap.1 h
    obtain ⟨m, h⟩ := mem_pNilradical.1 <| ker_le i p ((map_pow i x _).symm ▸ h)
    exact ⟨n + m, by rwa [pow_add, pow_mul]⟩
  simp only [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_pNilradical] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, by simpa only [map_pow, map_zero] using congr(i $h)⟩

name: IsPRadical.trans
statement:
theorem IsPRadical.trans [IsPRadical i p] [IsPRadical f p] :
    IsPRadical (f.comp i) p where
  pow_mem' x
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨n, y, hy⟩ := pow_mem f p x
    obtain ⟨m, z, hz⟩ := pow_mem i p y
    exact ⟨n + m, z, by rw [RingHom.comp_apply, hz, map_pow, hy, pow_add, pow_mul]⟩
  ker_le' x h := by
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, ← RingHom.mem_ker] at h
    simpa only [← Ideal.mem_comap, comap_pNilradical] using ker_le f p h

name: RingHom.pNilradical_le_ker_of_perfectRing
statement:
theorem RingHom.pNilradical_le_ker_of_perfectRing [ExpChar L p] [PerfectRing L p] :
    pNilradical K p ≤ RingHom.ker i
proof:
:= fun x h ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := mem_pNilradical.1 h
  replace h := congr((iterateFrobeniusEquiv L p n).symm (i $h))
  rwa [map_pow, ← iterateFrobenius_def, ← iterateFrobeniusEquiv_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    map_zero, map_zero] at h

name: IsPerfectClosure.ker_eq
statement:
theorem IsPerfectClosure.ker_eq [PerfectRing L p] [IsPerfectClosure i p] :
    RingHom.ker i = pNilradical K p
proof:
:=
  IsPRadical.ker_le'.antisymm (i.pNilradical_le_ker_of_perfectRing p)

name: lift_aux
statement: theorem lift_aux (x : L) : ∃ y : ℕ × K, i y.2 = x ^ p ^ y.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, y, h⟩ := IsPRadical.pow_mem i p x
  exact ⟨(n, y), h⟩

name: liftAux_self_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAux_self_apply [ExpChar L p] [PerfectRing L p] (x : L) : liftAux i i p x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftAux, Classical.choose_spec (lift_aux i p x), ← iterateFrobenius_def,
    ← iterateFrobeniusEquiv_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: liftAux_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAux_self [ExpChar L p] [PerfectRing L p] : liftAux i i p = id
proof:
:=
  funext (liftAux_self_apply i p)

name: liftAux_id_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAux_id_apply (x : K) : liftAux (RingHom.id K) j p x = j x
proof:
:= by
  have := RingHom.id_apply _ ▸ Classical.choose_spec (lift_aux (RingHom.id K) p x)
  rw [liftAux, this, map_pow, ← iterateFrobenius_def, ← iterateFrobeniusEquiv_apply,
    RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: liftAux_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAux_id : liftAux (RingHom.id K) j p = j
proof: := funext (liftAux_id_apply j p)

name: injective_comp_of_pNilradical_eq_bot
statement:
theorem injective_comp_of_pNilradical_eq_bot [IsPRadical i p] (h : pNilradical M p = ⊥) :
    Function.Injective fun f : L →+* M ↦ f.comp i
proof:
:= fun f g heq ↦ by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨n, y, hx⟩ := IsPRadical.pow_mem i p x
  apply_fun _ using pow_expChar_pow_inj_of_pNilradical_eq_bot M p h n
  simpa only [← map_pow, ← hx] using! congr($(heq) y)

name: injective_comp
statement:
theorem injective_comp [IsPRadical i p] [IsReduced M] :
    Function.Injective fun f : L →+* M ↦ f.comp i
proof:
:=
  injective_comp_of_pNilradical_eq_bot i p <| bot_unique <|
    pNilradical_le_nilradical.trans (nilradical_eq_zero M).le

name: injective_comp_of_perfect
statement:
theorem injective_comp_of_perfect [IsPRadical i p] [PerfectRing M p] :
    Function.Injective fun f : L →+* M ↦ f.comp i
proof:
:=
  injective_comp_of_pNilradical_eq_bot i p (PerfectRing.pNilradical_eq_bot M p)

name: liftAux_apply
statement:
theorem liftAux_apply (x : L) (n : ℕ) (y : K) (h : i y = x ^ p ^ n) :
    liftAux i j p x = (iterateFrobeniusEquiv M p n).symm (j y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftAux]
  have h' := Classical.choose_spec (lift_aux i p x)
  set n' := (Classical.choose (lift_aux i p x)).1
  replace h := congr($(h.symm) ^ p ^ n')
  rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, ← h', ← map_pow, ← map_pow, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub,
    ← RingHom.mem_ker] at h
  obtain ⟨m, h⟩ := mem_pNilradical.1 (IsPRadical.ker_le i p h)
  refine (iterateFrobeniusEquiv M p (m + n + n')).injective ?_
  conv_lhs => rw [iterateFrobeniusEquiv_add_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [add_assoc, add_comm n n', ← add_assoc,
    iterateFrobeniusEquiv_add_apply (m := m + n'), RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def,
    ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_sub,
    add_comm m, add_comm m, pow_add, pow_mul, pow_add, pow_mul, ← sub_pow_expChar_pow, h, map_zero]

name: lift_apply
statement:
theorem lift_apply (x : L) (n : ℕ) (y : K) (h : i y = x ^ p ^ n) :
    lift i j p x = (iterateFrobeniusEquiv M p n).symm (j y)
proof:
:=
  liftAux_apply i j p _ _ _ h

name: lift_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp_apply (x : K) : lift i j p (i x) = j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_apply i j p _ 0 x (by rw [pow_zero, pow_one]), iterateFrobeniusEquiv_zero]; rfl

name: lift_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp : (lift i j p).comp i = j
proof: := RingHom.ext (lift_comp_apply i j p)

name: lift_self_apply
statement: theorem lift_self_apply [PerfectRing L p] (x : L) : lift i i p x = x
proof: := liftAux_self_apply i p x

name: lift_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_self [PerfectRing L p] : lift i i p = RingHom.id L
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext (liftAux_self_apply i p)

name: lift_id_apply
statement: theorem lift_id_apply (x : K) : lift (RingHom.id K) j p x = j x
proof: := liftAux_id_apply j p x

name: lift_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_id : lift (RingHom.id K) j p = j
proof: := RingHom.ext (liftAux_id_apply j p)

name: comp_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_lift : lift i (f.comp i) p = f
proof:
:=
  IsPRadical.injective_comp_of_perfect _ i p (lift_comp i _ p)

name: comp_lift_apply
statement: theorem comp_lift_apply (x : L) : lift i (f.comp i) p x = f x
proof: := congr($(comp_lift i f p) x)

name: liftEquiv_apply
statement: theorem liftEquiv_apply : liftEquiv M i p j = lift i j p
proof: := rfl

name: liftEquiv_symm_apply
statement: theorem liftEquiv_symm_apply : (liftEquiv M i p).symm f = f.comp i
proof: := rfl

name: liftEquiv_id_apply
statement: theorem liftEquiv_id_apply : liftEquiv M (RingHom.id K) p j = j
proof:
:=
  lift_id j p

name: liftEquiv_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftEquiv_id : liftEquiv M (RingHom.id K) p = Equiv.refl _
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext (liftEquiv_id_apply · p)

name: lift_comp_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp_lift : (lift j k p).comp (lift i j p) = lift i k p
proof:
:=
  IsPRadical.injective_comp_of_perfect _ i p (by ext; simp)

name: lift_comp_lift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp_lift_apply (x : L) : lift j k p (lift i j p x) = lift i k p x
proof:
:=
  congr($(lift_comp_lift i j k p) x)

name: lift_comp_lift_apply_eq_self
statement:
theorem lift_comp_lift_apply_eq_self [PerfectRing L p] (x : L) :
    lift j i p (lift i j p x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_comp_lift_apply, lift_self_apply]

name: lift_comp_lift_eq_id
statement:
theorem lift_comp_lift_eq_id [PerfectRing L p] :
    (lift j i p).comp (lift i j p) = RingHom.id L
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext (lift_comp_lift_apply_eq_self i j p)

name: lift_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_lift : lift g (lift i j p) p = lift (g.comp i) j p
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPRadical.injective_comp_of_perfect _ (g.comp i) p ?_
  simp_rw [← RingHom.comp_assoc _ _ (lift g _ p), lift_comp]

name: lift_lift_apply
statement: theorem lift_lift_apply (x : N) : lift g (lift i j p) p x = lift (g.comp i) j p x
proof:
:=
  congr($(lift_lift i j g p) x)

name: liftEquiv_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftEquiv_comp_apply :
    liftEquiv M g p (liftEquiv M i p j) = liftEquiv M (g.comp i) p j
proof: := lift_lift i j g p

name: liftEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftEquiv_trans :
    (liftEquiv M i p).trans (liftEquiv M g p) = liftEquiv M (g.comp i) p
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext (liftEquiv_comp_apply i · g p)

name: equiv_toRingHom
statement: theorem equiv_toRingHom : (equiv i j p).toRingHom = PerfectRing.lift i j p
proof: := rfl

name: equiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_symm : (equiv i j p).symm = equiv j i p
proof: := rfl

name: equiv_symm_toRingHom
statement:
theorem equiv_symm_toRingHom :
    (equiv i j p).symm.toRingHom = PerfectRing.lift j i p
proof: := rfl

name: equiv_apply
statement:
theorem equiv_apply (x : L) (n : ℕ) (y : K) (h : i y = x ^ p ^ n) :
    equiv i j p x = (iterateFrobeniusEquiv M p n).symm (j y)
proof:
:=
  PerfectRing.liftAux_apply i j p _ _ _ h

name: equiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem equiv_symm_apply (x : M) (n : ℕ) (y : K) (h : j y = x ^ p ^ n) :
    (equiv i j p).symm x = (iterateFrobeniusEquiv L p n).symm (i y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [equiv_symm, equiv_apply j i p _ _ _ h]

name: equiv_self_apply
statement: theorem equiv_self_apply (x : L) : equiv i i p x = x
proof:
:=
  PerfectRing.liftAux_self_apply i p x

name: equiv_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_self : equiv i i p = RingEquiv.refl L
proof:
:=
  RingEquiv.ext (equiv_self_apply i p)

name: equiv_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_comp_apply (x : K) : equiv i j p (i x) = j x
proof:
:=
  PerfectRing.lift_comp_apply i j p x

name: equiv_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_comp : RingHom.comp (equiv i j p) i = j
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext (equiv_comp_apply i j p)

name: equiv_comp_equiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_comp_equiv_apply (x : L) :
    equiv j k p (equiv i j p x) = equiv i k p x
proof:
:=
  PerfectRing.lift_comp_lift_apply i j k p x

name: equiv_comp_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_comp_equiv : (equiv i j p).trans (equiv j k p) = equiv i k p
proof:
:=
  RingEquiv.ext (equiv_comp_equiv_apply i j k p)

name: equiv_comp_equiv_apply_eq_self
statement:
theorem equiv_comp_equiv_apply_eq_self (x : L) :
    equiv j i p (equiv i j p x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [equiv_comp_equiv_apply, equiv_self_apply]

name: equiv_comp_equiv_eq_id
statement:
theorem equiv_comp_equiv_eq_id :
    (equiv i j p).trans (equiv j i p) = RingEquiv.refl L
proof:
:=
  RingEquiv.ext (equiv_comp_equiv_apply_eq_self i j p)

name: IsPRadical.isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem IsPRadical.isPurelyInseparable [IsPRadical (algebraMap K L) p] :
    IsPurelyInseparable K L
proof:
:=
  (isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem K p).2 (IsPRadical.pow_mem (algebraMap K L) p)

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {σ τ : p.Gal} (h : ∀ x ∈ p.rootSet p.SplittingField, σ x = τ x) : σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  refine
    AlgEquiv.ext fun x =>
      (AlgHom.mem_equalizer σ.toAlgHom τ.toAlgHom x).mp
        ((SetLike.ext_iff.mp ?_ x).mpr Algebra.mem_top)
  rwa [eq_top_iff, ← SplittingField.adjoin_rootSet, Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]

name: restrict_surjective
statement:
theorem restrict_surjective [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] [Normal F E] :
    Function.Surjective (restrict p E)
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective E

name: mapRoots_bijective
statement:
theorem mapRoots_bijective [h : Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] :
    Function.Bijective (mapRoots p E)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (RingHom.injective _ (Subtype.ext_iff.mp h))
  · intro y
    
    have key := (IsSplittingField.splits p.SplittingField p).roots_map
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F p.SplittingField E : p.SplittingField →+* E)
    rw [map_map, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap] at key
    have hy := Subtype.mem y
    simp only [rootSet, Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, key, Multiset.mem_map] at hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, (@Multiset.mem_toFinset _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _).mpr hx1⟩, Subtype.ext hx2⟩

name: smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] (ϕ : p.Gal) (x : rootSet p E) :
    ϕ • x = rootsEquivRootsAux p E (ϕ • (rootsEquivRootsAux p E).symm x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_rootsEquivRoots
statement:
theorem smul_rootsEquivRoots [Fact (map (algebraMap F E) p).Splits]
    [Fact (map (algebraMap F E') p).Splits] (g : p.Gal) (x : p.rootSet E) :
    g • rootsEquivRoots p E E' x = rootsEquivRoots p E E' (g • x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootsEquivRoots, smul_def]

name: galAction_isPretransitive
statement:
lemma galAction_isPretransitive [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] (hp : Irreducible p) :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive p.Gal (p.rootSet E)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩
  have hx := minpoly.eq_of_irreducible hp (mem_rootSet.mp ((rootsEquivRootsAux p E).symm x).2).2
  have hy := minpoly.eq_of_irreducible hp (mem_rootSet.mp ((rootsEquivRootsAux p E).symm y).2).2
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (Normal.minpoly_eq_iff_mem_orbit p.SplittingField).mp (hy.symm.trans hx)
  exact ⟨g, (rootsEquivRootsAux p E).eq_symm_apply.mp (Subtype.ext hg)⟩

name: restrict_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_smul [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] (ϕ : Gal(E/F)) (x : rootSet p E) :
    ↑(restrict p E ϕ • x) = ϕ x
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F p.SplittingField E)
  change ↑(ψ (ψ.symm _)) = ϕ x
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply ψ]
  change ϕ (rootsEquivRootsAux p E ((rootsEquivRootsAux p E).symm x)) = ϕ x
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply (rootsEquivRootsAux p E)]

name: galActionHom_restrict
statement:
theorem galActionHom_restrict [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] (ϕ : Gal(E/F))
    (x : rootSet p E) : ↑(galActionHom p E (restrict p E ϕ) x) = ϕ x
proof:
:=
  restrict_smul ϕ x

name: galActionHom_injective
statement:
theorem galActionHom_injective [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits)] :
    Function.Injective (galActionHom p E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro ϕ hϕ
  ext (x hx)
  have key := Equiv.Perm.ext_iff.mp hϕ (rootsEquivRootsAux p E ⟨x, hx⟩)
  change
    rootsEquivRootsAux p E (ϕ • (rootsEquivRootsAux p E).symm (rootsEquivRootsAux p E ⟨x, hx⟩)) =
      rootsEquivRootsAux p E ⟨x, hx⟩
    at key
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at key
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp (Equiv.injective (rootsEquivRootsAux p E) key)

name: restrictDvd_def
statement:
theorem restrictDvd_def [Decidable (q = 0)] (hpq : p ∣ q) :
    restrictDvd hpq =
      if hq : q = 0 then 1
      else @restrict F _ p _ _ _
        ⟨(SplittingField.splits q).of_dvd (map_ne_zero hq) ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr hpq)⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictDvd
  congr

name: restrictDvd_surjective
statement:
theorem restrictDvd_surjective (hpq : p ∣ q) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (restrictDvd hpq)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fact.mk <|
    (SplittingField.splits q).of_dvd (map_ne_zero hq) ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr hpq)
  simpa only [restrictDvd_def, dite_eq_right hq] using! restrict_surjective _ _

name: restrictProd_injective
statement: theorem restrictProd_injective : Function.Injective (restrictProd p q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p * q = 0
  · have : Unique (p * q).Gal := by rw [hpq]; infer_instance
    exact fun f g _ => Eq.trans (Unique.eq_default f) (Unique.eq_default g).symm
  intro f g hfg
  classical
  simp only [restrictProd, restrictDvd_def] at hfg
  simp only [dite_eq_right hpq, MonoidHom.prod_apply, Prod.mk_inj] at hfg
  ext (x hx)
  rw [rootSet_def, aroots_mul hpq] at hx
  rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hx) with h | h
  · have : Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F (p * q).SplittingField)).Splits) :=
      ⟨(SplittingField.splits (p * q)).of_dvd (map_ne_zero hpq)
        ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr (dvd_mul_right p q))⟩
    have key :
      x =
        algebraMap p.SplittingField (p * q).SplittingField
          ((rootsEquivRootsAux p _).invFun
            ⟨x, (@Multiset.mem_toFinset _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _).mpr h⟩) :=
      Subtype.ext_iff.mp (Equiv.apply_symm_apply (rootsEquivRootsAux p _) ⟨x, _⟩).symm
    rw [key, ← AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes, ← AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes]
    exact congr_arg _ (AlgEquiv.ext_iff.mp hfg.1 _)
  · have : Fact ((q.map (algebraMap F (p * q).SplittingField)).Splits) :=
      ⟨(SplittingField.splits (p * q)).of_dvd (map_ne_zero hpq)
        ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr (dvd_mul_left q p))⟩
    have key :
      x =
        algebraMap q.SplittingField (p * q).SplittingField
          ((rootsEquivRootsAux q _).invFun
            ⟨x, (@Multiset.mem_toFinset _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _).mpr h⟩) :=
      Subtype.ext_iff.mp (Equiv.apply_symm_apply (rootsEquivRootsAux q _) ⟨x, _⟩).symm
    rw [key, ← AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes, ← AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes]
    exact congr_arg _ (AlgEquiv.ext_iff.mp hfg.2 _)

name: mul_splits_in_splittingField_of_mul
statement:
theorem mul_splits_in_splittingField_of_mul {p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ : F[X]} (hq₁ : q₁ ≠ 0) (hq₂ : q₂ ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : (p₁.map (algebraMap F q₁.SplittingField)).Splits)
    (h₂ : (p₂.map (algebraMap F q₂.SplittingField)).Splits) :
    ((p₁ * p₂).map (algebraMap F (q₁ * q₂).SplittingField)).Splits
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul]
  apply Splits.mul
  · rw [←
      (SplittingField.lift q₁
          ((SplittingField.splits _).of_dvd (map_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hq₁ hq₂))
             ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr (dvd_mul_right q₁ q₂)))).comp_algebraMap, ← map_map]
    exact h₁.map _
  · rw [←
      (SplittingField.lift q₂
          ((SplittingField.splits _).of_dvd (map_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hq₁ hq₂))
             ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr (dvd_mul_left q₂ q₁)))).comp_algebraMap, ← map_map]
    exact h₂.map _

name: splits_in_splittingField_of_comp
statement:
theorem splits_in_splittingField_of_comp (hq : q.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    (p.map (algebraMap F (p.comp q).SplittingField)).Splits
proof:
:= by
  let P : F[X] → Prop := fun r => (r.map (algebraMap F (r.comp q).SplittingField)).Splits
  have key1 : ∀ {r : F[X]}, Irreducible r → P r := by
    intro r hr
    by_cases hr' : natDegree r = 0
    · exact Splits.of_natDegree_le_one <| natDegree_map_le.trans (hr'.trans_le zero_le_one)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
      Splits.exists_eval_eq_zero (SplittingField.splits (r.comp q)) fun h =>
        hr' ((mul_eq_zero.mp (natDegree_comp.symm.trans (natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some
          (by rwa [degree_map] at h)))).resolve_right hq)
    rw [eval_map_algebraMap, aeval_comp] at hx
    have h_normal : Normal F (r.comp q).SplittingField := SplittingField.instNormal (r.comp q)
    have qx_int := Normal.isIntegral h_normal (aeval x q)
    exact (h_normal.splits _).of_dvd (map_ne_zero (minpoly.ne_zero (h_normal.isIntegral _)))
      ((map_dvd_map' _).mpr ((minpoly.irreducible qx_int).dvd_symm hr (minpoly.dvd F _ hx)))
  have key2 : ∀ {p₁ p₂ : F[X]}, P p₁ → P p₂ → P (p₁ * p₂) := by
    intro p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂
    by_cases h₁ : p₁.comp q = 0
    · rcases comp_eq_zero_iff.mp h₁ with h | h
      · rw [h, zero_mul]
        simp [P]
      · exact False.elim (hq (by rw [h.2, natDegree_C]))
    by_cases h₂ : p₂.comp q = 0
    · rcases comp_eq_zero_iff.mp h₂ with h | h
      · simp [h, P]
      · exact False.elim (hq (by rw [h.2, natDegree_C]))
    have key := mul_splits_in_splittingField_of_mul h₁ h₂ hp₁ hp₂
    rwa [← mul_comp] at key
  exact
    WfDvdMonoid.induction_on_irreducible p (by simp) (fun _ hu => hu.splits.map _)
      fun _ _ _ h => key2 (key1 h)

name: restrictComp_surjective
statement:
theorem restrictComp_surjective (hq : q.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (restrictComp p q hq)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Splits (p.map (algebraMap F (SplittingField (comp p q))))) :=
    ⟨splits_in_splittingField_of_comp p q hq⟩
  simpa only [restrictComp] using! restrict_surjective _ _

name: card_of_separable
statement: theorem card_of_separable (hp : p.Separable) : Nat.card p.Gal = finrank F p.SplittingField
proof:
:=
  haveI : IsGalois F p.SplittingField := IsGalois.of_separable_splitting_field hp
  IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F p.SplittingField

name: prime_degree_dvd_card
statement:
theorem prime_degree_dvd_card [CharZero F] (p_irr : Irreducible p) (p_deg : p.natDegree.Prime) :
    p.natDegree ∣ Nat.card p.Gal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gal.card_of_separable p_irr.separable]
  have hp : p.degree ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    Nat.Prime.ne_zero p_deg (natDegree_eq_zero_iff_degree_le_zero.mpr (le_of_eq h))
  let α : p.SplittingField :=
    rootOfSplits (SplittingField.splits p) (by rwa [degree_map])
  have hα : IsIntegral F α := .of_finite F α
  use Module.finrank F⟮α⟯ p.SplittingField
  suffices (minpoly F α).natDegree = p.natDegree by
    let _ : AddCommGroup F⟮α⟯ := Ring.toAddCommGroup
    rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank F F⟮α⟯ p.SplittingField,
      IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hα, this]
  suffices minpoly F α ∣ p by
    have key := (minpoly.irreducible hα).dvd_symm p_irr this
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact natDegree_le_of_dvd this p_irr.ne_zero
    · exact natDegree_le_of_dvd key (minpoly.ne_zero hα)
  apply minpoly.dvd F α
  rw [← eval_map_algebraMap, eval_rootOfSplits]

name: root_X_pow_sub_C_pow
statement:
lemma root_X_pow_sub_C_pow (n : ℕ) (a : K) :
    (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) ^ n = AdjoinRoot.of _ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root, eval₂_sub, eval₂_C, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X]

name: root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero
statement:
lemma root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (a : K) :
    (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mk_ne_zero_of_natDegree_lt (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn))
    X_ne_zero <| by rwa [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C, natDegree_X]

name: root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero'
statement:
lemma root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero' {n : ℕ} {a : K} (hn : 0 < n) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | hn) := (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hn).eq_or_lt
  · rw [pow_one]
    intro e
    refine mk_ne_zero_of_natDegree_lt (monic_X_sub_C a) (C_ne_zero.mpr ha) (by simp) ?_
    trans AdjoinRoot.mk (X - C a) (X - (X - C a))
    · rw [sub_sub_cancel]
    · rw [map_sub, mk_self, sub_zero, mk_X, e]
  · exact root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hn a

name: ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
lemma ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C {n : ℕ} {a : K} (H : Irreducible (X ^ n - C a)) :
    n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  rw [pow_zero, ← C.map_one, ← map_sub] at H
  exact not_irreducible_C _ H

name: ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C'
statement:
lemma ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C' {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 1) {a : K}
    (H : Irreducible (X ^ n - C a)) : a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  rw [map_zero, sub_zero] at H
  exact not_irreducible_pow hn H

name: root_X_pow_sub_C_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma root_X_pow_sub_C_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {a : K} (H : Irreducible (X ^ n - C a)) :
    (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)
  refine ⟨not_imp_not.mp (root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero' hn), ?_⟩
  rintro rfl
  have := not_imp_not.mp (fun hn ↦ ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C' hn H) rfl
  rw [this, pow_one, map_zero, sub_zero, ← mk_X, mk_self]

name: root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero_iff
statement:
lemma root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {a : K} (H : Irreducible (X ^ n - C a)) :
    (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) ≠ 0 ↔ a ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (root_X_pow_sub_C_eq_zero_iff H).not

name: pow_ne_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem pow_ne_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C {n : ℕ} {a : K}
    (H : Irreducible (X ^ n - C a)) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ∣ n) (hm' : m ≠ 1) (b : K) : b ^ m ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := fun e ↦ not_irreducible_C
    (1 - a) (by simpa only [e, pow_zero, ← C.map_one, ← map_sub] using H)
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hm
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow (X ^ k) (C b) m
  rw [mul_comm, pow_mul, map_pow, hq] at H
  have : degree q = 0 := by
    simpa [isUnit_iff_degree_eq_zero, degree_X_pow_sub_C,
      Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hn).2] using H.2 rfl
  apply_fun degree at hq
  simp only [this, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k m, degree_X_pow_sub_C, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn,
    Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hn).2, degree_mul, ← map_pow, add_zero,
    Nat.cast_injective.eq_iff] at hq
  exact hm' ((mul_eq_right₀ (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hn).2).mp hq)

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime
statement:
@[stacks 09HF "We proved the result without the condition that `K` is char p in 09HF."]
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {a : K} (ha : ∀ b : K, b ^ p ≠ a) :
    Irreducible (X ^ p - C a)
proof:
:= by
  
  have : ¬ IsUnit (X ^ p - C a) := by
    rw [Polynomial.isUnit_iff_degree_eq_zero, degree_X_pow_sub_C hp.pos, Nat.cast_eq_zero]
    exact hp.ne_zero
  have ⟨g, hg, hg'⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor this (X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hp.pos a)
  
  suffices natDegree g = p from (associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hg'
    (X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hp.pos a) (this.trans natDegree_X_pow_sub_C.symm).ge).irreducible hg
  
  by_contra h
  
  have key : (Algebra.norm K (AdjoinRoot.root g)) ^ p = a ^ g.natDegree := by
    have := eval₂_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval₂_eq_zero _ _ hg' (AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root g)
    rw [eval₂_sub, eval₂_pow, eval₂_C, eval₂_X, sub_eq_zero] at this
    rw [← map_pow, this, ← AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, Algebra.norm_algebraMap,
      (powerBasis hg.ne_zero).finrank, powerBasis_dim hg.ne_zero]
  
  
  have : p.Coprime (natDegree g) := hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr (fun e ↦ h (((natDegree_le_of_dvd hg'
    (X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hp.pos a)).trans_eq natDegree_X_pow_sub_C).antisymm (Nat.le_of_dvd
      (natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mpr <| Polynomial.degree_pos_of_irreducible hg) e)))
  exact ha _ ((pow_mem_range_pow_of_coprime this.symm a).mp ⟨_, key⟩).choose_spec

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_of_prime
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_of_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {a : K} :
    Irreducible (X ^ p - C a) ↔ ∀ b, b ^ p ≠ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨(pow_ne_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C · dvd_rfl hp.ne_one), X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime hp⟩

name: left
statement: theorem left [IsDomain K] [Nontrivial A] : Module.Finite F K
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : A)
  Module.Finite.of_injective
    (LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf K ℕ A |>.symm x |>.restrictScalars F) (smul_left_injective K hx)

name: right
statement:
@[stacks 09G5]
theorem right [hf : Module.Finite F A] : Module.Finite K A
proof:
:=
  let ⟨⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := hf
  ⟨⟨b, Submodule.restrictScalars_injective F _ _ <| by
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_top, eq_top_iff, ← hb, Submodule.span_le]
    exact Submodule.subset_span⟩⟩

name: algebraicClosure_toSubalgebra
statement: theorem algebraicClosure_toSubalgebra : (algebraicClosure F E).toSubalgebra = integralClosure F E
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_algebraicClosure_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_algebraicClosure_iff' {x : E} :
    x ∈ algebraicClosure F E ↔ IsIntegral F x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: mem_algebraicClosure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_algebraicClosure_iff {x : E} :
    x ∈ algebraicClosure F E ↔ IsAlgebraic F x
proof: := isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.symm

name: map_mem_algebraicClosure_iff
statement:
theorem map_mem_algebraicClosure_iff (i : E →ₐ[F] K) {x : E} :
    i x ∈ algebraicClosure F K ↔ x ∈ algebraicClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_algebraicClosure_iff', ← minpoly.ne_zero_iff, minpoly.algHom_eq i i.injective]

name: comap_eq_of_algHom
statement:
theorem comap_eq_of_algHom (i : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (algebraicClosure F K).comap i = algebraicClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact map_mem_algebraicClosure_iff i

name: map_le_of_algHom
statement:
theorem map_le_of_algHom (i : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (algebraicClosure F E).map i ≤ algebraicClosure F K
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (comap_eq_of_algHom i).ge

name: map_eq_of_algebraicClosure_eq_bot
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_algebraicClosure_eq_bot [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    (h : algebraicClosure E K = ⊥) :
    (algebraicClosure F E).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K) = algebraicClosure F K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (map_le_of_algHom _) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mem_bot.1 <| h ▸ mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.2
    (IsIntegral.tower_top <| mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.1 hx)
  exact ⟨y, (map_mem_algebraicClosure_iff <| IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K).mp hx, rfl⟩

name: map_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_algEquiv (i : E ≃ₐ[F] K) :
    (algebraicClosure F E).map i = algebraicClosure F K
proof:
:=
  (map_le_of_algHom i.toAlgHom).antisymm
    (fun x h ↦ ⟨_, (map_mem_algebraicClosure_iff i.symm).2 h, by simp⟩)

name: Transcendental.algebraicClosure
statement:
protected theorem Transcendental.algebraicClosure {a : E} (ha : Transcendental F a) :
    Transcendental (algebraicClosure F E) a
proof:
:=
  ha.extendScalars _

name: le_algebraicClosure'
statement:
theorem le_algebraicClosure' {L : IntermediateField F E} (hs : ∀ x : L, IsAlgebraic F x) :
    L ≤ algebraicClosure F E
proof:
:= fun x h ↦ by
  simpa only [mem_algebraicClosure_iff, IsAlgebraic, ne_eq, ← aeval_algebraMap_eq_zero_iff E,
    Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply] using hs ⟨x, h⟩

name: le_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem le_algebraicClosure (L : IntermediateField F E) [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L] :
    L ≤ algebraicClosure F E
proof: := le_algebraicClosure' F E (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic)

name: le_algebraicClosure_iff
statement:
theorem le_algebraicClosure_iff (L : IntermediateField F E) :
    L ≤ algebraicClosure F E ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun x ↦ by simpa only [IsAlgebraic, ne_eq, ← aeval_algebraMap_eq_zero_iff E,
    IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply,
    Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, mem_algebraicClosure_iff] using h x.2⟩,
    fun _ ↦ le_algebraicClosure _ _ _⟩

name: algebraicClosure_eq_bot
statement:
theorem algebraicClosure_eq_bot :
    algebraicClosure (algebraicClosure F E) E = ⊥
proof:
:=
  bot_unique fun x hx ↦ mem_bot.2
    ⟨⟨x, isIntegral_trans x (mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.1 hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: normalClosure_eq_self
statement:
theorem normalClosure_eq_self :
    normalClosure F (algebraicClosure F E) E = algebraicClosure F E
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (normalClosure_le_iff.2 fun i ↦
    haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F i.fieldRange := (AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField i).isAlgebraic
    le_algebraicClosure F E _) (le_normalClosure _)

name: IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff [IsAlgClosed E] :
    algebraicClosure F E = ⊥ ↔ IsAlgClosed F
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ IsAlgClosed.of_exists_root _ fun p hmon hirr ↦ ?_,
    fun _ ↦ IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isAlgClosed_of_isAlgebraic _⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_aeval_eq_zero E p (degree_pos_of_irreducible hirr).ne'
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h ▸ mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.2 (minpoly.ne_zero_iff.1 <|
    ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hmon.ne_zero (minpoly.dvd _ x hx))
  exact ⟨x, by simpa [Algebra.ofId_apply] using hx⟩

name: IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_isAlgebraic {S : Set E} :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic F (adjoin F S) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, IsAlgebraic F x
proof:
:=
  ((le_algebraicClosure_iff F E _).symm.trans (adjoin_le_iff.trans <| forall_congr' <|
    fun _ => Iff.imp Iff.rfl mem_algebraicClosure_iff))

name: eq_top_iff
statement: theorem eq_top_iff : algebraicClosure F E = ⊤ ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 (h ▸ mem_top)⟩,
    fun _ ↦ top_unique fun x _ ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.2 (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x)⟩

name: le_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem le_restrictScalars [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K] :
    algebraicClosure F K ≤ (algebraicClosure E K).restrictScalars F
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.2 <| IsAlgebraic.tower_top E (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 h)

name: eq_restrictScalars_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem eq_restrictScalars_of_isAlgebraic [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] : algebraicClosure F K = (algebraicClosure E K).restrictScalars F
proof:
:=
  (algebraicClosure.le_restrictScalars F E K).antisymm fun _ h ↦
    isIntegral_trans _ h

name: adjoin_le
statement:
theorem adjoin_le [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K] :
    adjoin E (algebraicClosure F K) ≤ algebraicClosure E K
proof:
:=
  adjoin_le_iff.2 <| le_restrictScalars F E K

name: Splits.algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem Splits.algebraicClosure {p : F[X]} (h : (p.map (algebraMap F E)).Splits) :
    (p.map (algebraMap F (algebraicClosure F E))).Splits
proof:
:=
  splits_of_splits h fun _ hx ↦ (isAlgebraic_of_mem_rootSet hx).isIntegral

name: le_iff
statement:
theorem le_iff : L₁ ≤ L₂ ↔
    ∃ h : L₁.carrier ≤ L₂.carrier, L₂.emb.comp (inclusion h) = L₁.emb
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [AlgHom.ext_iff]; rfl

name: eq_iff_le_carrier_eq
statement: theorem eq_iff_le_carrier_eq : L₁ = L₂ ↔ L₁ ≤ L₂ ∧ L₁.carrier = L₂.carrier
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun eq ↦ ⟨eq.le, congr_arg _ eq⟩, fun ⟨le, eq⟩ ↦ le.antisymm ⟨eq.ge, fun x ↦ (le.2 ⟨x, _⟩).symm⟩⟩

name: eq_iff
statement:
theorem eq_iff : L₁ = L₂ ↔
    ∃ h : L₁.carrier = L₂.carrier, L₂.emb.comp (inclusion h.le) = L₁.emb
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_iff_le_carrier_eq, le_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.2, h.1.2⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨⟨h.1.le, h.2⟩, h.1⟩⟩

name: lt_iff_le_carrier_ne
statement: theorem lt_iff_le_carrier_ne : L₁ < L₂ ↔ L₁ ≤ L₂ ∧ L₁.carrier ≠ L₂.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne, and_congr_right]; intro h; simp_rw [Ne, eq_iff_le_carrier_eq, h, true_and]

name: lt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_iff : L₁ < L₂ ↔
    ∃ h : L₁.carrier < L₂.carrier, L₂.emb.comp (inclusion h.le) = L₁.emb
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_carrier_ne, le_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1.1.lt_of_ne h.2, h.1.2⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨⟨h.1.le, h.2⟩, h.1.ne⟩⟩

name: le_of_carrier_le_iSup
proof:
:=
  le_iff.mpr ⟨carrier_le.trans (iSup_le fun i ↦ (hτ i).1), algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin _
      (carrier_le.antisymm (iSup_le fun i ↦ (hσ i).1)|>.trans <| iSup_eq_adjoin _ _) fun x hx ↦
    have ⟨i, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    ((hτ i).2 ⟨x, hx⟩).trans ((hσ i).2 ⟨x, hx⟩).symm⟩

name: le_union
statement: theorem le_union ⦃σ : Lifts F E K⦄ (hσ : σ ∈ c) : σ ≤ union c hc
proof:
:=
  have hσ := Set.mem_insert_of_mem ⊥ hσ
  let t (i : ↑(insert ⊥ c)) := i.val.carrier
  ⟨le_iSup t ⟨σ, hσ⟩, fun x ↦ by
    dsimp only [union, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    exact Subalgebra.iSupLift_inclusion (K := (toSubalgebra <| t ·))
      (i := ⟨σ, hσ⟩) x (le_iSup (toSubalgebra <| t ·) ⟨σ, hσ⟩)⟩

name: carrier_union
statement: theorem carrier_union : (union c hc).carrier = ⨆ i : c, i.1.carrier
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iSup_le <| by rintro ⟨i, rfl | hi⟩; exacts [bot_le, le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, hi⟩ le_rfl]) <|
    iSup_le fun i ↦ le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, .inr i.2⟩ le_rfl

name: exists_upper_bound
statement:
theorem exists_upper_bound (c : Set (Lifts F E K)) (hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c) :
    ∃ ub, ∀ a ∈ c, a ≤ ub
proof: := ⟨_, le_union c hc⟩

name: union_isExtendible
statement:
theorem union_isExtendible [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E]
    [Nonempty c] (hext : ∀ σ ∈ c, σ.IsExtendible) :
    (union c hc).IsExtendible
proof:
:= fun S ↦ by
  let Ω := adjoin F (S : Set E) →ₐ[F] K
  have ⟨ω, hω⟩ : ∃ ω : Ω, ∀ π : c, ∃ θ ≥ π.1, ⟨_, ω⟩ ≤ θ ∧ θ.carrier = π.1.1 ⊔ adjoin F S := by
    by_contra!; choose π hπ using this
    have := finiteDimensional_adjoin (S := (S : Set E)) fun _ _ ↦ (alg.isIntegral).1 _
    have ⟨π₀, hπ₀⟩ := hc.directed.finite_le π
    have ⟨θ, hθπ, hθ⟩ := hext _ π₀.2 S
    rw [← adjoin_le_iff] at hθ
    let θ₀ := θ.emb.comp (inclusion hθ)
    have := (hπ₀ θ₀).trans hθπ
    exact hπ θ₀ ⟨_, θ.emb.comp <| inclusion <| sup_le this.1 hθ⟩
      ⟨le_sup_left, this.2⟩ ⟨le_sup_right, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩ rfl
  choose θ ge hθ eq using hω
  have : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (Set.range θ) := by
    simp_rw [← restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, restrictScalars_adjoin] at eq
    rintro _ ⟨π₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨π₂, rfl⟩ -
    wlog h : π₁ ≤ π₂ generalizing π₁ π₂
    · exact (this _ _ <| (hc.total π₁.2 π₂.2).resolve_left h).symm
    refine .inl (le_iff.mpr ⟨?_, algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin _ (eq _) ?_⟩)
    · rw [eq, eq]; exact adjoin.mono _ _ _ (Set.union_subset_union_left _ h.1)
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · change (θ π₂).emb (inclusion (ge π₂).1 <| inclusion h.1 ⟨x, hx⟩) =
        (θ π₁).emb (inclusion (ge π₁).1 ⟨x, hx⟩)
      rw [(ge π₁).2, (ge π₂).2, h.2]
    · change (θ π₂).emb (inclusion (hθ π₂).1 ⟨x, subset_adjoin _ _ hx⟩) =
        (θ π₁).emb (inclusion (hθ π₁).1 ⟨x, subset_adjoin _ _ hx⟩)
      rw [(hθ π₁).2, (hθ π₂).2]
  refine ⟨union _ this, le_of_carrier_le_iSup (fun π ↦ le_union c hc π.2)
    (fun π ↦ (ge π).trans <| le_union _ _ ⟨_, rfl⟩) (carrier_union _ _).le, ?_⟩
  simp_rw [carrier_union, iSup_range', eq]
  exact (subset_adjoin _ _).trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr <|
    le_sup_right.trans <| le_iSup_of_le (Classical.arbitrary _) le_rfl)

name: nonempty_algHom_of_exist_lifts_finset
statement:
theorem nonempty_algHom_of_exist_lifts_finset [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E]
    (h : ∀ S : Finset E, ∃ σ : Lifts F E K, (S : Set E) ⊆ σ.carrier) :
    Nonempty (E →ₐ[F] K)
proof:
:= by
  have : (⊥ : Lifts F E K).IsExtendible := fun S ↦ have ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h S; ⟨σ, bot_le, hσ⟩
  have ⟨ϕ, hϕ⟩ := zorn_le₀ {ϕ : Lifts F E K | ϕ.IsExtendible}
    fun c hext hc ↦ (isEmpty_or_nonempty c).elim
      (fun _ ↦ ⟨⊥, this, fun ϕ hϕ ↦ isEmptyElim (⟨ϕ, hϕ⟩ : c)⟩)
      fun _ ↦ ⟨_, union_isExtendible c hc hext, le_union c hc⟩
  suffices ϕ.carrier = ⊤ from ⟨ϕ.emb.comp <| ((equivOfEq this).trans topEquiv).symm⟩
  by_contra!
  obtain ⟨α, -, hα⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt this.lt_top
  let _ : Algebra ϕ.carrier K := ϕ.emb.toAlgebra
  let Λ := ϕ.carrier⟮α⟯ →ₐ[ϕ.carrier] K
  have := finiteDimensional_adjoin (S := {α}) fun _ _ ↦ ((alg.tower_top ϕ.carrier).isIntegral).1 _
  let L (σ : Λ) : Lifts F E K := ⟨ϕ.carrier⟮α⟯.restrictScalars F, σ.restrictScalars F⟩
  have hL (σ : Λ) : ϕ < L σ := lt_iff.mpr
    ⟨by simpa only [L, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, left_lt_sup, adjoin_simple_le_iff],
      AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective σ.comp_algebraMap⟩
  have ⟨(ϕ_ext : ϕ.IsExtendible), ϕ_max⟩ := maximal_iff_forall_gt.mp hϕ
  simp_rw [Set.mem_ofPred, IsExtendible] at ϕ_max; push Not at ϕ_max
  choose S hS using fun σ : Λ ↦ ϕ_max (hL σ)
  classical
  have ⟨θ, hθϕ, hθ⟩ := ϕ_ext ({α} ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion S)
  simp_rw [Finset.coe_union, Set.union_subset_iff, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.singleton_subset_iff,
    Finset.coe_biUnion, Finset.coe_univ, Set.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true, Set.iUnion_subset_iff] at hθ
  have : ϕ.carrier⟮α⟯.restrictScalars F ≤ θ.carrier := by
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, sup_le_iff, adjoin_simple_le_iff]; exact ⟨hθϕ.1, hθ.1⟩
  exact hS ⟨(θ.emb.comp <| inclusion this).toRingHom, hθϕ.2⟩ θ ⟨this, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩ (hθ.2 _)

name: exists_lift_of_splits'
statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_splits' (x : Lifts F E K) {s : E} (h1 : IsIntegral x.carrier s)
    (h2 : ((minpoly x.carrier s).map x.emb.toRingHom).Splits) : ∃ y, x ≤ y ∧ s ∈ y.carrier
proof:
:=
  have I2 := (minpoly.degree_pos h1).ne'
  letI : Algebra x.carrier K := x.emb.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let carrier := x.carrier⟮s⟯.restrictScalars F
  letI : Algebra x.carrier carrier := x.carrier⟮s⟯.toSubalgebra.algebra
  let φ : carrier →ₐ[x.carrier] K := ((algHomAdjoinIntegralEquiv x.carrier h1).symm
    ⟨rootOfSplits h2 (by rwa [degree_map]), by
      rw [mem_aroots, and_iff_right (minpoly.ne_zero h1)]
      exact (eval_map _ _).symm.trans (eval_rootOfSplits _ _)⟩)
  ⟨⟨carrier, (@algHomEquivSigma F x.carrier carrier K _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl)).symm ⟨x.emb, φ⟩⟩,
    ⟨fun z hz ↦ algebraMap_mem x.carrier⟮s⟯ ⟨z, hz⟩, φ.commutes⟩,
    mem_adjoin_simple_self x.carrier s⟩

name: exists_lift_of_splits
statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_splits (x : Lifts F E K) {s : E} (h1 : IsIntegral F s)
    (h2 : ((minpoly F s).map (algebraMap F K)).Splits) : ∃ y, x ≤ y ∧ s ∈ y.carrier
proof:
:=
  exists_lift_of_splits' x h1.tower_top <| h1.minpoly_splits_tower_top' <| by
    rwa [← x.emb.comp_algebraMap] at h2

name: exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits''
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hfφ, hφ⟩ := zorn_le_nonempty_Ici₀ _
    (fun c _ hc _ _ ↦ Lifts.exists_upper_bound c hc) ⟨L, f⟩ le_rfl
  refine ⟨φ.emb.comp (inclusion <| (le_extendScalars_iff hfφ.1 <| adjoin L S).mp <|
    adjoin_le_iff.mpr fun s h ↦ ?_), AlgHom.ext hfφ.2⟩
  let := (inclusion hfφ.1).toAlgebra
  let : SMul L φ.carrier := Algebra.toSMul
  have : IsScalarTower L φ.carrier E := ⟨fun x y ↦ smul_assoc x (y : E)⟩
  have := φ.exists_lift_of_splits' (hK s h).1.tower_top ((hK s h).1.minpoly_splits_tower_top' ?_)
  · obtain ⟨y, h1, h2⟩ := this
    exact (hφ h1).1 h2
  · convert! (hK s h).2; ext; apply hfφ.2

name: exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits'
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits' :
    ∃ φ : adjoin L S →ₐ[F] K, φ.domRestrict L = f
proof:
:= by
  let L' := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L E).fieldRange
  let f' : L' →ₐ[F] K := f.comp (AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField _).symm.toAlgHom
  have := exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits'' f' (S := S) fun s hs ↦ ?_
  · obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := this; refine ⟨φ.comp <|
      inclusion (?_ : (adjoin L S).restrictScalars F ≤ (adjoin L' S).restrictScalars F), ?_⟩
    · simp_rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe, coe_restrictScalars, adjoin_subset_adjoin_iff]
      exact ⟨subset_adjoin_of_subset_left S (F := L'.toSubfield) le_rfl, subset_adjoin _ _⟩
    · ext x
      let y := (AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L E)) x
      refine Eq.trans congr($hφ y) ?_
      simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, f']
      exact congr_arg f (AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _)
  let : Algebra L L' := (AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField _).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower L L' E := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  refine ⟨(hK s hs).1.tower_top, (hK s hs).1.minpoly_splits_tower_top' ?_⟩
  convert! (hK s hs).2
  ext
  simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe,
    AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, f']
  exact congr_arg f (AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _)

name: exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits'
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits' (hS : adjoin L S = ⊤) :
    ∃ φ : E →ₐ[F] K, φ.domRestrict L = f
proof:
:=
  have ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits' f hK
  ⟨φ.comp (((equivOfEq hS).trans topEquiv).symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars F), hφ⟩

name: exists_algHom_of_splits'
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_of_splits'
    (hK : ∀ s : E, IsIntegral L s ∧ ((minpoly L s).map f.toRingHom).Splits) :
    ∃ φ : E →ₐ[F] K, φ.domRestrict L = f
proof:
:=
  exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits' f (fun x _ ↦ hK x) (adjoin_univ L E)

name: exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits
statement: theorem exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits : ∃ φ : adjoin F S →ₐ[F] K, φ.comp (inclusion hL) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hfφ, hφ⟩ := zorn_le_nonempty_Ici₀ _
    (fun c _ hc _ _ ↦ Lifts.exists_upper_bound c hc) ⟨L, f⟩ le_rfl
  refine ⟨φ.emb.comp (inclusion <| adjoin_le_iff.mpr fun s hs ↦ ?_), ?_⟩
  · rcases φ.exists_lift_of_splits (hK s hs).1 (hK s hs).2 with ⟨y, h1, h2⟩
    exact (hφ h1).1 h2
  · ext; apply hfφ.2

name: nonempty_algHom_adjoin_of_splits
statement: theorem nonempty_algHom_adjoin_of_splits : Nonempty (adjoin F S →ₐ[F] K)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨φ, _⟩ := exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits hK (⊥ : Lifts F E K).emb bot_le; ⟨φ⟩

name: exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits
statement: theorem exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits : ∃ φ : E →ₐ[F] K, φ.comp L.val = f
proof:
:=
  have ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits hK f (hS.symm ▸ le_top)
  ⟨φ.comp ((equivOfEq hS).trans topEquiv).symm.toAlgHom, hφ⟩

name: nonempty_algHom_of_adjoin_splits
statement: theorem nonempty_algHom_of_adjoin_splits : Nonempty (E →ₐ[F] K)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨φ, _⟩ := exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits hK (⊥ : Lifts F E K).emb hS; ⟨φ⟩

name: exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits_of_aeval
statement: theorem exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits_of_aeval : ∃ φ : adjoin F S →ₐ[F] K, φ ⟨x, hx⟩ = y
proof:
:= by
  have := isAlgebraic_adjoin (fun s hs ↦ (hK s hs).1)
  have ix : IsAlgebraic F _ := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (⟨x, hx⟩ : adjoin F S)
  rw [isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral, isIntegral_iff] at ix
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits hK ((algHomAdjoinIntegralEquiv F ix).symm
    ⟨y, mem_aroots.mpr ⟨minpoly.ne_zero ix, hy⟩⟩) (adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr hx)
  exact ⟨φ, (DFunLike.congr_fun hφ <| AdjoinSimple.gen F x).trans <|
    algHomAdjoinIntegralEquiv_symm_apply_gen F ix _⟩

name: exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits_of_aeval
statement: theorem exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits_of_aeval : ∃ φ : E →ₐ[F] K, φ x = y
proof:
:=
  have ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits_of_aeval hK (hS ▸ mem_top) hy
  ⟨φ.comp ((equivOfEq hS).trans topEquiv).symm.toAlgHom, hφ⟩

name: exists_algHom_of_splits
statement: theorem exists_algHom_of_splits : ∃ φ : E →ₐ[F] K, φ.comp L.val = f
proof:
:=
  exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits (fun x _ ↦ hK' x) f (adjoin_univ F E)

name: nonempty_algHom_of_splits
statement: theorem nonempty_algHom_of_splits : Nonempty (E →ₐ[F] K)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_algHom_of_adjoin_splits (fun x _ ↦ hK' x) (adjoin_univ F E)

name: exists_algHom_of_splits_of_aeval
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_of_splits_of_aeval (hy : aeval y (minpoly F x) = 0) :
    ∃ φ : E →ₐ[F] K, φ x = y
proof:
:=
  exists_algHom_of_adjoin_splits_of_aeval (fun x _ ↦ hK' x) (adjoin_univ F E) hy

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly_of_splits
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly_of_splits {F K : Type*} (L : Type*)
    [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra F L] [Algebra F K]
    (hA : ∀ x : K, ((minpoly F x).map (algebraMap F L)).Splits)
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] (x : K) :
    (Set.range fun (ψ : K →ₐ[F] L) => ψ x) = (minpoly F x).rootSet L
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [mem_rootSet_of_ne (minpoly.ne_zero (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x))]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ha ↦ IntermediateField.exists_algHom_of_splits_of_aeval
    (fun x ↦ ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x, hA x⟩) ha⟩
  rw [← hψ, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply ψ x, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]

name: Fintype.isPrimePow_card_of_field

name: Fintype.nonempty_field_iff
statement: theorem Fintype.nonempty_field_iff {α} [Fintype α] : Nonempty (Field α) ↔ IsPrimePow ‖α‖

name: Field.nonempty_iff

  obtain h | h := fintypeOrInfinite α
