      Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0.not_ge, false_or] using Fintype.nonempty_field_iff
  · simpa only [← Cardinal.infinite_iff, h, true_or, iff_true] using Infinite.nonempty_field

name: MvPolynomial.sum_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem MvPolynomial.sum_eval_eq_zero (f : MvPolynomial σ K)
    (h : f.totalDegree < (q - 1) * Fintype.card σ) : ∑ x, eval x f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : DecidableEq K := Classical.decEq K
  calc
    ∑ x, eval x f = ∑ x : σ → K, ∑ d ∈ f.support, f.coeff d * ∏ i, x i ^ d i := by
      simp only [eval_eq']
    _ = ∑ d ∈ f.support, ∑ x : σ → K, f.coeff d * ∏ i, x i ^ d i := sum_comm
    _ = 0 := sum_eq_zero ?_
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, d i < q - 1 := f.exists_degree_lt (q - 1) h hd
  calc
    (∑ x : σ → K, f.coeff d * ∏ i, x i ^ d i) = f.coeff d * ∑ x : σ → K, ∏ i, x i ^ d i :=
      (mul_sum ..).symm
    _ = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mpr ∘ Or.inr) ?_
  calc
    (∑ x : σ → K, ∏ i, x i ^ d i) =
        ∑ x₀ : { j // j ≠ i } → K, ∑ x : { x : σ → K // x ∘ (↑) = x₀ }, ∏ j, (x : σ → K) j ^ d j :=
      (Fintype.sum_fiberwise _ _).symm
    _ = 0 := Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ ?_
  intro x₀
  let e : K ≃ { x // x ∘ ((↑) : _ → σ) = x₀ } := (Equiv.subtypeEquivCodomain _).symm
  calc
    (∑ x : { x : σ → K // x ∘ (↑) = x₀ }, ∏ j, (x : σ → K) j ^ d j) =
        ∑ a : K, ∏ j : σ, (e a : σ → K) j ^ d j := (e.sum_comp _).symm
    _ = ∑ a : K, (∏ j, x₀ j ^ d j) * a ^ d i := Fintype.sum_congr _ _ ?_
    _ = (∏ j, x₀ j ^ d j) * ∑ a : K, a ^ d i := by rw [mul_sum]
    _ = 0 := by rw [sum_pow_lt_card_sub_one K _ hi, mul_zero]
  intro a
  let e' : { j // j = i } ⊕ { j // j ≠ i } ≃ σ := Equiv.sumCompl _
  let : Unique { j // j = i } :=
    { default := ⟨i, rfl⟩
      uniq := fun ⟨j, h⟩ => Subtype.val_injective h }
  calc
    (∏ j : σ, (e a : σ → K) j ^ d j) =
        (e a : σ → K) i ^ d i * ∏ j : { j // j ≠ i }, (e a : σ → K) j ^ d j := by
      rw [← e'.prod_comp, Fintype.prod_sum_type, univ_unique, prod_singleton]; rfl
    _ = a ^ d i * ∏ j : { j // j ≠ i }, (e a : σ → K) j ^ d j := by
      rw [Equiv.subtypeEquivCodomain_symm_apply_eq]
    _ = a ^ d i * ∏ j, x₀ j ^ d j := congr_arg _ (Fintype.prod_congr _ _ ?_)
    
    _ = (∏ j, x₀ j ^ d j) * a ^ d i := mul_comm _ _
  
  rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
  change (e a : σ → K) j ^ d j = x₀ ⟨j, hj⟩ ^ d j
  rw [Equiv.subtypeEquivCodomain_symm_apply_ne]

name: char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 < q - 1 := by rw [← Fintype.card_units, Fintype.card_pos_iff]; exact ⟨1⟩
  let S : Finset (σ → K) := {x | ∀ i ∈ s, eval x (f i) = 0}
  have hS (x : σ → K) : x ∈ S ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, eval x (f i) = 0 := by simp [S]
  /- The polynomial `F = ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - (f i)^(q - 1))` has the nice property
    that it takes the value `1` on elements of `{x : σ → K // ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).eval x = 0}`
    while it is `0` outside that locus.
    Hence the sum of its values is equal to the cardinality of
    `{x : σ → K // ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).eval x = 0}` modulo `p`. -/
  let F : MvPolynomial σ K := ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - f i ^ (q - 1))
  have hF : ∀ x, eval x F = if x ∈ S then 1 else 0 := by
    intro x
    calc
      eval x F = ∏ i ∈ s, eval x (1 - f i ^ (q - 1)) := eval_prod s _ x
      _ = if x ∈ S then 1 else 0 := ?_
    simp only [(eval x).map_sub, (eval x).map_pow, (eval x).map_one]
    split_ifs with hx
    · apply Finset.prod_eq_one
      intro i hi
      rw [hS] at hx
      rw [hx i hi, zero_pow hq.ne', sub_zero]
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hx⟩ : ∃ i ∈ s, eval x (f i) ≠ 0 := by
        simpa [hS, not_forall, Classical.not_imp] using hx
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero hi
      rw [pow_card_sub_one_eq_one (eval x (f i)) hx, sub_self]
  
  have key : ∑ x, eval x F = Fintype.card { x : σ → K // ∀ i ∈ s, eval x (f i) = 0 } := by
    rw [Fintype.card_of_subtype S hS, card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_one, ←
      Fintype.sum_extend_by_zero S, sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hF x]
  
  change p ∣ Fintype.card { x // ∀ i : ι, i ∈ s → eval x (f i) = 0 }
  rw [← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff K, ← key]
  change (∑ x, eval x F) = 0
  
  apply F.sum_eval_eq_zero
  
  show F.totalDegree < (q - 1) * Fintype.card σ
  calc
    F.totalDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (1 - f i ^ (q - 1)).totalDegree := totalDegree_finsetProd s _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (q - 1) * (f i).totalDegree := sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    
    _ = (q - 1) * ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree := (mul_sum ..).symm
    _ < (q - 1) * Fintype.card σ := by gcongr
  
  change (1 - f i ^ (q - 1)).totalDegree ≤ (q - 1) * (f i).totalDegree
  calc
    (1 - f i ^ (q - 1)).totalDegree ≤
        max (1 : MvPolynomial σ K).totalDegree (f i ^ (q - 1)).totalDegree := totalDegree_sub _ _
    _ ≤ (f i ^ (q - 1)).totalDegree := by simp
    _ ≤ (q - 1) * (f i).totalDegree := totalDegree_pow _ _

name: char_dvd_card_solutions_of_fintype_sum_lt
proof:
:= by
  simpa using char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt p h

name: char_dvd_card_solutions
statement:
theorem char_dvd_card_solutions {f : MvPolynomial σ K} (h : f.totalDegree < Fintype.card σ) :
    p ∣ Fintype.card { x : σ → K // eval x f = 0 }
proof:
:= by
  let F : Unit → MvPolynomial σ K := fun _ => f
  have : (∑ i : Unit, (F i).totalDegree) < Fintype.card σ := h
  convert! char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt p this
  aesop

name: char_dvd_card_solutions_of_add_lt
proof:
:= by
  let F : Bool → MvPolynomial σ K := fun b => cond b f₂ f₁
  have : (∑ b : Bool, (F b).totalDegree) < Fintype.card σ := (add_comm _ _).trans_lt h
  simpa only [Bool.forall_bool] using! char_dvd_card_solutions_of_fintype_sum_lt p this

name: IsSepClosed.splits_codomain
statement:
theorem IsSepClosed.splits_codomain [IsSepClosed K] {f : k →+* K}
    (p : k[X]) (h : p.Separable) : (p.map f).Splits
proof:
:=
  IsSepClosed.splits_of_separable (p.map f) (Separable.map h)

name: IsSepClosed.splits_domain
statement:
theorem IsSepClosed.splits_domain [IsSepClosed k] {f : k →+* K}
    (p : k[X]) (h : p.Separable) : (p.map f).Splits
proof:
:=
  (IsSepClosed.splits_of_separable _ h).map f

name: exists_root
statement:
theorem exists_root [IsSepClosed k] (p : k[X]) (hp : p.degree ≠ 0) (hsep : p.Separable) :
    ∃ x, IsRoot p x
proof:
:=
  (IsSepClosed.splits_of_separable p hsep).exists_eval_eq_zero hp

name: exists_root_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C
statement:
theorem exists_root_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C
    [IsSepClosed k] {n : ℕ} (a b c : k) (hn : (n : k) = 0) (hn' : 2 ≤ n) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x, a * x ^ n + b * x + c = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : k[X] := C a * X ^ n + C b * X + C c
  
  have hdeg : f.degree ≠ 0 := degree_ne_of_natDegree_ne (n := 0) <| by
    have : C 0 * X ^ n + C b * X = 0 * X ^ n + C b * X := by grind
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · grind [zero_add]
    · grind [natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt]
  have hsep : f.Separable := separable_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C a b c hn hb.isUnit
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_root f hdeg hsep
  exact ⟨x, by simpa [f] using hx⟩

name: exists_root_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C'
statement:
theorem exists_root_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C'
    [IsSepClosed k] (p n : ℕ) (a b c : k) [CharP k p] (hn : p ∣ n) (hn' : 2 ≤ n) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x, a * x ^ n + b * x + c = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_root_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C a b c ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff k p n).2 hn) hn' hb

name: exists_pow_nat_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pow_nat_eq [IsSepClosed k] (x : k) (n : ℕ) [hn : NeZero (n : k)] :
    ∃ z, z ^ n = x
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by
    rw [h, Nat.cast_zero] at hn
    exact hn.out rfl
  have : degree (X ^ n - C x) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [degree_X_pow_sub_C hn' x]
    exact (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 hn').ne'
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [hx, pow_eq_zero_iff hn'.ne']⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_root _ this <| separable_X_pow_sub_C x hn.out hx
    use z
    simpa [eval_C, eval_X, eval_pow, eval_sub, IsRoot.def, sub_eq_zero] using hz

name: exists_eq_mul_self
statement: theorem exists_eq_mul_self [IsSepClosed k] (x : k) [h2 : NeZero (2 : k)] : ∃ z, x = z * z
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_pow_nat_eq x 2 with ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨z, sq z⟩

name: roots_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem roots_eq_zero_iff [IsSepClosed k] {p : k[X]} (hsep : p.Separable) :
    p.roots = 0 ↔ p = Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun hp => by rw [hp, roots_C]⟩
  rcases le_or_gt (degree p) 0 with hd | hd
  · exact eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hd
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsSepClosed.exists_root p hd.ne' hsep
    rw [← mem_roots (ne_zero_of_degree_gt hd), h] at hz
    simp at hz

name: exists_eval
statement:
theorem exists_eval₂_eq_zero_of_injective {k : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [IsSepClosed K] (f : k →+* K)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : k[X]) (hp : p.degree ≠ 0) (hsep : p.Separable) :
    ∃ x, p.eval₂ f x = 0
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_root (p.map f) (by rwa [degree_map_eq_of_injective hf])
    (Separable.map hsep)
  ⟨x, by rwa [eval₂_eq_eval_map, ← IsRoot]⟩

name: exists_eval
statement:
theorem exists_eval₂_eq_zero {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [IsSimpleRing k] [IsSepClosed K] (f : k →+* K)
    (p : k[X]) (hp : p.degree ≠ 0) (hsep : p.Separable) : ∃ x, p.eval₂ f x = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_eval₂_eq_zero_of_injective _ f.injective _ hp hsep

name: exists_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_aeval_eq_zero {k : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [IsSepClosed K] [Algebra k K]
    [FaithfulSMul k K] (p : k[X]) (hp : p.degree ≠ 0) (hsep : p.Separable) :
    ∃ x : K, p.aeval x = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_eval₂_eq_zero_of_injective _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ..) p hp hsep

name: of_exists_root
statement:
theorem of_exists_root (H : ∀ p : k[X], p.Monic → Irreducible p → Separable p → ∃ x, p.eval x = 0) :
    IsSepClosed k
proof:
:= by
  replace H (p : k[X]) (hp : Irreducible p) (hs : Separable p) : ∃ x, p.eval x = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := H (p * C (leadingCoeff p)⁻¹) (monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hp.ne_zero)
      (irreducible_mul_leadingCoeff_inv.mpr hp) (hs.mul_unit (by aesop))
    exact ⟨x, by simpa [hp.ne_zero] using hx⟩
  refine ⟨fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_prod hp0
  rw [← hu]
  refine (Splits.multisetProd fun f hf ↦ ?_).mul u.isUnit.splits
  let h := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_factor f hf
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := H f h (hp.of_dvd (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_factors hf))
  exact Splits.of_degree_eq_one (degree_eq_one_of_irreducible_of_root h hx)

name: degree_eq_one_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem degree_eq_one_of_irreducible [IsSepClosed k] {p : k[X]}
    (hp : Irreducible p) (hsep : p.Separable) : p.degree = 1
proof:
:=
  (IsSepClosed.splits_of_separable p hsep).degree_eq_one_of_irreducible hp

name: algebraMap_surjective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_surjective
    [IsSepClosed k] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K] :
    Function.Surjective (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun x => ⟨-(minpoly k x).coeff 0, ?_⟩
  have hq : (minpoly k x).leadingCoeff = 1 := minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral k x)
  have hsep : IsSeparable k x := Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable k x
  have h : (minpoly k x).degree = 1 :=
    degree_eq_one_of_irreducible k (minpoly.irreducible (Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral k x)) hsep
  have : aeval x (minpoly k x) = 0 := minpoly.aeval k x
  rw [eq_X_add_C_of_degree_eq_one h, hq, C_1, one_mul, aeval_add, aeval_X, aeval_C,
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at this
  exact (map_neg (algebraMap k K) ((minpoly k x).coeff 0)).symm ▸ this.symm

name: algebraMap_bijective
statement:
lemma algebraMap_bijective [IsSepClosed k] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨RingHom.injective _, IsSepClosed.algebraMap_surjective _ _⟩

name: IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isSepClosed_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isSepClosed_of_isSeparable [IsSepClosed k] [Algebra k K]
    (L : IntermediateField k K) [Algebra.IsSeparable k L] : L = ⊥
proof:
:= bot_unique fun x hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := IsSepClosed.algebraMap_surjective k L ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨y, congr_arg (algebraMap L K) hy⟩

name: isSepClosure_iff
statement:
theorem isSepClosure_iff [Algebra k K] :
    IsSepClosure k K ↔ IsSepClosed K ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k K

name: surjective_domRestrict_of_isSeparable
proof:
:=
  fun f ↦ IntermediateField.exists_algHom_of_splits' (E := E) f
    fun s ↦ ⟨Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral L s,
      IsSepClosed.splits_codomain _ <| Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable L s⟩

name: IsSepClosed.separableClosure_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem IsSepClosed.separableClosure_eq_bot_iff [IsSepClosed E] :
    separableClosure F E = ⊥ ↔ IsSepClosed F
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ IsSepClosed.of_exists_root _ fun p _ hirr hsep ↦ ?_,
    fun _ ↦ IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isSepClosed_of_isSeparable _⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsSepClosed.exists_aeval_eq_zero E p (degree_pos_of_irreducible hirr).ne' hsep
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h ▸ mem_separableClosure_iff.2 (hsep.of_dvd <| minpoly.dvd _ x hx)
  exact ⟨x, by simpa [Algebra.ofId_apply] using hx⟩

name: X_pow_sub_C_splits_of_isPrimitiveRoot
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_splits_of_isPrimitiveRoot
    {n : ℕ} {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) {α a : K} (e : α ^ n = a) :
    (X ^ n - C a).Splits
proof:
:= by
  cases n.eq_zero_or_pos with
  | inl hn =>
    simp only [hn, pow_zero, ← C.map_one, ← map_sub, Splits.C]
  | inr hn =>
    rw [splits_iff_card_roots, ← nthRoots, hζ.card_nthRoots, natDegree_X_pow_sub_C,
      ite_eq_left ⟨α, e⟩]

name: X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod'
statement:
private
theorem X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod'
    {n : ℕ} {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) {α a : K} (hn : 0 < n) (e : α ^ n = a) :
    (X ^ n - C a) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X - C (ζ ^ i * α))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(X_pow_sub_C_splits_of_isPrimitiveRoot hζ e).eq_prod_roots_of_monic
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hn.ne'), ← nthRoots, hζ.nthRoots_eq e, Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

name: X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod
statement:
lemma X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {n : ℕ} {ζ : R} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) {α a : R} (hn : 0 < n) (e : α ^ n = a) :
    (X ^ n - C a) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X - C (ζ ^ i * α))
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  let i := algebraMap R K
  have h := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K
  apply_fun Polynomial.map i using map_injective i h
  simpa only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, map_C, map_mul, map_pow,
    Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_mul]
    using X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod' (hζ.map_of_injective h) hn <| map_pow i α n ▸ congrArg i e

name: X_pow_mul_sub_C_irreducible
statement:
theorem X_pow_mul_sub_C_irreducible
    {n m : ℕ} {a : K} (hm : Irreducible (X ^ m - C a))
    (hn : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra K E] (x : E) (_ : minpoly K x = X ^ m - C a),
      Irreducible (X ^ n - C (AdjoinSimple.gen K x))) :
    Irreducible (X ^ (n * m) - C a)
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [pow_zero, ← C.map_one, ← map_sub] at hm
    exact not_irreducible_C _ hm
  simpa [pow_mul] using irreducible_comp (monic_X_pow_sub_C a hm') (monic_X_pow n) hm
    (by simpa only [Polynomial.map_pow, map_X] using hn)

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_odd
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_odd
    {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) {a : K} (ha : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ n → ∀ b : K, b ^ p ≠ a) :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C a)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using induction_on_primes generalizing K a with
  | zero => simp [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd] at hn
  | one => simpa using irreducible_X_sub_C a
  | prime_mul p n hp IH =>
    rw [mul_comm]
    apply X_pow_mul_sub_C_irreducible
      (X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime hp (ha p hp (dvd_mul_right _ _)))
    intro E _ _ x hx
    have : IsIntegral K x := not_not.mp fun h ↦ by
      simpa only [degree_zero, degree_X_pow_sub_C hp.pos,
        WithBot.natCast_ne_bot] using congr_arg degree (hx.symm.trans (dite_eq_right h))
    apply IH (Nat.odd_mul.mp hn).2
    intro q hq hqn b hb
    apply ha q hq (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hqn p) (Algebra.norm _ b)
    rw [← map_pow, hb, ← adjoin.powerBasis_gen this,
      Algebra.PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_coeff_zero_minpoly]
    simp [minpoly_gen, hx, hp.ne_zero.symm, (Nat.odd_mul.mp hn).1.neg_pow]

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_forall_prime_of_odd
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_forall_prime_of_odd {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) {a : K} :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C a) ↔ (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ n → ∀ b : K, b ^ p ≠ a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e _ hp hpn ↦ pow_ne_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C e hpn hp.ne_one,
    X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_odd hn⟩

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_of_odd
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_of_odd {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) {a : K} :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C a) ↔ (∀ d, d ∣ n → d ≠ 1 → ∀ b : K, b ^ d ≠ a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e _ ↦ pow_ne_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C e,
    fun H ↦ X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_odd hn fun p hp hpn ↦ (H p hpn hp.ne_one)⟩

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime_pow_of_ne_two
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime_pow_of_ne_two
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp' : p ≠ 2) (n : ℕ) {a : K} (ha : ∀ b : K, b ^ p ≠ a) :
    Irreducible (X ^ (p ^ n) - C a)
proof:
:= by
  apply X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_odd (hp.odd_of_ne_two hp').pow
  intro q hq hq'
  simpa [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hp).mp (hq.dvd_of_dvd_pow hq')] using ha

name: X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_of_prime_pow_of_ne_two
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_iff_of_prime_pow_of_ne_two
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp' : p ≠ 2) {n} (hn : n ≠ 0) {a : K} :
    Irreducible (X ^ p ^ n - C a) ↔ ∀ b, b ^ p ≠ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨(pow_ne_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C · (dvd_pow dvd_rfl hn) hp.ne_one),
    X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime_pow_of_ne_two hp hp' n⟩

name: Polynomial.separable_X_pow_sub_C_of_irreducible
statement: theorem Polynomial.separable_X_pow_sub_C_of_irreducible : (X ^ n - C a).Separable
proof:
:= by
  let := Fact.mk H
  let : Algebra K K[n√a] := inferInstance
  have hn := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)
  by_cases hn' : n = 1
  · rw [hn', pow_one]; exact separable_X_sub_C
  have ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hζ
  rw [mem_primitiveRoots (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <| ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)] at hζ
  rw [← separable_map (algebraMap K K[n√a]), Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, map_C, map_X,
    AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq,
    X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod (hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap K _).injective) hn
    (root_X_pow_sub_C_pow n a), separable_prod_X_sub_C_iff']
  exact (hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap K K[n√a]).injective).injOn_pow_mul
    (root_X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (lt_of_le_of_ne (show 1 ≤ n from hn) (Ne.symm hn')) _)

name: autAdjoinRootXPowSubC_root
statement:
lemma autAdjoinRootXPowSubC_root (η) :
    autAdjoinRootXPowSubC n a η (root _) = ((η : Kˣ) : K) • root _
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [autAdjoinRootXPowSubC, autAdjoinRootXPowSubCHom, AlgEquiv.algHomUnitsEquiv]
  exact liftAlgHom_root _ (Algebra.ofId _ _) ..

name: autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root
statement:
lemma autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root [NeZero n] (η) :
    autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H η (root _) = ((η : Kˣ) : K) • root _
proof:
:=
  autAdjoinRootXPowSubC_root a η

name: autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_symm_smul
statement:
lemma autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_symm_smul [NeZero n] (σ) :
    ((autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H).symm σ : Kˣ) • (root _ : K[n√a]) = σ (root _)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fact.mk H
  simp only [autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv, OneHom.toFun_eq_coe, MonoidHom.toOneHom_coe,
    MulEquiv.symm_mk, MulEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, AdjoinRootXPowSubCEquivToRootsOfUnity,
    AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def,
    rootsOfUnityEquivOfPrimitiveRoots_symm_apply, Units.val_ofPowEqOne, ite_mul, one_mul]
  simp_rw [← root_X_pow_sub_C_eq_zero_iff H]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h, map_zero]
  · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h]

name: isSplittingField_AdjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
lemma isSplittingField_AdjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C :
    haveI
proof:
:= Fact.mk H
    letI : Algebra K K[n√a] := inferInstance
    IsSplittingField K K[n√a] (X ^ n - C a) := by
  have := Fact.mk H
  let : Algebra K K[n√a] := inferInstance
  constructor
  · rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.map_X]
    have ⟨_, hζ⟩ := hζ
    rw [mem_primitiveRoots (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <| ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)] at hζ
    exact X_pow_sub_C_splits_of_isPrimitiveRoot (hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap K _).injective)
      (root_X_pow_sub_C_pow n a)
  · rw [eq_top_iff, ← AdjoinRoot.adjoinRoot_eq_top]
    apply Algebra.adjoin_mono
    have := ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H
    rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff, mem_rootSet_of_ne (X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero this) a), aeval_def, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root]

name: adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root
statement:
lemma adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root :
    adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα (root _) = α
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv, AlgEquiv.coe_ofBijective, liftAlgHom_root]

name: adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_symm_eq_root
statement:
lemma adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_symm_eq_root :
    (adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα).symm α = root _
proof:
:= by
  apply (adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα).injective
  rw [(adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα).apply_symm_apply, adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root]

name: Algebra.adjoin_root_eq_top_of_isSplittingField
statement:
lemma Algebra.adjoin_root_eq_top_of_isSplittingField :
    Algebra.adjoin K {α} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply Subalgebra.map_injective (B := K[n√a]) (f := (adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα).symm)
    (adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα).symm.injective
  rw [Algebra.map_top, (AlgHom.range_eq_top _).mpr
    (adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv hζ H hα).symm.surjective, AlgHom.map_adjoin,
    Set.image_singleton, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_symm_eq_root,
      adjoinRoot_eq_top]

name: IntermediateField.adjoin_root_eq_top_of_isSplittingField
statement:
lemma IntermediateField.adjoin_root_eq_top_of_isSplittingField :
    K⟮α⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine (IntermediateField.eq_adjoin_of_eq_algebra_adjoin _ _ _ ?_).symm
  exact (Algebra.adjoin_root_eq_top_of_isSplittingField hζ H hα).symm

name: rootOfSplitsXPowSubC_pow
statement:
lemma rootOfSplitsXPowSubC_pow [NeZero n] :
    (rootOfSplitsXPowSubC (NeZero.pos n) a L) ^ n = algebraMap K L a
proof:
:= by
  have := eval_rootOfSplits (IsSplittingField.splits L (X ^ n - C a))
    (by simp [degree_X_pow_sub_C (NeZero.pos n), NeZero.ne n])
  simpa only [eval_map, eval₂_sub, eval₂_X_pow, eval₂_C, sub_eq_zero] using this

name: autEquivRootsOfUnity_apply_rootOfSplit
statement:
lemma autEquivRootsOfUnity_apply_rootOfSplit [NeZero n] (σ : Gal(L/K)) :
    σ (rootOfSplitsXPowSubC (NeZero.pos n) a L) =
      autEquivRootsOfUnity hζ H L σ • (rootOfSplitsXPowSubC (NeZero.pos n) a L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, rfl⟩ := (autEquivRootsOfUnity hζ H L).symm.surjective σ
  rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, autEquivRootsOfUnity]
  simp only [MulEquiv.symm_trans_apply, AlgEquiv.autCongr_symm, AlgEquiv.symm_symm,
    MulEquiv.symm_symm, AlgEquiv.autCongr_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_symm_eq_root, autAdjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root, map_smul,
    adjoinRootXPowSubCEquiv_root]
  rfl

name: autEquivRootsOfUnity_smul
statement:
lemma autEquivRootsOfUnity_smul [NeZero n] (σ : Gal(L/K)) :
    autEquivRootsOfUnity hζ H L σ • α = σ α
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨ζ, hζ'⟩ := hζ
  have hn := NeZero.pos n
  rw [mem_primitiveRoots hn] at hζ'
  rw [← mem_nthRoots hn, (hζ'.map_of_injective (algebraMap K L).injective).nthRoots_eq
    (rootOfSplitsXPowSubC_pow a L)] at hα
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map, Multiset.mem_range] at hα
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hα
  simp only [← map_pow, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul,
    autEquivRootsOfUnity_apply_rootOfSplit hζ H L]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: autEquivZmod_symm_apply_intCast
statement:
lemma autEquivZmod_symm_apply_intCast [NeZero n] {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) (m : ℤ) :
    (autEquivZmod H L hζ).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd (m : ZMod n)) α = ζ ^ m • α
proof:
:= by
  have hn := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)
  rw [← autEquivRootsOfUnity_smul ⟨ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots hn).mpr hζ⟩ H L hα]
  simp [MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_symm_apply, Subgroup.smul_def, Units.smul_def, autEquivZmod]

name: autEquivZmod_symm_apply_natCast
statement:
lemma autEquivZmod_symm_apply_natCast [NeZero n] {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) (m : ℕ) :
    (autEquivZmod H L hζ).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd (m : ZMod n)) α = ζ ^ m • α
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Int.cast_natCast, zpow_natCast] using autEquivZmod_symm_apply_intCast H L hα hζ m

name: isCyclic_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C
statement: lemma isCyclic_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C [NeZero n] : IsCyclic Gal(L/K)
proof:
:=
  have hn := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)
  isCyclic_of_surjective _
    (autEquivZmod H _ <| (mem_primitiveRoots hn).mp hζ.choose_spec).symm.surjective

name: isGalois_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C
statement: lemma isGalois_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C : IsGalois K L
proof:
:=
  IsGalois.of_separable_splitting_field (separable_X_pow_sub_C_of_irreducible hζ a H)

name: finrank_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C
statement: lemma finrank_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C : Module.finrank K L = n
proof:
:= by
  have := Polynomial.IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional L (X ^ n - C a)
  have := isGalois_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C hζ H L
  have hn := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H)
  have : NeZero n := ⟨ne_zero_of_irreducible_X_pow_sub_C H⟩
  rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, Nat.card_congr ((autEquivZmod H L <|
    (mem_primitiveRoots hn).mp hζ.choose_spec).toEquiv.trans Multiplicative.toAdd), Nat.card_zmod]

name: exists_root_adjoin_eq_top_of_isCyclic
statement:
lemma exists_root_adjoin_eq_top_of_isCyclic [IsGalois K L] [IsCyclic Gal(L/K)] :
    ∃ (α : L), α ^ (finrank K L) ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) ∧ K⟮α⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  
  have ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hK
  rw [mem_primitiveRoots finrank_pos] at hζ
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := ‹IsCyclic Gal(L/K)›
  have hσ' := orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hσ
  
  
  have : IsRoot (minpoly K σ.toLinearMap) ζ := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank] at hσ'
    simpa [minpoly_algEquiv_toLinearMap σ (isOfFinOrder_of_finite σ), hσ',
      sub_eq_zero] using hζ.pow_eq_one
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_isRoot this).exists_hasEigenvector
  have hv' := hv.pow_apply
  simp_rw [← AlgEquiv.pow_toLinearMap, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply] at hv'
  
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [← IntermediateField.mem_bot,
      ← OrderIso.map_bot IsGalois.intermediateFieldEquivSubgroup.symm]
    intro ⟨σ', hσ'⟩
    obtain ⟨n, rfl : σ ^ n = σ'⟩ := mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.mpr (hσ σ')
    rw [smul_pow', Submonoid.smul_def, AlgEquiv.smul_def, hv', smul_pow, ← pow_mul,
      mul_comm, pow_mul, hζ.pow_eq_one, one_pow, one_smul]
  · 
    apply IsGalois.intermediateFieldEquivSubgroup.injective
    rw [map_top, eq_top_iff]
    intro σ' hσ'
    obtain ⟨n, rfl : σ ^ n = σ'⟩ := mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.mpr (hσ σ')
    have := hσ' ⟨v, IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self K v⟩
    simp only [AlgEquiv.smul_def, hv'] at this
    conv_rhs at this => rw [← one_smul K v]
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hζ.dvd_of_pow_eq_one n (smul_left_injective K hv.2 this)
    rw [pow_mul, ← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, pow_card_eq_one', one_pow]
    exact one_mem _

name: irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_root_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
lemma irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_root_adjoin_eq_top
    {a : K} {α : L} (ha : α ^ (finrank K L) = algebraMap K L a) (hα : K⟮α⟯ = ⊤) :
    Irreducible (X ^ (finrank K L) - C a)
proof:
:= by
  have : X ^ (finrank K L) - C a = minpoly K α := by
    refine minpoly.unique _ _ (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ finrank_pos.ne.symm) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [aeval_def, eval₂_sub, eval₂_X_pow, ha, eval₂_C, sub_self]
    · intro q hq hq'
      refine le_trans ?_ (degree_le_of_dvd (minpoly.dvd _ _ hq') hq.ne_zero)
      rw [degree_X_pow_sub_C finrank_pos,
        degree_eq_natDegree (minpoly.ne_zero (IsIntegral.of_finite K α)),
        ← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (IsIntegral.of_finite K α), hα, Nat.cast_le]
      exact (finrank_top K L).ge
  exact this ▸ minpoly.irreducible (IsIntegral.of_finite K α)

name: isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C_of_root_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
lemma isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C_of_root_adjoin_eq_top
    {a : K} {α : L} (ha : α ^ (finrank K L) = algebraMap K L a) (hα : K⟮α⟯ = ⊤) :
    IsSplittingField K L (X ^ (finrank K L) - C a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.map_X]
    have ⟨_, hζ⟩ := hK
    rw [mem_primitiveRoots finrank_pos] at hζ
    exact X_pow_sub_C_splits_of_isPrimitiveRoot (hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap K _).injective) ha
  · rw [eq_top_iff, ← IntermediateField.top_toSubalgebra, ← hα,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic (IsAlgebraic.of_finite K α)]
    apply Algebra.adjoin_mono
    rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff, mem_rootSet_of_ne (X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero finrank_pos a),
      aeval_def, eval₂_sub, eval₂_X_pow, eval₂_C, ha, sub_self]

name: isCyclic_tfae
statement:
lemma isCyclic_tfae (K L) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hK : (primitiveRoots (Module.finrank K L) K).Nonempty) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsGalois K L ∧ IsCyclic Gal(L/K),
      ∃ a : K, Irreducible (X ^ (finrank K L) - C a) ∧
        IsSplittingField K L (X ^ (finrank K L) - C a),
      ∃ (α : L), α ^ (finrank K L) ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) ∧ K⟮α⟯ = ⊤]
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (Module.finrank K L) := NeZero.of_pos finrank_pos
  tfae_have 1 → 3
  | ⟨inst₁, inst₂⟩ => exists_root_adjoin_eq_top_of_isCyclic K L hK
  tfae_have 3 → 2
  | ⟨α, ⟨a, ha⟩, hα⟩ => ⟨a, irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_root_adjoin_eq_top ha.symm hα,
      isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C_of_root_adjoin_eq_top hK ha.symm hα⟩
  tfae_have 2 → 1
  | ⟨a, H, inst⟩ => ⟨isGalois_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C hK H L,
      isCyclic_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C hK H L⟩
  tfae_finish

name: normalizedTraceAux_def
statement:
private theorem normalizedTraceAux_def (a : K) : normalizedTraceAux F K a =
    (Module.finrank F F⟮a⟯ : F)⁻¹ • trace F F⟮a⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen F a)
proof: := rfl

name: normalizedTraceAux_map
statement:
private theorem normalizedTraceAux_map {E : Type*} [Field E] [Algebra F E] (f : E →ₐ[F] K) (a : E) :
    normalizedTraceAux F K (f a) = normalizedTraceAux F E a
proof:
:= by
  let e := (F⟮a⟯.equivMap f).trans (equivOfEq <| Set.image_singleton ▸ adjoin_map F {a} f)
  simp_rw [normalizedTraceAux, ← LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e.toLinearEquiv]
  congr
  exact trace_eq_of_algEquiv e <| AdjoinSimple.gen F a

name: normalizedTraceAux_intermediateField
statement:
private theorem normalizedTraceAux_intermediateField {E : IntermediateField F K} (a : E) :
    normalizedTraceAux F K a = normalizedTraceAux F E a
proof:
:=
  normalizedTraceAux_map F K E.val a

name: normalizedTraceAux_eq_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
private theorem normalizedTraceAux_eq_of_finiteDimensional [FiniteDimensional F K] (a : K) :
    normalizedTraceAux F K a = (Module.finrank F K : F)⁻¹ • trace F K a
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Nat.cast_ne_zero (R := F)).mpr <|
    Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp <| Module.finrank_pos (R := F⟮a⟯) (M := K)
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv, trace_eq_trace_adjoin F a,
    ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank F F⟮a⟯ K, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm,
    mul_div_mul_right _ _ h, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, normalizedTraceAux_def]

name: normalizedTrace_def
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_def (a : K) : normalizedTrace F K a =
    (Module.finrank F F⟮a⟯ : F)⁻¹ • trace F F⟮a⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen F a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: normalizedTrace_minpoly
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_minpoly (a : K) :
    normalizedTrace F K a = ((minpoly F a).natDegree : F)⁻¹ • -(minpoly F a).nextCoeff
proof:
:=
  have ha : IsIntegral F a := IsIntegral.isIntegral a
  IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank ha ▸ trace_adjoinSimpleGen ha ▸ normalizedTrace_def F K a

name: normalizedTrace_self_apply
statement: theorem normalizedTrace_self_apply (a : F) : normalizedTrace F F a = a
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [normalizedTrace]
  rw [normalizedTraceAux_eq_of_finiteDimensional F a, Module.finrank_self F,
    Nat.cast_one, inv_one, one_smul, trace_self_apply]

name: normalizedTrace_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTrace_self : normalizedTrace F F = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext normalizedTrace_self_apply

name: normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional_apply
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional_apply [FiniteDimensional F K] (a : K) :
    normalizedTrace F K a = (Module.finrank F K : F)⁻¹ • trace F K a
proof:
:=
  normalizedTraceAux_eq_of_finiteDimensional F a

name: normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional [FiniteDimensional F K] :
    normalizedTrace F K = (Module.finrank F K : F)⁻¹ • trace F K
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext <| normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional_apply F

name: normalizedTrace_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTrace_map {E : Type*} [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsIntegral F E]
    (f : E →ₐ[F] K) (a : E) : normalizedTrace F K (f a) = normalizedTrace F E a
proof:
:=
  normalizedTraceAux_map F K f a

name: normalizedTrace_intermediateField
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_intermediateField {E : IntermediateField F K} (a : E) :
    normalizedTrace F K a = normalizedTrace F E a
proof:
:=

name: normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply (a : E) :
    normalizedTrace F K (algebraMap E K a) = normalizedTrace F E a
proof:
:=
  normalizedTrace_map F K (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K) a

name: normalizedTrace_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTrace_algebraMap :
    normalizedTrace F K ∘ₗ Algebra.linearMap E K = normalizedTrace F E
proof:

  LinearMap.ext <| normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply F E K

name: normalizedTrace_algebraMap_of_lifts
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_algebraMap_of_lifts [CharZero E] [Algebra.IsIntegral E K] (a : K)
    (h : minpoly E a ∈ Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap F E)) :
    algebraMap F E (normalizedTrace F K a) = normalizedTrace E K a
proof:
:= by
  have ha : IsIntegral F a := IsIntegral.isIntegral a
  simp [normalizedTrace_minpoly F a, normalizedTrace_minpoly E a, ← minpoly.map_algebraMap ha h,
    (minpoly F a).nextCoeff_map_eq, map_mul, map_neg]

name: normalizedTrace_trans_apply_aux
statement:
private theorem normalizedTrace_trans_apply_aux [FiniteDimensional F E] [Algebra.IsIntegral E K]
    [CharZero E] (a : K) :
    normalizedTrace F E (normalizedTrace E K a) = normalizedTrace F K a
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional E E⟮a⟯ :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional (IsIntegral.isIntegral a)
  rw [normalizedTrace_def E K, inv_natCast_smul_eq (R := E) (S := F), map_smul,
    normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional F E, LinearMap.smul_apply, ← smul_assoc,
    smul_eq_mul (a := _⁻¹), ← mul_inv, trace_trace, mul_comm,
    ← Nat.cast_mul, Module.finrank_mul_finrank, eq_comm]
  let E' := E⟮a⟯.restrictScalars F
  have : FiniteDimensional F E' := Module.Finite.trans E E⟮a⟯
  have h_finrank_eq : Module.finrank F E⟮a⟯ = Module.finrank F E' := rfl
  have h_trace_eq : trace F E⟮a⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen E a) = trace F E' (AdjoinSimple.gen E a : E') :=
    rfl
  let a' : E' := AdjoinSimple.gen E a
  rw [h_finrank_eq, h_trace_eq, ← normalizedTrace_eq_of_finiteDimensional_apply F,
    ← normalizedTrace_intermediateField F K a']
  congr

name: normalizedTrace_trans_apply
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_trans_apply [Algebra.IsIntegral E K] [CharZero E] (a : K) :
    normalizedTrace F E (normalizedTrace E K a) = normalizedTrace F K a
proof:
:=
  let S : Set E := (minpoly E a).coeffs
  let E₀ := IntermediateField.adjoin F S
  have : FiniteDimensional F E₀ := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
    fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral E₀ E := IsIntegral.tower_top F
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral E₀ K := IsIntegral.trans E
  have hsub : S ⊆ (algebraMap E₀ E).range :=
    Subalgebra.range_algebraMap E₀.toSubalgebra ▸ IntermediateField.subset_adjoin F S
  have hlifts := (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeffs_subset_range _).mpr hsub
  (normalizedTrace_trans_apply_aux F E₀ K _ ▸
    normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply F E₀ E _ ▸
    congrArg (normalizedTrace F E) (normalizedTrace_algebraMap_of_lifts E₀ E K a hlifts)).symm

name: normalizedTrace_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTrace_trans [Algebra.IsIntegral E K] [CharZero E] :
    normalizedTrace F E ∘ₗ normalizedTrace E K = normalizedTrace F K
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext <| normalizedTrace_trans_apply F E K

name: normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply_eq_self
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply_eq_self (a : F) :
    normalizedTrace F K (algebraMap F K a) = a
proof: := by simp

name: normalizedTrace_algebraMap_eq_id
statement:
theorem normalizedTrace_algebraMap_eq_id :
    normalizedTrace F K ∘ₗ Algebra.linearMap F K = LinearMap.id

name: normalizedTrace_comp_algHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTrace_comp_algHom {E : Type*} [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsIntegral F E]
    (f : E →ₐ[F] K) : normalizedTrace F K ∘ₗ f = normalizedTrace F E
proof:

name: normalizedTrace_surjective
statement: theorem normalizedTrace_surjective : Function.Surjective (normalizedTrace F K)
proof:
:=
  fun a ↦ ⟨algebraMap F K a, normalizedTrace_algebraMap_apply_eq_self F K a⟩

name: normalizedTrace_ne_zero
statement: theorem normalizedTrace_ne_zero : normalizedTrace F K ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, ha⟩ := normalizedTrace_surjective F K 1
  DFunLike.ne_iff.mpr <| ⟨a, ha ▸ one_ne_zero⟩

name: mem_separableClosure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_separableClosure_iff {x : E} :
    x ∈ separableClosure F E ↔ IsSeparable F x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: map_mem_separableClosure_iff
statement:
theorem map_mem_separableClosure_iff (i : E →ₐ[F] K) {x : E} :
    i x ∈ separableClosure F K ↔ x ∈ separableClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_separableClosure_iff, IsSeparable, minpoly.algHom_eq i i.injective]

name: separableClosure.comap_eq_of_algHom
statement:
theorem separableClosure.comap_eq_of_algHom (i : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (separableClosure F K).comap i = separableClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact map_mem_separableClosure_iff i

name: separableClosure.map_le_of_algHom
statement:
theorem separableClosure.map_le_of_algHom (i : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (separableClosure F E).map i ≤ separableClosure F K
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (comap_eq_of_algHom i).ge

name: separableClosure.map_eq_of_separableClosure_eq_bot
statement:
theorem separableClosure.map_eq_of_separableClosure_eq_bot [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    (h : separableClosure E K = ⊥) :
    (separableClosure F E).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K) = separableClosure F K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (map_le_of_algHom _) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mem_bot.1 <| h ▸ mem_separableClosure_iff.2
    (IsSeparable.tower_top E <| mem_separableClosure_iff.1 hx)
  exact ⟨y, (map_mem_separableClosure_iff <| IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K).mp hx, rfl⟩

name: separableClosure.map_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem separableClosure.map_eq_of_algEquiv (i : E ≃ₐ[F] K) :
    (separableClosure F E).map i = separableClosure F K
proof:
:=
  (map_le_of_algHom i.toAlgHom).antisymm
    (fun x h ↦ ⟨_, (map_mem_separableClosure_iff i.symm).2 h, by simp⟩)

name: le_separableClosure'
statement:
theorem le_separableClosure' {L : IntermediateField F E} (hs : ∀ x : L, IsSeparable F x) :
    L ≤ separableClosure F E
proof: := fun x h ↦ by simpa only [IsSeparable, minpoly_eq] using! hs ⟨x, h⟩

name: le_separableClosure
statement:
theorem le_separableClosure (L : IntermediateField F E) [Algebra.IsSeparable F L] :

proof: := le_separableClosure' F E (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable F)

statement:
theorem le_separableClosure_iff (L : IntermediateField F E) :
    L ≤ separableClosure F E ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable F L
proof:
:=

name: separableClosure.separableClosure_eq_bot
statement:
theorem separableClosure.separableClosure_eq_bot :
    separableClosure (separableClosure F E) E = ⊥
proof:
:=
  bot_unique fun x hx ↦ mem_bot.2
    ⟨⟨x, IsSeparable.of_algebra_isSeparable_of_isSeparable F (mem_separableClosure_iff.1 hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: separableClosure.normalClosure_eq_self
statement:
theorem separableClosure.normalClosure_eq_self :
    normalClosure F (separableClosure F E) E = separableClosure F E
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (normalClosure_le_iff.2 fun i ↦
    have : Algebra.IsSeparable F i.fieldRange :=
      (AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable (AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField i))
    le_separableClosure F E _) (le_normalClosure _)

name: IntermediateField.isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable {S : Set E} :
    Algebra.IsSeparable F (adjoin F S) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, IsSeparable F x
proof:
:=
  (le_separableClosure_iff F E _).symm.trans adjoin_le_iff

name: Algebra.isSeparable_of_separable_splitting_field
statement:
theorem Algebra.isSeparable_of_separable_splitting_field {p : F[X]}
    [sp : p.IsSplittingField F E] (hp : p.Separable) : Algebra.IsSeparable F E
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isSeparable_top, ← (isSplittingField_iff_intermediateField.mp sp).2,
    isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable]
  exact fun x hx ↦ hp.of_dvd (minpoly.dvd F x (aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_rootSet hx))

name: separableClosure.eq_top_iff
statement: theorem separableClosure.eq_top_iff : separableClosure F E = ⊤ ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable F E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ mem_separableClosure_iff.1 (h ▸ mem_top)⟩,
    fun _ ↦ top_unique fun x _ ↦ mem_separableClosure_iff.2 (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable _ x)⟩

statement:
theorem separableClosure.le_restrictScalars [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K] :

:=

theorem separableClosure.eq_restrictScalars_of_isSeparable [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]

proof:

:=
  ClosureOperator.isClosed_iff_closure_le.mpr fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (separableClosure.separableClosure_eq_bot K E).le hx
    exact x.2

name: sepDegree_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sepDegree_self : sepDegree F F = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sepDegree, Subsingleton.elim (separableClosure F F) ⊥, IntermediateField.rank_bot]

name: insepDegree_self
statement:

theorem insepDegree_self : insepDegree F F = 1
proof:

:= by

name: exists_finset_maximalFor_isTranscendenceBasis_separableClosure
statement:
lemma exists_finset_maximalFor_isTranscendenceBasis_separableClosure
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType F E] :
    ∃ s : Finset E, MaximalFor (fun t : Set E ↦ IsTranscendenceBasis F ((↑) : t → E))
      (fun t ↦ (separableClosure (adjoin F t) E).restrictScalars F) s
proof:
:= by
  let d (s : Finset E) := Field.finInsepDegree (adjoin F (s : Set E)) E
  have Hexists : {s : Finset E | IsTranscendenceBasis F ((↑) : s → E)}.Nonempty := by
    have ⟨s, hs⟩ := IntermediateField.fg_top F E
    have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin F (s : Set E)) E := by
      rw [← isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_top, hs, Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral]
      refine Algebra.isIntegral_of_surjective topEquiv.surjective
    have ⟨t, hts, ht⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_subset (R := F) (s : Set E)
    lift t to Finset E using s.finite_toSet.subset hts
    exact ⟨t, ht⟩
  let s := d.argminOn _ Hexists
  have hs := d.argminOn_mem _ Hexists
  refine ⟨s, hs, fun t ht ↦ not_lt_iff_le_imp_ge.mp fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  have : t.Finite := by
    simp [Set.Finite, ← Cardinal.mk_lt_aleph0_iff, ht.cardinalMk_eq hs, Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0]
  lift t to Finset E using this
  have : Module.Finite (adjoin F (s : Set E)) E := by
    apply +allowSynthFailures Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
    · exact .of_comp F _ _
    · convert! hs.isAlgebraic_field <;> simp [s]
  have : Module.Finite ((separableClosure (adjoin F (s : Set E)) E).restrictScalars F) E :=
    inferInstanceAs <| Module.Finite (separableClosure (adjoin F (s : Set E)) E) E
  apply d.not_lt_argminOn {s | IsTranscendenceBasis (ι := s) F Subtype.val} ht
  apply finrank_lt_of_gt H

name: sepDegree_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sepDegree_bot : sepDegree F (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := lift_sepDegree_eq_of_equiv _ _ _ (botEquiv F E)
  rwa [sepDegree_self, Cardinal.lift_one, ← Cardinal.lift_one.{v, u}, Cardinal.lift_inj] at this

name: insepDegree_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insepDegree_bot : insepDegree F (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = 1
proof:

    Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank (A.comap f) L) = Cardinal.lift.{w} (relrank A f.fieldRange)
proof:
:=
  A.toSubfield.lift_rank_comap f.toRingHom

name: rank_comap
statement:
theorem rank_comap {L : Type v} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (f : L →ₐ[F] E) :
    Module.rank (A.comap f) L = relrank A f.fieldRange
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [lift_id] using A.lift_rank_comap f

name: finrank_comap
statement: theorem finrank_comap (f : L →ₐ[F] E) : finrank (A.comap f) L = relfinrank A f.fieldRange

name: lift_relrank_comap
statement:
theorem lift_relrank_comap (f : L →ₐ[F] E) (B : IntermediateField F L) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (relrank (A.comap f) B) = Cardinal.lift.{w} (relrank A (B.map f))

name: relrank_comap
statement:
theorem relrank_comap {L : Type v} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (f : L →ₐ[F] E)

name: relfinrank_comap
statement:
theorem relfinrank_comap (f : L →ₐ[F] E) (B : IntermediateField F L) :

proof:

  simpa using! congr(toNat $(lift_relrank_comap A f B))

name: lift_relrank_map_map

proof:

name: relrank_map_map

name: relrank_comap_comap_eq_relrank_inf
statement:

    {L : Type v} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (f : L →ₐ[F] E) :

name: relfinrank_comap_comap_eq_relfinrank_inf
statement:
theorem relfinrank_comap_comap_eq_relfinrank_inf (f : L →ₐ[F] E) :
    relfinrank (A.comap f) (B.comap f) = relfinrank A (B ⊓ f.fieldRange)

name: lift_relrank_comap_comap_eq_lift_relrank_of_le

    Cardinal.lift.{v} (relrank (A.comap f) (B.comap f)) = Cardinal.lift.{w} (relrank A B)

  simpa only [inf_of_le_left h] using lift_relrank_comap_comap_eq_lift_relrank_inf A B f

name: relrank_comap_comap_eq_relrank_of_le
statement:
theorem relrank_comap_comap_eq_relrank_of_le
    {L : Type v} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (f : L →ₐ[F] E) (h : B ≤ f.fieldRange) :
    relrank (A.comap f) (B.comap f) = relrank A B
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [lift_id] using lift_relrank_comap_comap_eq_lift_relrank_of_le A B f h

name: relfinrank_comap_comap_eq_relfinrank_of_le

theorem relfinrank_comap_comap_eq_relfinrank_of_le (f : L →ₐ[F] E) (h : B ≤ f.fieldRange) :

name: lift_relrank_comap_comap_eq_lift_relrank_of_surjective

    (f : L →ₐ[F] E) (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (relrank (A.comap f) (B.comap f)) = Cardinal.lift.{w} (relrank A B)

:=
  lift_relrank_comap_comap_eq_lift_relrank_of_le A B f fun x _ ↦ h x

name: relrank_comap_comap_eq_relrank_of_surjective
statement:
theorem relrank_comap_comap_eq_relrank_of_surjective
    {L : Type v} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (f : L →ₐ[F] E) (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    relrank (A.comap f) (B.comap f) = relrank A B

name: relfinrank_comap_comap_eq_relfinrank_of_surjective

theorem relfinrank_comap_comap_eq_relfinrank_of_surjective

name: relrank_mul_rank_top

name: relfinrank_dvd_finrank_top_of_le

name: relrank_dvd_rank_bot
statement: theorem relrank_dvd_rank_bot : relrank A B ∣ Module.rank F B
proof:
:=
  inf_relrank_right A B ▸ dvd_of_mul_left_eq _ (rank_bot_mul_relrank inf_le_right)

name: relfinrank_dvd_finrank_bot
statement: theorem relfinrank_dvd_finrank_bot : relfinrank A B ∣ finrank F B

name: relrank_mul_relrank
statement:
theorem relrank_mul_relrank (h1 : A ≤ B) (h2 : B ≤ C) :

proof:
:=

name: relfinrank_mul_relfinrank
statement:
theorem relfinrank_mul_relfinrank (h1 : A ≤ B) (h2 : B ≤ C) :
    relfinrank A B * relfinrank B C = relfinrank A C

name: relrank_inf_mul_relrank
statement: theorem relrank_inf_mul_relrank : A.relrank (B ⊓ C) * B.relrank C = (A ⊓ B).relrank C

    A.relfinrank (B ⊓ C) * B.relfinrank C = (A ⊓ B).relfinrank C

theorem relrank_mul_relrank_eq_inf_relrank (h : B ≤ C) :

theorem relfinrank_mul_relfinrank_eq_inf_relfinrank (h : B ≤ C) :
    relfinrank A B * relfinrank B C = (A ⊓ B).relfinrank C

theorem relrank_inf_mul_relrank_of_le (h : A ≤ B) :
    A.relrank (B ⊓ C) * B.relrank C = A.relrank C

statement:
@[simp]
theorem relrank_top_right : relrank A ⊤ = Module.rank A E
proof:
:= by
  rw [← relrank_mul_rank_top (show A ≤ ⊤ from le_top), IntermediateField.rank_top, mul_one]

name: relfinrank_top_right

@[simp]
theorem relfinrank_top_right : relfinrank A ⊤ = finrank A E
proof:

theorem relrank_bot_left : relrank ⊥ A = Module.rank F A
proof:

name: relfinrank_bot_left

@[simp]
theorem relfinrank_bot_left : relfinrank ⊥ A = finrank F A
proof:
:= by
