    ← pb.natDegree_minpoly, ← natDegree_map (algebraMap K L), h_splits.natDegree_eq_card_roots,
    Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup]
  exact nodup_roots ((separable_map (algebraMap K L)).mpr h_sep)

name: linearIndependent_smul_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_smul_of_linearIndependent {s : Finset F} :
    (LinearIndepOn (FixedPoints.subfield G F) id (s : Set F)) →
      LinearIndepOn F (MulAction.toFun G F) s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : IsEmpty ((∅ : Finset F) : Set F) := by simp
  refine Finset.induction_on s (fun _ => linearIndependent_empty_type) fun a s has ih hs => ?_
  rw [coe_insert] at hs ⊢
  rw [linearIndepOn_insert (mt mem_coe.1 has)] at hs
  rw [linearIndepOn_insert (mt mem_coe.1 has)]; refine ⟨ih hs.1, fun ha => ?_⟩
  rw [Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination] at ha; rcases ha with ⟨l, hl, hla⟩
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply_of_mem_supported F hl] at hla
  suffices ∀ i ∈ s, l i ∈ FixedPoints.subfield G F by
    replace hla := (sum_apply _ _ fun i => l i • toFun G F i).symm.trans (congr_fun hla 1)
    simp_rw [Pi.smul_apply, toFun_apply, one_smul] at hla
    refine hs.2 (hla ▸ Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c hcs => ?_)
    change (⟨l c, this c hcs⟩ : FixedPoints.subfield G F) • c ∈ _
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ <| Submodule.subset_span <| by simpa
  intro i his g
  refine
    eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      (linearIndependent_iff'.1 (ih hs.1) s.attach (fun i => g • l i - l i) ?_ ⟨i, his⟩
          (mem_attach _ _) :
        _)
  refine (sum_attach s fun i ↦ (g • l i - l i) • MulAction.toFun G F i).trans ?_
  ext g'
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    congr
    · skip
    · ext
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, sub_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, Pi.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  conv_lhs =>
    congr
    · skip
    · ext x
      rw [toFun_apply, ← mul_inv_cancel_left g g', mul_smul, ← smul_mul', ← toFun_apply _ x]
  change
    (∑ x ∈ s, g • (fun y => l y • MulAction.toFun G F y) x (g⁻¹ * g')) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, (fun y => l y • MulAction.toFun G F y) x g'
  rw [← smul_sum, ← sum_apply _ _ fun y => l y • toFun G F y, ←
    sum_apply _ _ fun y => l y • toFun G F y]
  rw [hla, toFun_apply, toFun_apply, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel_left]

statement:
theorem eval₂ :
    Polynomial.eval₂ (Subring.subtype <| (FixedPoints.subfield G F).toSubring) x (minpoly G F x) =

name: eval

name: ne_one
statement: theorem ne_one : minpoly G F x ≠ (1 : Polynomial (FixedPoints.subfield G F))
proof:
:= fun H =>
  have := eval₂ G F x
  (one_ne_zero : (1 : F) ≠ 0) <| by rwa [H, Polynomial.eval₂_one] at this

name: of_eval
statement:
theorem of_eval₂ (f : Polynomial (FixedPoints.subfield G F))
    (hf : Polynomial.eval₂ (Subfield.subtype <| FixedPoints.subfield G F) x f = 0) :
    minpoly G F x ∣ f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Polynomial.map_dvd_map' (Subfield.subtype <| FixedPoints.subfield G F), minpoly,
    ← Subfield.toSubring_subtype_eq_subtype, Polynomial.map_toSubring _ _, prodXSubSMul]
  refine
    Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
      (Polynomial.pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C <| MulAction.injective_ofQuotientStabilizer G x) fun y =>
      QuotientGroup.induction_on y fun g => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot, Polynomial.IsRoot.def, MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer_mk,
    Polynomial.eval_smul',
    ← IsInvariantSubring.coe_subtypeHom' G (FixedPoints.subfield G F).toSubring,
    ← MulSemiringActionHom.coe_polynomial, ← map_smul, smul_polynomial,
    MulSemiringActionHom.coe_polynomial, IsInvariantSubring.coe_subtypeHom',
    Polynomial.eval_map, Subfield.toSubring_subtype_eq_subtype, hf, smul_zero]

name: irreducible_aux
statement:
theorem irreducible_aux (f g : Polynomial (FixedPoints.subfield G F)) (hf : f.Monic) (hg : g.Monic)
    (hfg : f * g = minpoly G F x) : f = 1 ∨ g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf2 : f ∣ minpoly G F x := by rw [← hfg]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _
  have hg2 : g ∣ minpoly G F x := by rw [← hfg]; exact dvd_mul_left _ _
  have := eval₂ G F x
  rw [← hfg, Polynomial.eval₂_mul, mul_eq_zero] at this
  rcases this with this | this
  · right
    have hf3 : f = minpoly G F x :=
      Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated hf (monic G F x)
        (associated_of_dvd_dvd hf2 <| @of_eval₂ G _ F _ _ _ x f this)
    rwa [← mul_one (minpoly G F x), hf3, mul_right_inj' (monic G F x).ne_zero] at hfg
  · left
    have hg3 : g = minpoly G F x :=
      Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated hg (monic G F x)
        (associated_of_dvd_dvd hg2 <| @of_eval₂ G _ F _ _ _ x g this)
    rwa [← one_mul (minpoly G F x), hg3, mul_left_inj' (monic G F x).ne_zero] at hfg

name: irreducible
statement: theorem irreducible : Irreducible (minpoly G F x)
proof:
:=
  (Polynomial.irreducible_of_monic (monic G F x) (ne_one G F x)).2 (irreducible_aux G F x)

theorem linearIndependent_toLinearMap (R : Type u) (A : Type v) (B : Type w) [CommSemiring R]

name: finrank_eq_card
statement:
@[stacks 09I3 "second part"]
theorem finrank_eq_card [Fintype G] [FaithfulSMul G F] :
    finrank (FixedPoints.subfield G F) F = Fintype.card G
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (FixedPoints.finrank_le_card G F) <|
    calc
      Fintype.card G ≤ Fintype.card (F →ₐ[FixedPoints.subfield G F] F) :=
        Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ (MulSemiringAction.toAlgHom_injective _ F)
      _ ≤ finrank F (F →ₗ[FixedPoints.subfield G F] F) := finrank_algHom (subfield G F) F
      _ = finrank (FixedPoints.subfield G F) F := finrank_linearMap_self _ _ _

name: toAlgHom_bijective
statement:
theorem toAlgHom_bijective [Finite G] [FaithfulSMul G F] :
    Function.Bijective (MulSemiringAction.toAlgHom _ _ : G → F →ₐ[subfield G F] F)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype G
  rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
  constructor
  · exact MulSemiringAction.toAlgHom_injective _ F
  · apply le_antisymm
    · exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ (MulSemiringAction.toAlgHom_injective _ F)
    · rw [← finrank_eq_card G F]
      exact LE.le.trans_eq (finrank_algHom _ F) (finrank_linearMap_self _ _ _)

name: toAlgAut_bijective
statement:
theorem toAlgAut_bijective [Finite G] [FaithfulSMul G F] :
    Function.Bijective (MulSemiringAction.toAlgAut G (FixedPoints.subfield G F) F)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ h ↦ (FixedPoints.toAlgHom_bijective G F).injective ?_,
    fun f ↦ ((FixedPoints.toAlgHom_bijective G F).surjective f).imp (fun _ h ↦ ?_)⟩ <;>
      rwa [DFunLike.ext_iff] at h ⊢

name: toAlgAut_surjective
statement:
theorem toAlgAut_surjective [Finite G] :
    Function.Surjective (MulSemiringAction.toAlgAut G (FixedPoints.subfield G F) F)
proof:
:= by
  let f : G →* F ≃ₐ[FixedPoints.subfield G F] F :=
    MulSemiringAction.toAlgAut G (FixedPoints.subfield G F) F
  let Q := G ⧸ f.ker
  let _ : MulSemiringAction Q F := MulSemiringAction.compHom _ (QuotientGroup.kerLift f)
  have : FaithfulSMul Q F := ⟨fun {q₁ q₂} ↦ by
    induction q₁, q₂ using Quotient.inductionOn₂ with | _ g₁ g₂
    intro h
    rwa [QuotientGroup.eq, MonoidHom.mem_ker, map_mul, map_inv, inv_mul_eq_one, AlgEquiv.ext_iff]⟩
  intro f
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (toAlgAut_bijective Q F).surjective
    (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := f) (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ f.commutes' ⟨x, fun g ↦ hx g⟩))
  revert hq
  refine QuotientGroup.induction_on q (fun g hg ↦ ⟨g, ?_⟩)
  rwa [AlgEquiv.ext_iff] at hg ⊢

name: add_aux_left
proof:

  match x1, x2, H with
  | _, _, R.intro n x =>
    Quot.sound <| by
      rw [← iterate_succ_apply, iterate_succ_apply', iterate_succ_apply', ← map_add,
        Nat.succ_add]
      apply R.intro

name: add_aux_right
proof:
:=
  match y1, y2, H with
  | _, _, R.intro n y =>
    Quot.sound <| by
      rw [← iterate_succ_apply, iterate_succ_apply', iterate_succ_apply', ← map_add]
      apply R.intro

name: mk_add_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_add_mk (x y : ℕ × K) :
    mk K p x + mk K p y =
      mk K p (x.1 + y.1, (frobenius K p)^[y.1] x.2 + (frobenius K p)^[x.1] y.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: neg_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_mk (x : ℕ × K) : -mk K p x = mk K p (x.1, -x.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: zero_def
statement: theorem zero_def : (0 : PerfectClosure K p) = mk K p (0, 0)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero : mk K p 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mk_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero_right (n : ℕ) : mk K p (n, 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← ih]
    apply (Quot.sound _).symm
    have := R.intro (p := p) n (0 : K)
    rwa [map_zero] at this

name: R.sound
statement:
theorem R.sound (m n : ℕ) (x y : K) (H : (frobenius K p)^[m] x = y) :
    mk K p (n, x) = mk K p (m + n, y)
proof:
:= by
  subst H
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add, iterate_zero_apply]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [ih, Nat.succ_add, iterate_succ']
    apply Quot.sound
    apply R.intro

name: mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_iff (x y : ℕ × K) :
    mk K p x = mk K p y ↔ ∃ z, (frobenius K p)^[y.1 + z] x.2 = (frobenius K p)^[x.1 + z] y.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    replace H := Quot.eqvGen_exact H
    induction H with
    | rel x y H => obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := H; exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | refl H => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | symm x y H ih => obtain ⟨w, ih⟩ := ih; exact ⟨w, ih.symm⟩
    | trans x y z H1 H2 ih1 ih2 =>
      obtain ⟨z1, ih1⟩ := ih1
      obtain ⟨z2, ih2⟩ := ih2
      exists z2 + (y.1 + z1)
      rw [← add_assoc, iterate_add_apply, ih1]
      rw [← iterate_add_apply, add_comm, iterate_add_apply, ih2]
      rw [← iterate_add_apply]
      simp only [add_comm, add_left_comm]
  intro H
  obtain ⟨m, x⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨n, y⟩ := y
  obtain ⟨z, H⟩ := H; dsimp only at H
  rw [R.sound K p (n + z) m x _ rfl, R.sound K p (m + z) n y _ rfl, H]
  rw [add_assoc, add_comm, add_comm z]

name: mk_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_pow (x : ℕ × K) (n : ℕ) : mk K p x ^ n = mk K p (x.1, x.2 ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, one_def, mk_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨0, by simp_rw [← coe_iterateFrobenius, map_one]⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ih, mk_mul_mk, mk_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨0, by simp_rw [iterate_frobenius, add_zero, mul_pow, ← pow_mul,
      ← pow_add, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]⟩

name: natCast
statement: theorem natCast (n x : ℕ) : (x : PerfectClosure K p) = mk K p (n, x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    induction x with
    | zero => simp
    | succ x ih => simp [Nat.cast_succ, ih, one_def]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ih]; apply Quot.sound
    suffices R K p (n, (x : K)) (Nat.succ n, frobenius K p (x : K)) by
      rwa [map_natCast] at this
    apply R.intro

name: intCast
statement: theorem intCast (x : ℤ) : (x : PerfectClosure K p) = mk K p (0, x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> simp [natCast K p 0]

name: natCast_eq_iff
statement: theorem natCast_eq_iff (x y : ℕ) : (x : PerfectClosure K p) = y ↔ (x : K) = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro H
  · rw [natCast K p 0, natCast K p 0, mk_eq_iff] at H
    obtain ⟨z, H⟩ := H
    simpa only [zero_add, iterate_fixed (map_natCast _ _)] using H
  rw [natCast K p 0, natCast K p 0, H]

name: frobenius_mk
statement:
theorem frobenius_mk (x : ℕ × K) :
    (frobenius (PerfectClosure K p) p : PerfectClosure K p → PerfectClosure K p) (mk K p x) =
      mk _ _ (x.1, x.2 ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobenius_def]
  exact mk_pow K p x p

name: of_apply
statement: theorem of_apply (x : K) : of K p x = mk _ _ (0, x)

name: iterate_frobenius_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_frobenius_mk (n : ℕ) (x : K) :
    (frobenius (PerfectClosure K p) p)^[n] (mk K p ⟨n, x⟩) = of K p x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [iterate_succ_apply, ← ih, frobenius_mk, mk_succ_pow]

name: eq_iff
statement:
theorem eq_iff [CommRing K] [IsReduced K] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] (x y : ℕ × K) :
    mk K p x = mk K p y ↔ (frobenius K p)^[y.1] x.2 = (frobenius K p)^[x.1] y.2
proof:
:=
  (mk_eq_iff K p x y).trans
    ⟨fun ⟨z, H⟩ => (frobenius_inj K p).iterate z <| by simpa only [add_comm, iterate_add] using! H,
      fun H => ⟨0, H⟩⟩

name: iff_rank_lt_aleph0
statement: theorem iff_rank_lt_aleph0 : IsNoetherian K V ↔ Module.rank K V < ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  let b := Basis.ofVectorSpace K V
  rw [← b.mk_eq_rank'', lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite]
  constructor
  · intro
    exact (Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex.linearIndependent K V).set_finite_of_isNoetherian
  · intro hbfinite
    refine
      @isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv K K (⊤ : Submodule K V) V _ _ _ _ _ _ (RingHom.id K) _ _ _
        (LinearEquiv.ofTop _ rfl) (id ?_)
    refine isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian _ ⟨Set.Finite.toFinset hbfinite, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, ← b.span_eq, Basis.coe_ofVectorSpace, Subtype.range_coe]

name: logDeriv_pow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma logDeriv_pow (n : ℕ) (a : R) : logDeriv (a ^ n) = n * logDeriv a

  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n h2 =>
    obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne a 0

name: logDeriv_eq_zero

name: logDeriv_multisetProd
statement:
lemma logDeriv_multisetProd {ι : Type*} (s : Multiset ι) {f : ι → R} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0) :
    logDeriv (s.map f).prod = (s.map fun x ↦ logDeriv (f x)).sum

:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on
  · simp
  · rename_i h₂
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]

    · apply logDeriv_mul
      · simp [h]
      · simp_all
    · simp_all

name: differentialAlgebraFiniteDimensional
statement:
lemma differentialAlgebraFiniteDimensional [FiniteDimensional F K] :
    letI
proof:
:= differentialFiniteDimensional F K
    DifferentialAlgebra F K := by
  let k := (Field.exists_primitive_element F K).choose
  have h : F⟮k⟯ = ⊤ := (Field.exists_primitive_element F K).choose_spec
  have : Fact (minpoly F k).Monic := ⟨minpoly.monic (IsAlgebraic.of_finite ..).isIntegral⟩

name: IsLiouville.trans
statement:
lemma IsLiouville.trans {A : Type*} [Field A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra F A]
    [Differential A] [IsScalarTower F K A] [Differential.ContainConstants F K]
    (inst1 : IsLiouville F K) (inst2 : IsLiouville K A) : IsLiouville F A where
  isLiouville (a : F) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (c : ι → F) (hc : ∀ x, (c x)′ = 0)
      (u : ι → A) (v : A) (h : a = ∑ x, c x * logDeriv (u x) + v′)
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨ι₀, _, c₀, hc₀, u₀, v₀, h₀⟩ := inst2.isLiouville (a : K) ι
        ((↑) ∘ c)
        (fun _ ↦ by simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← coe_deriv, coe_eq_zero_iff, hc])
        ((↑) ∘ u) v (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply])
    have hc (x : ι₀) := mem_range_of_deriv_eq_zero F (hc₀ x)
    choose c₀ hc using hc
    apply inst1.isLiouville a ι₀ c₀ _ u₀ v₀
    · rw [h₀]
      simp [hc]
    · intro
      apply_fun ((↑) : F → K)
      · simp only [coe_deriv, hc, algebraMap.coe_zero]
        apply hc₀
      · apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective

name: IsLiouville.equiv
statement:
lemma IsLiouville.equiv {K' : Type*} [Field K'] [Differential K'] [Algebra F K']
    [DifferentialAlgebra F K'] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K']
    [inst : IsLiouville F K] (e : K ≃ₐ[F] K') : IsLiouville F K' where
  isLiouville (a : F) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (c : ι → F) (hc : ∀ x, (c x)′ = 0)
      (u : ι → K') (v : K') (h : a = ∑ x, c x * logDeriv (u x) + v′)
proof:
:= by
    apply inst.isLiouville a ι c hc (e.symm ∘ u) (e.symm v)
    apply_fun e.symm at h
    simpa [AlgEquiv.commutes, map_add, map_sum, map_mul, logDeriv, algEquiv_deriv'] using h

name: LinearIndependent.map_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.map_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable [IsPurelyInseparable F E]
    {ι : Type*} {v : ι → K} (hsep : ∀ i : ι, IsSeparable F (v i))
    (h : LinearIndependent F v) : LinearIndependent E v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, _⟩ := ExpChar.exists F
  have := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F K).injective q
  refine linearIndependent_iff.mpr fun l hl ↦ Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ ?_
  choose f hf using fun i ↦ (isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem F q).1 ‹_› (l i)
  let n := l.support.sup f
  have := (expChar_pow_pos F q n).ne'
  replace hf (i : ι) : l i ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range := by
    by_cases hs : i ∈ l.support
    · convert! pow_mem (hf i) (q ^ (n - f i)) using 1
      rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (Finset.le_sup hs)]
    exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hs, zero_pow this]⟩
  choose lF hlF using hf
  let lF₀ := Finsupp.onFinset l.support lF fun i ↦ by
    contrapose
    refine fun hs ↦ (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp (algebraMap F E).injective _ ?_
    rw [hlF, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hs, zero_pow this]
  replace h := linearIndependent_iff.1 (h.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable' q n hsep :) lF₀ <| by
    replace hl := congr($hl ^ q ^ n)
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, sum_pow_char_pow, zero_pow this] at hl
    rw [← hl, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
      Finsupp.onFinset_sum _ (fun _ ↦ by exact zero_smul _ _)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    simp_rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E K, hlF, map_pow]
  refine eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero ((hlF _).symm.trans ?_)
  convert! map_zero (algebraMap F E)
  exact congr($h i)

name: IntermediateField.linearDisjoint_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.linearDisjoint_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable
    [IsPurelyInseparable F E] (S : IntermediateField F K) [Algebra.IsSeparable F S] :
    S.LinearDisjoint E
proof:
:=
  have ⟨ι, ⟨b⟩⟩ := Module.Basis.exists_basis F S
  .of_basis_left b <| b.linearIndependent.map' S.val.toLinearMap
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot_of_injective S.val.injective)
    |>.map_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable E fun i ↦ by
      simpa only [IsSeparable, minpoly_eq] using! Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable F (b i)

name: rank_mul_insepDegree_of_isPurelyInseparable
statement:
lemma rank_mul_insepDegree_of_isPurelyInseparable (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra F K]

theorem lift_sepDegree_mul_lift_sepDegree_of_isAlgebraic [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :

name: sepDegree_mul_sepDegree_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
@[stacks 09HK "Part 1"]
theorem sepDegree_mul_sepDegree_of_isAlgebraic (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    sepDegree F E * sepDegree E K = sepDegree F K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Cardinal.lift_id] using lift_sepDegree_mul_lift_sepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F E K

name: lift_insepDegree_mul_lift_insepDegree_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem lift_insepDegree_mul_lift_insepDegree_of_isAlgebraic [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    Cardinal.lift.{w} (insepDegree F E) * Cardinal.lift.{v} (insepDegree E K) =
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (insepDegree F K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := lift_rank_mul_lift_insepDegree_of_isPurelyInseparable (separableClosure F E) E K
  rwa [← insepDegree_eq_of_isSeparable F (separableClosure F E) K] at h

name: insepDegree_mul_insepDegree_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
@[stacks 09HK "Part 2"]
theorem insepDegree_mul_insepDegree_of_isAlgebraic (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    insepDegree F E * insepDegree E K = insepDegree F K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Cardinal.lift_id] using lift_insepDegree_mul_lift_insepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F E K

name: finInsepDegree_mul_finInsepDegree_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
@[stacks 09HK "Part 2, `finInsepDegree` variant"]
theorem finInsepDegree_mul_finInsepDegree_of_isAlgebraic [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    finInsepDegree F E * finInsepDegree E K = finInsepDegree F K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul, Cardinal.toNat_lift] using!
    congr(Cardinal.toNat $(lift_insepDegree_mul_lift_insepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F E K))

name: IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable
    (S : Set K) [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F (adjoin F S)] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    sepDegree E (adjoin E S) = sepDegree F (adjoin F S)
proof:
:= by
  set M := adjoin F S
  set L := adjoin E S
  let E' := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K).fieldRange
  let j : E ≃ₐ[F] E' := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K)
  have hi : M ≤ L.restrictScalars F := by
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv (E := K) j rfl, restrictScalars_adjoin]
    exact adjoin.mono _ _ _ Set.subset_union_right
  let i : M →+* L := Subsemiring.inclusion hi
  let : Algebra M L := i.toAlgebra
  let : SMul M L := Algebra.toSMul
  have : IsScalarTower F M L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (congrFun rfl)
  have : IsPurelyInseparable M L := by
    change IsPurelyInseparable M (extendScalars hi)
    obtain ⟨q, _⟩ := ExpChar.exists F
    have : extendScalars hi = adjoin M (E' : Set K) := restrictScalars_injective F <| by
      conv_lhs => rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv
        (E := K) j rfl, ← adjoin_self F E', adjoin_adjoin_comm]
    rw [this, isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_iff_pow_mem _ _ q]
    rintro x ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem F q y
    refine ⟨n, algebraMap F M z, ?_⟩
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E K, hz, ← hy, map_pow,
      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom]
  have h := lift_sepDegree_mul_lift_sepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F E L
  rw [IsPurelyInseparable.sepDegree_eq_one F E, Cardinal.lift_one, one_mul] at h
  rw [Cardinal.lift_injective h, ← sepDegree_mul_sepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F M L,
    IsPurelyInseparable.sepDegree_eq_one M L, mul_one]

name: IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable'
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable'
    (S : IntermediateField F K) [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F S] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    sepDegree E (adjoin E (S : Set K)) = sepDegree F S
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F (adjoin F (S : Set K)) := by rwa [adjoin_self]
  have := sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable (F := F) E (S : Set K)
  rwa [adjoin_self] at this

name: minpoly.map_eq_of_isSeparable_of_isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem minpoly.map_eq_of_isSeparable_of_isPurelyInseparable (x : K)
    (hsep : IsSeparable F x) [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    (minpoly F x).map (algebraMap F E) = minpoly E x
proof:
:= by
  have hi := IsSeparable.isIntegral hsep
  have hi' : IsIntegral E x := IsIntegral.tower_top hi
  refine eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (monic hi') ((monic hi).map (algebraMap F E))
    (dvd_map_of_isScalarTower F E x) (le_of_eq ?_)
  have hsep' := IsSeparable.tower_top E hsep
  have := (isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable _ _).2 hsep
  have := (isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable _ _).2 hsep'
  have := Algebra.IsSeparable.isAlgebraic F F⟮x⟯
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map, ← adjoin.finrank hi, ← adjoin.finrank hi',
    ← finSepDegree_eq_finrank_of_isSeparable F _, ← finSepDegree_eq_finrank_of_isSeparable E _,
    finSepDegree_eq, finSepDegree_eq,
    sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable (F := F) E]

name: Polynomial.Separable.map_irreducible_of_isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem Polynomial.Separable.map_irreducible_of_isPurelyInseparable {f : F[X]} (hsep : f.Separable)
    (hirr : Irreducible f) [IsPurelyInseparable F E] : Irreducible (f.map (algebraMap F E))
proof:
:= by
  let K := AlgebraicClosure E
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_aeval_eq_zero K f
    (natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.1 hirr.natDegree_pos).ne'
  have ha : Associated f (minpoly F x) := by
    have := isUnit_C.2 (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hirr.ne_zero).isUnit.inv
    exact ⟨this.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, minpoly.eq_of_irreducible hirr hx]⟩
  have ha' : Associated (f.map (algebraMap F E)) ((minpoly F x).map (algebraMap F E)) :=
    ha.map (mapRingHom (algebraMap F E)).toMonoidHom
  have heq := minpoly.map_eq_of_isSeparable_of_isPurelyInseparable E x (ha.separable hsep)
  rw [ha'.irreducible_iff, heq]
  exact minpoly.irreducible (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)

name: IsPurelyInseparable.isIntegral'
statement: theorem IsPurelyInseparable.isIntegral' [IsPurelyInseparable F E] (x : E) : IsIntegral F x

:=
  Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _

name: IsPurelyInseparable.isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.isAlgebraic [Nontrivial F] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E
proof: := inferInstance

name: IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    ∀ x : E, IsSeparable F x → x ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof:
:=
  IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable'

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff : IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ ∀ x : E,
    IsIntegral F x ∧ (IsSeparable F x → x ∈ (algebraMap F E).range)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h x ↦ ⟨h.isIntegral' _ x, h.inseparable' x⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨⟨fun x ↦ (h x).1⟩, fun x ↦ (h x).2⟩⟩

name: AlgEquiv.isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem AlgEquiv.isPurelyInseparable (e : K ≃ₐ[F] E) [IsPurelyInseparable F K] :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨fun _ ↦ by rw [← isIntegral_algEquiv e.symm]; exact IsPurelyInseparable.isIntegral' F _⟩,
    fun x h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [IsSeparable, ← minpoly.algEquiv_eq e.symm] at h
  simpa only [RingHom.mem_range, algebraMap_eq_apply] using IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable F _ h

name: AlgEquiv.isPurelyInseparable_iff
statement:
theorem AlgEquiv.isPurelyInseparable_iff (e : K ≃ₐ[F] E) :
    IsPurelyInseparable F K ↔ IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ e.isPurelyInseparable, fun _ ↦ e.symm.isPurelyInseparable⟩

name: IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable
    [IsPurelyInseparable F E] [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] : Function.Surjective (algebraMap F E)
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable F x (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable F x)

name: IsPurelyInseparable.bijective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.bijective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable
    [Nontrivial E] [IsDomain F] [IsTorsionFree F E]
    [IsPurelyInseparable F E] [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] : Function.Bijective (algebraMap F E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective F E, surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable F E⟩

name: Subalgebra.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable (L : Subalgebra F E)
    [IsPurelyInseparable F L] [Algebra.IsSeparable F L] : L = ⊥
proof:
:= bot_unique fun x hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable F L ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨y, congr_arg (Subalgebra.val _) hy⟩

name: IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable
    {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] (L : IntermediateField F E)
    [IsPurelyInseparable F L] [Algebra.IsSeparable F L] : L = ⊥
proof:
:= bot_unique fun x hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable F L ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨y, congr_arg (algebraMap L E) hy⟩

name: separableClosure.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem separableClosure.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable
    (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    separableClosure F E = ⊥
proof:
:=
  bot_unique fun x h ↦ IsPurelyInseparable.inseparable F x (mem_separableClosure_iff.1 h)

name: separableClosure.eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem separableClosure.eq_bot_iff
    {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    separableClosure F E = ⊥ ↔ IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ isPurelyInseparable_iff.2 fun x ↦ ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x, fun hs ↦ by
    simpa only [h] using! mem_separableClosure_iff.2 hs⟩, fun _ ↦ eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable F E⟩

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem
statement:
@[stacks 09HE]
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ ∀ x : E, ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h x ↦ ?_, fun h x ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, h1, n, h2⟩ := (minpoly.irreducible (h x).1).hasSeparableContraction q
    exact ⟨n, (h _).2 <| h1.of_dvd <| minpoly.dvd F _ <| by
      simpa only [expand_aeval, minpoly.aeval] using congr_arg (aeval x) h2⟩
  have hdeg := (minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_pow_mem q).2 (h x)
  have halg : IsIntegral F x := by_contra fun h' ↦ by
    simp only [minpoly.eq_zero h', natSepDegree_zero, zero_ne_one] at hdeg
  refine ⟨halg, fun hsep ↦ ?_⟩
  rwa [hsep.natSepDegree_eq_natDegree, minpoly.natDegree_eq_one_iff] at hdeg

name: IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof:
:=
  (isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem F q).1 ‹_› x

name: IsPurelyInseparable.tower_bot
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.tower_bot [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    [IsPurelyInseparable F K] : IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨fun x ↦ (isIntegral' F (algebraMap E K x)).tower_bot_of_field⟩, fun x h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [IsSeparable, ← minpoly.algebraMap_eq (algebraMap E K).injective] at h
  obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := inseparable F _ h
  exact ⟨y, (algebraMap E K).injective (h.symm ▸ (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E K y).symm)⟩

name: IsPurelyInseparable.tower_top
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.tower_top [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    [h : IsPurelyInseparable F K] : IsPurelyInseparable E K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, _⟩ := ExpChar.exists F
  have := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F E).injective q
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem _ q] at h ⊢
  intro x
  obtain ⟨n, y, h⟩ := h x
  exact ⟨n, (algebraMap F E) y, h.symm ▸ (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E K y).symm⟩

name: IsPurelyInseparable.trans
statement:
@[stacks 02JJ "See also 00GM"]
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.trans [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    [h1 : IsPurelyInseparable F E] [h2 : IsPurelyInseparable E K] : IsPurelyInseparable F K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, _⟩ := ExpChar.exists F
  have := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F E).injective q
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem _ q] at h1 h2 ⊢
  intro x
  obtain ⟨n, y, h2⟩ := h2 x
  obtain ⟨m, z, h1⟩ := h1 y
  refine ⟨n + m, z, ?_⟩
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E K, h1, map_pow, h2, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ ∀ x : E, (minpoly F x).natSepDegree = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, _⟩ := ExpChar.exists F
  simp_rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem F q, minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_pow_mem q]

name: IsPurelyInseparable.natSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.natSepDegree_eq_one [IsPurelyInseparable F E] (x : E) :
    (minpoly F x).natSepDegree = 1
proof:

  (isPurelyInseparable_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one F).1 ‹_› x

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C (q : ℕ) [hF : ExpChar F q] :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ ∀ x : E, ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : F), minpoly F x = X ^ q ^ n - C y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one,
    minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_eq_X_pow_sub_C q]

name: IsPurelyInseparable.minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] [IsPurelyInseparable F E]
    (x : E) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : F), minpoly F x = X ^ q ^ n - C y
proof:
:=
  (isPurelyInseparable_iff_minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C F q).1 ‹_› x

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_minpoly_eq_X_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_minpoly_eq_X_sub_C_pow (q : ℕ) [hF : ExpChar F q] :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔
    ∀ x : E, ∃ n : ℕ, (minpoly F x).map (algebraMap F E) = (X - C x) ^ q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one,
    minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_eq_X_sub_C_pow q]

name: IsPurelyInseparable.minpoly_eq_X_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.minpoly_eq_X_sub_C_pow (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] [IsPurelyInseparable F E]
    (x : E) : ∃ n : ℕ, (minpoly F x).map (algebraMap F E) = (X - C x) ^ q ^ n
proof:
:=
  (isPurelyInseparable_iff_minpoly_eq_X_sub_C_pow F q).1 ‹_› x

name: IsPurelyInseparable.finrank_eq_pow
statement:
lemma IsPurelyInseparable.finrank_eq_pow
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] [IsPurelyInseparable F E] [FiniteDimensional F E] :
    ∃ n, finrank F E = q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ (F E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q]
      [IsPurelyInseparable F E] [FiniteDimensional F E], ∃ n, finrank F E = q ^ n by
    simpa using this (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) E q
  intro F E _ _ _ q _ _ _
  generalize hd : finrank F E = d
  induction d using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing F with
  | ind d IH =>
    by_cases h : (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = ⊤
    · rw [← finrank_top', ← h, IntermediateField.finrank_bot] at hd
      exact ⟨0, ((pow_zero q).trans hd).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne bot_le h :)
    obtain ⟨m, y, e⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C F q x
    have : finrank F F⟮x⟯ = q ^ m := by
      rw [adjoin.finrank (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x), e, natDegree_sub_C, natDegree_X_pow]
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IH _ (by
      rw [← hd, ← finrank_mul_finrank F F⟮x⟯, Nat.lt_mul_iff_one_lt_left finrank_pos, this]
      by_contra! H
      refine hx (finrank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff.mp (le_antisymm (this ▸ H) ?_))
      exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr Module.finrank_pos.ne') (F⟮x⟯) rfl
    exact ⟨m + n, by rw [← hd, ← finrank_mul_finrank F F⟮x⟯, hn, pow_add, this]⟩

name: isPurelyInseparable_of_finSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_of_finSepDegree_eq_one
    (hdeg : finSepDegree F E = 1) : IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E
  · rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff]
    refine fun x ↦ ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x, fun hsep ↦ ?_⟩
    have := finSepDegree_mul_finSepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F F⟮x⟯ E
    rw [hdeg, mul_eq_one, (finSepDegree_adjoin_simple_eq_finrank_iff F E x
        (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x)).2 hsep,
      IntermediateField.finrank_eq_one_iff] at this
    simpa only [this.1] using! mem_adjoin_simple_self F x
  · rw [← Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic] at H
    simp [finSepDegree_eq_zero_of_transcendental F E] at hdeg

name: injective_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem injective_comp_algebraMap [CommRing L] [IsReduced L] :
    Function.Injective fun f : E →+* L ↦ f.comp (algebraMap F E)
proof:
:= fun f g heq ↦ by
  ext x
  let q := ringExpChar F
  obtain ⟨n, y, h⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem F q x
  replace heq := congr($heq y)
  simp_rw [RingHom.comp_apply, h, map_pow] at heq
  nontriviality L
  have := expChar_of_injective_ringHom (f.comp (algebraMap F E)).injective q
  exact iterateFrobenius_inj L q n heq

name: injective_restrictDomain
statement:
theorem injective_restrictDomain [CommRing L] [IsReduced L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R F E] :
    Function.Injective (AlgHom.domRestrict (A := R) F (C := E) (D := L))
proof:
:= fun _ _ eq ↦
  AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective <| injective_comp_algebraMap F E L <| congr_arg AlgHom.toRingHom eq

name: bijective_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem bijective_comp_algebraMap [Field L] [PerfectField L] :
    Function.Bijective fun f : E →+* L ↦ f.comp (algebraMap F E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨injective_comp_algebraMap F E L, fun g ↦ let _ := g.toAlgebra
    ⟨_, (Classical.arbitrary <| E →ₐ[F] L).comp_algebraMap⟩⟩

name: bijective_restrictDomain
statement:
theorem bijective_restrictDomain [Field L] [PerfectField L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R F E] :
    Function.Bijective (AlgHom.domRestrict (A := R) F (C := E) (D := L))
proof:
:=
  ⟨injective_restrictDomain F E R L, fun g ↦ let _ := g.toAlgebra
    let f := Classical.arbitrary (E →ₐ[F] L)
    ⟨f.restrictScalars R, AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective f.comp_algebraMap⟩⟩

name: IsPurelyInseparable.finSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.finSepDegree_eq_one [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    finSepDegree F E = 1
proof: := Nat.card_unique

name: IsPurelyInseparable.sepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.sepDegree_eq_one [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    sepDegree F E = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sepDegree, separableClosure.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable, IntermediateField.rank_bot]

name: IsPurelyInseparable.insepDegree_eq
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.insepDegree_eq [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    insepDegree F E = Module.rank F E
proof:
:= by
  rw [insepDegree, separableClosure.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable, rank_bot']

name: IsPurelyInseparable.finInsepDegree_eq
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.finInsepDegree_eq [IsPurelyInseparable F E] :
    finInsepDegree F E = finrank F E
proof: := congr(Cardinal.toNat $(insepDegree_eq F E))

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_finSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_finSepDegree_eq_one :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ finSepDegree F E = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ IsPurelyInseparable.finSepDegree_eq_one F E,
    fun h ↦ isPurelyInseparable_of_finSepDegree_eq_one h⟩

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_subsingleton_emb
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_subsingleton_emb :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ Subsingleton (Field.Emb F E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_finSepDegree_eq_one, Field.finSepDegree, Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique,
    and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  infer_instance

name: isSeparable_iff_finInsepDegree_eq_one
statement:
lemma isSeparable_iff_finInsepDegree_eq_one :
    Algebra.IsSeparable F K ↔ finInsepDegree F K = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← separableClosure.eq_top_iff, ← IntermediateField.finrank_eq_one_iff_eq_top, finInsepDegree]

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_fd_isPurelyInseparable
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_fd_isPurelyInseparable [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔
    ∀ L : IntermediateField F E, FiniteDimensional F L → IsPurelyInseparable F L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ IsPurelyInseparable.tower_bot F _ E,
    fun h ↦ isPurelyInseparable_iff.2 fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  have hx : IsIntegral F x := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x
  refine ⟨hx, fun _ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := (h _ (adjoin.finiteDimensional hx)).inseparable' _ <|
    show Separable (minpoly F (AdjoinSimple.gen F x)) by rwa [minpoly_eq]
  exact ⟨y, congr_arg (algebraMap _ E) h⟩

name: Field.Emb.cardinal_separableClosure
statement:
theorem Field.Emb.cardinal_separableClosure [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    #(Field.Emb F <| separableClosure F E) = #(Field.Emb F E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (embProdEmbOfIsAlgebraic F (separableClosure F E) E).cardinal_eq,
    mk_prod, mk_eq_one (Emb _ E), lift_one, mul_one, lift_id]

name: finInsepDegree_eq_pow
statement:
lemma finInsepDegree_eq_pow (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] [FiniteDimensional F E] :
    ∃ n, finInsepDegree F E = q ^ n
proof:
:=
  IsPurelyInseparable.finrank_eq_pow ..

name: separableClosure_le
statement:
theorem separableClosure_le (L : IntermediateField F E)
    [h : IsPurelyInseparable L E] : separableClosure F E ≤ L
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h.inseparable' _ <|
    IsSeparable.tower_top L (mem_separableClosure_iff.1 hx)
  exact y.2

name: separableClosure_le_iff
statement:
theorem separableClosure_le_iff [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (L : IntermediateField F E) :
    separableClosure F E ≤ L ↔ IsPurelyInseparable L E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ separableClosure_le F E L⟩
  let := (inclusion h).toAlgebra
  let : SMul (separableClosure F E) L := Algebra.toSMul
  have : IsScalarTower (separableClosure F E) L E := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (congrFun rfl)
  exact IsPurelyInseparable.tower_top (separableClosure F E) L E

name: eq_separableClosure
statement:
theorem eq_separableClosure (L : IntermediateField F E)
    [Algebra.IsSeparable F L] [IsPurelyInseparable L E] : L = separableClosure F E
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_separableClosure F E L) (separableClosure_le F E L)

name: eq_separableClosure_iff
statement:
theorem eq_separableClosure_iff [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (L : IntermediateField F E) :
    L = separableClosure F E ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable F L ∧ IsPurelyInseparable L E
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; exact ⟨isSeparable F E, isPurelyInseparable F E⟩,
   fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ eq_separableClosure F E L⟩

name: IsPurelyInseparable.of_injective_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem IsPurelyInseparable.of_injective_comp_algebraMap (L : Type w) [Field L] [IsAlgClosed L]
    [Nonempty (E →+* L)] (h : Function.Injective fun f : E →+* L ↦ f.comp (algebraMap F E)) :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_finSepDegree_eq_one, finSepDegree, Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique]
  let := (Classical.arbitrary (E →+* L)).toAlgebra
  let j : AlgebraicClosure E →ₐ[E] L := IsAlgClosed.lift
  exact ⟨⟨fun f g ↦ DFunLike.ext' <| j.injective.comp_left (congr_arg (⇑) <|
    @h (j.toRingHom.comp f) (j.toRingHom.comp g) (by ext; simp))⟩, inferInstance⟩

name: isSepClosed_iff_isPurelyInseparable_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem isSepClosed_iff_isPurelyInseparable_algebraicClosure [IsAlgClosure F E] :
    IsSepClosed F ↔ IsPurelyInseparable F E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ inferInstance, fun H ↦ by
    have := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed F (K := E)
    rwa [← separableClosure.eq_bot_iff, IsSepClosed.separableClosure_eq_bot_iff] at H⟩

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSepClosed
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSepClosed [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E]
    [IsSepClosed F] : IsSepClosed E
proof:
:=
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F (AlgebraicClosure E) := .trans F E _
  (isSepClosed_iff_isPurelyInseparable_algebraicClosure E _).mpr
    (IsPurelyInseparable.tower_top F E <| AlgebraicClosure E)

name: finSepDegree_eq
statement:
@[stacks 09HJ "`sepDegree` is defined as the right-hand side of 09HJ"]
theorem finSepDegree_eq [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    finSepDegree F E = Cardinal.toNat (sepDegree F E)
proof:
:= by
  have h := finSepDegree_mul_finSepDegree_of_isAlgebraic F (separableClosure F E) E |>.symm
  rwa [finSepDegree_eq_finrank_of_isSeparable F (separableClosure F E),
    IsPurelyInseparable.finSepDegree_eq_one (separableClosure F E) E, mul_one] at h

name: finSepDegree_mul_finInsepDegree
statement: theorem finSepDegree_mul_finInsepDegree : finSepDegree F E * finInsepDegree F E = finrank F E
proof:
:= by
  by_cases halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E
  · have := congr_arg Cardinal.toNat (sepDegree_mul_insepDegree F E)
    rwa [Cardinal.toNat_mul, ← finSepDegree_eq F E] at this
  rw [finInsepDegree, finrank_of_infinite_dimensional (K := F) (V := E) fun _ ↦
      halg (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite F E),
    finrank_of_infinite_dimensional (K := separableClosure F E) (V := E) fun _ ↦
      halg (.trans _ (separableClosure F E) _),
    mul_zero]

name: adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isSeparable
statement:
lemma adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isSeparable [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable E K] : adjoin E (separableClosure F K : Set K) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique fun x _ ↦ by
    set S := separableClosure F K
    set L := adjoin E (S : Set K)
    have := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable E L K
    let i : S →+* L := Subsemiring.inclusion fun x hx ↦ subset_adjoin E (S : Set K) hx
    let _ : Algebra S L := i.toAlgebra
    have : IsScalarTower S L K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (congrFun rfl)
    have := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans F E K
    have : IsPurelyInseparable S K := separableClosure.isPurelyInseparable F K
    have := IsPurelyInseparable.tower_top S L K
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable L K x
    exact y.2

name: adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    adjoin E (separableClosure F K) = separableClosure E K
proof:
:= by
  set S := separableClosure E K
  have h := congr_arg lift (adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isSeparable (F := F) S)
  rw [lift_top, lift_adjoin] at h
  have : IsScalarTower F S K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (congrFun rfl)
  rw [← h, ← map_eq_of_separableClosure_eq_bot F (separableClosure_eq_bot E K)]
  simp only [S, coe_map, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply]

name: Subalgebra.mem_perfectClosure_iff
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.mem_perfectClosure_iff {x : A} :
    x ∈ perfectClosure R A p ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ p ^ n ∈ (algebraMap R A).rangeS
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: IsPurelyInseparable.exists_pow_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct_of_expChar
statement:
lemma IsPurelyInseparable.exists_pow_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct_of_expChar
    [IsPurelyInseparable k K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar k q] (x : R ⊗[k] K) :
    ∃ n, x ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap R (R ⊗[k] K)).range
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality (R ⊗[k] K)
  obtain (hq | hq) := expChar_is_prime_or_one k q
  induction x with
  | add x y h h' =>
    have : ExpChar (R ⊗[k] K) q := expChar_of_injective_ringHom (algebraMap k _).injective q
    simp_rw [RingHom.mem_range, ← RingHom.mem_rangeS, ← Subalgebra.mem_perfectClosure_iff] at h h' ⊢
    exact add_mem h h'
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem k q y
    use n
    have : (x ^ q ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (y ^ q ^ n) =
        (x ^ q ^ n) ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : K) * (1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] (y ^ q ^ n) := by
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, this]
    refine Subring.mul_mem _ ⟨x ^ q ^ n, rfl⟩ ⟨algebraMap k R a, ?_⟩
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul, ha]
  · subst hq
    have : CharZero k := charZero_of_expChar_one' k
    exact ⟨0, (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_surjective R _ <|
      IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable k K) _⟩

name: IsPurelyInseparable.exists_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct
statement:
lemma IsPurelyInseparable.exists_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct [IsPurelyInseparable k K]
    (x : R ⊗[k] K) : ∃ n > 0, x ^ n ∈ (algebraMap R (R ⊗[k] K)).range
proof:
:= by
  let q := ringExpChar k
  obtain ⟨n, hr⟩ := exists_pow_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct_of_expChar q x
  refine ⟨q ^ n, pow_pos ?_ _, hr⟩
  obtain (hq | hq) := expChar_is_prime_or_one k q <;> simp [hq, Nat.Prime.pos]

name: hasExponent_iff'
statement:
theorem hasExponent_iff' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] :
    HasExponent K L ↔ ∃ e, ∀ (a : L), a ^ p ^ e ∈ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ hasExponent_iff K L

name: exponent_def
statement:
theorem exponent_def [HasExponent K L] (a : L) :
    a ^ ringExpChar K ^ exponent K L ∈ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_spec ‹HasExponent K L›.has_exponent a

name: exponent_def'
statement:
theorem exponent_def' [HasExponent K L] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] (a : L) :
    a ^ p ^ exponent K L ∈ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ exponent_def K a

name: exponent_min
statement:
theorem exponent_min [HasExponent K L] {e : ℕ} (h : e < exponent K L) :
    ∃ a, a ^ ringExpChar K ^ e ∉ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact not_forall.mp <| Nat.find_min ‹HasExponent K L›.has_exponent h

name: exponent_min'
statement:
theorem exponent_min' [HasExponent K L] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] {e : ℕ} (h : e < exponent K L) :
    ∃ a, a ^ p ^ e ∉ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ exponent_min h

name: elemExponent_eq_zero_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem elemExponent_eq_zero_of_mem_range {a : L} (h : a ∈ (algebraMap K L).range) :
    elemExponent K a = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Nat.find_eq_zero _).mpr
  rw [pow_zero, pow_one]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
  exact ⟨y, hy ▸ minpoly.eq_X_sub_C L y⟩

name: elemExponent_eq_zero_of_charZero
statement:
theorem elemExponent_eq_zero_of_charZero (a : L) [CharZero K] :
    elemExponent K a = 0
proof:
:=
  elemExponent_eq_zero_of_mem_range <| surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable K L a

name: minpoly_eq
statement:
theorem minpoly_eq (a : L) :
    minpoly K a = X ^ ringExpChar K ^ elemExponent K a - C (elemReduct K a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Classical.choose_spec <| Nat.find_spec <| minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C K (ringExpChar K) a

name: minpoly_eq'
statement:
theorem minpoly_eq' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] (a : L) :
    minpoly K a = X ^ p ^ elemExponent K a - C (elemReduct K a)
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ minpoly_eq K a

name: minpoly_natDegree_eq
statement:
theorem minpoly_natDegree_eq (a : L) :
    (minpoly K a).natDegree = ringExpChar K ^ elemExponent K a
proof:
:= by
  rw [minpoly_eq K a, natDegree_sub_C, natDegree_pow, natDegree_X, mul_one]

name: minpoly_natDegree_eq'
statement:
theorem minpoly_natDegree_eq' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] (a : L) :
    (minpoly K a).natDegree = p ^ elemExponent K a
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ minpoly_natDegree_eq K a

name: algebraMap_elemReduct_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_elemReduct_eq (a : L) :
    algebraMap K L (elemReduct K a) = a ^ ringExpChar K ^ elemExponent K a
proof:
:= by
  have := minpoly_eq K a ▸ minpoly.aeval K a
  rwa [map_sub, aeval_C, map_pow, aeval_X, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at this

name: algebraMap_elemReduct_eq'
statement:
theorem algebraMap_elemReduct_eq' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] (a : L) :
    algebraMap K L (elemReduct K a) = a ^ p ^ elemExponent K a
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ algebraMap_elemReduct_eq K a

name: elemExponent_def
statement:
theorem elemExponent_def (a : L) :
    a ^ ringExpChar K ^ elemExponent K a ∈ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  RingHom.mem_range.mpr <| ⟨_, algebraMap_elemReduct_eq K a⟩

name: elemExponent_def'
statement:
theorem elemExponent_def' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] (a : L) :
    a ^ p ^ elemExponent K a ∈ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ elemExponent_def K a

name: elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem
statement:
theorem elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem {a : L} {n : ℕ}
    (h : a ^ ringExpChar K ^ n ∈ (algebraMap K L).range) : elemExponent K a ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨p, _⟩ := ExpChar.exists K
  rcases ‹ExpChar K p› with _ | ⟨hp⟩
  · exact elemExponent_eq_zero_of_charZero K a ▸ Nat.zero_le _
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.mp <| h
    let f := X ^ ringExpChar K ^ n - C y
    have hf₁ : f.aeval a = 0 := by rwa [map_sub, aeval_C, aeval_X_pow, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]
    have hf₂ : f.Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C y <| Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp <| expChar_pow_pos K _ _
    have hf₃ : f.natDegree = ringExpChar K ^ n := by
      rw [natDegree_sub_C, natDegree_pow, natDegree_X, mul_one]
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right <| Nat.Prime.one_lt hp).mp <|
      ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ hf₃ ▸ minpoly_natDegree_eq K a ▸
      natDegree_le_natDegree (minpoly.min K a hf₂ hf₁)

name: elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem'
statement:
theorem elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] {a : L} {n : ℕ}
    (h : a ^ p ^ n ∈ (algebraMap K L).range) : elemExponent K a ≤ n
proof:
:=
  elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem (ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ h)

name: elemExponent_min
statement:
theorem elemExponent_min {a : L} {n : ℕ} (h : n < elemExponent K a) :
    a ^ ringExpChar K ^ n ∉ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  fun hn ↦ (Nat.not_lt_of_ge <| elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem hn) h

name: elemExponent_min'
statement:
theorem elemExponent_min' (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p] {a : L} {n : ℕ} (h : n < elemExponent K a) :
    a ^ p ^ n ∉ (algebraMap K L).range
proof:
:=
  ringExpChar.eq K p ▸ elemExponent_min h

name: elemExponent_le_exponent
statement:
theorem elemExponent_le_exponent [HasExponent K L] (a : L) :
    elemExponent K a ≤ exponent K L
proof:
:=
  elemExponent_le_of_pow_mem <| exponent_def K a

name: algebraMap_iterateFrobeniusAux
statement:
private theorem algebraMap_iterateFrobeniusAux {n : ℕ} (hn : exponent K L ≤ n) (a : L) :
    algebraMap K L (iterateFrobeniusAux K L p n a) = a ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [iterateFrobeniusAux, map_pow, algebraMap_elemReduct_eq' K p, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel' <| (elemExponent_le_exponent K a).trans hn]

name: algebraMap_iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem algebraMap_iterateFrobenius {n : ℕ} (hn : exponent K L ≤ n) (a : L) :
    algebraMap K L (iterateFrobenius K L p hn a) = a ^ p ^ n
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_iterateFrobeniusAux K p hn a

name: iterateFrobenius_algebraMap
statement:
theorem iterateFrobenius_algebraMap {n : ℕ} (hn : exponent K L ≤ n) (a : K) :
    iterateFrobenius K L p hn (algebraMap K L a) = a ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  apply (algebraMap K L).injective
  rw [map_pow, algebraMap_iterateFrobenius K p hn]

name: algebraMap_iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem algebraMap_iterateFrobeniusₛₗ {n : ℕ} (hn : exponent K L ≤ n) (a : L) :
    algebraMap K L (iterateFrobeniusₛₗ F K L p hn a) = a ^ p ^ n
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_iterateFrobenius K p hn a

name: iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem iterateFrobeniusₛₗ_algebraMap {n : ℕ} (hn : exponent K L ≤ n) (a : K) :
    iterateFrobeniusₛₗ F K L p hn (algebraMap K L a) = a ^ p ^ n
proof:
:=
  iterateFrobenius_algebraMap L p hn a

name: iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem iterateFrobeniusₛₗ_algebraMap_base {n : ℕ} (hn : exponent K L ≤ n) (a : F) :
    iterateFrobeniusₛₗ F K L p hn (algebraMap F L a) = (algebraMap F K a) ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  apply (algebraMap K L).injective
  rw [← map_pow, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, map_pow,
    algebraMap_iterateFrobeniusₛₗ F K L p hn]

name: mem_perfectClosure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_perfectClosure_iff {x : E} :
    x ∈ perfectClosure F E ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ (ringExpChar F) ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: mem_perfectClosure_iff_pow_mem
statement:
theorem mem_perfectClosure_iff_pow_mem (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] {x : E} :
    x ∈ perfectClosure F E ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_perfectClosure_iff, ringExpChar.eq F q]

name: mem_perfectClosure_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_perfectClosure_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one {x : E} :
    x ∈ perfectClosure F E ↔ (minpoly F x).natSepDegree = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_perfectClosure_iff, minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_pow_mem (ringExpChar F)]

name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_perfectClosure_eq_top
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_iff_perfectClosure_eq_top :
    IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ perfectClosure F E = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem F (ringExpChar F)]
  exact ⟨fun H ↦ top_unique fun x _ ↦ H x, fun H _ ↦ H.ge trivial⟩

name: perfectClosure.eq_bot_of_isSeparable
statement: theorem perfectClosure.eq_bot_of_isSeparable [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] : perfectClosure F E = ⊥
proof:
:=
  haveI := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable F (perfectClosure F E) E
  eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable _

name: le_perfectClosure
statement:
theorem le_perfectClosure (L : IntermediateField F E) [h : IsPurelyInseparable F L] :
    L ≤ perfectClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem F (ringExpChar F)] at h
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, y, hy⟩ := h ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨n, y, congr_arg (algebraMap L E) hy⟩

name: le_perfectClosure_iff
statement:
theorem le_perfectClosure_iff (L : IntermediateField F E) :
    L ≤ perfectClosure F E ↔ IsPurelyInseparable F L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem F (ringExpChar F)).2 fun x ↦ ?_,
    fun _ ↦ le_perfectClosure F E L⟩
  obtain ⟨n, y, hy⟩ := h x.2
  exact ⟨n, y, (algebraMap L E).injective hy⟩

name: separableClosure_inf_perfectClosure
statement: theorem separableClosure_inf_perfectClosure : separableClosure F E ⊓ perfectClosure F E = ⊥
proof:
:=
  haveI := (le_separableClosure_iff F E _).mp (inf_le_left (b := perfectClosure F E))
  haveI := (le_perfectClosure_iff F E _).mp (inf_le_right (a := separableClosure F E))
  eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable _

name: map_mem_perfectClosure_iff
statement:
theorem map_mem_perfectClosure_iff (i : E →ₐ[F] K) {x : E} :
    i x ∈ perfectClosure F K ↔ x ∈ perfectClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_perfectClosure_iff]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨n, y, h⟩ ↦ ⟨n, y, ?_⟩, fun ⟨n, y, h⟩ ↦ ⟨n, y, ?_⟩⟩
  · apply_fun i using i.injective
    rwa [AlgHom.commutes, map_pow]
  simpa only [AlgHom.commutes, map_pow] using congr_arg i h

name: perfectClosure.comap_eq_of_algHom
statement:
theorem perfectClosure.comap_eq_of_algHom (i : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (perfectClosure F K).comap i = perfectClosure F E
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact map_mem_perfectClosure_iff i

name: perfectClosure.map_le_of_algHom
statement:
theorem perfectClosure.map_le_of_algHom (i : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (perfectClosure F E).map i ≤ perfectClosure F K
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (perfectClosure.comap_eq_of_algHom i).ge

name: perfectClosure.map_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem perfectClosure.map_eq_of_algEquiv (i : E ≃ₐ[F] K) :
    (perfectClosure F E).map i.toAlgHom = perfectClosure F K
proof:
:=
  (map_le_of_algHom i.toAlgHom).antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ⟨i.symm x,
    (map_mem_perfectClosure_iff i.symm.toAlgHom).2 hx, i.right_inv x⟩)

name: isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one {x : E} :
    IsPurelyInseparable F F⟮x⟯ ↔ (minpoly F x).natSepDegree = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_perfectClosure_iff, adjoin_simple_le_iff, mem_perfectClosure_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one]

name: isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_pow_mem
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_pow_mem (q : ℕ) [hF : ExpChar F q] {x : E} :
    IsPurelyInseparable F F⟮x⟯ ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_perfectClosure_iff, adjoin_simple_le_iff, mem_perfectClosure_iff_pow_mem q]

name: isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_iff_pow_mem
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_iff_pow_mem (q : ℕ) [hF : ExpChar F q] {S : Set E} :
    IsPurelyInseparable F (adjoin F S) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ q ^ n ∈ (algebraMap F E).range
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← le_perfectClosure_iff, adjoin_le_iff, ← mem_perfectClosure_iff_pow_mem q,
    Set.subset_def, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable (S : Set E)
    [Algebra.IsSeparable F (adjoin F S)] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] (n : ℕ) :
    adjoin F S = adjoin F ((· ^ q ^ n) '' S)
proof:
:= by
  set M := adjoin F ((· ^ q ^ n) '' S)
  have := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F M).injective q
  refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_) (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_)
  · have : Algebra.IsSeparable M M⟮x⟯ :=
      (isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable M E).2 <|
        ((isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable F E).1 inferInstance x hx).tower_top M
    have : IsPurelyInseparable M M⟮x⟯ :=
      (isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_pow_mem M E q).2
        ⟨n, ⟨x ^ q ^ n, subset_adjoin F _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    have hx' := mem_adjoin_simple_self M x
    rw [M⟮x⟯.eq_bot_of_isPurelyInseparable_of_isSeparable, mem_bot] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx'
    exact y.2
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact pow_mem (subset_adjoin F S hy) _

name: adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable'
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable' [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] (S : Set E)
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] (n : ℕ) : adjoin F S = adjoin F ((· ^ q ^ n) '' S)
proof:
:=
  haveI := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable F (adjoin F S) E
  adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable F E S q n

name: adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable (S : Set E) [Algebra.IsSeparable F (adjoin F S)]
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] : adjoin F S = adjoin F ((· ^ q) '' S)
proof:
:=
  pow_one q ▸ adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable F E S q 1

name: adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable'
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable' [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] (S : Set E)
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] : adjoin F S = adjoin F ((· ^ q) '' S)
proof:
:=
  pow_one q ▸ adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable' F E S q 1

name: adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable {a : E} (ha : IsSeparable F a)
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] (n : ℕ) : F⟮a⟯ = F⟮a ^ q ^ n⟯
proof:
:= by
  have := (isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable F E).mpr ha
  simpa using adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable F E {a} q n

name: adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable'
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable' [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] (a : E)
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] (n : ℕ) : F⟮a⟯ = F⟮a ^ q ^ n⟯
proof:
:= by
  simpa using adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable F E {a} q n

name: adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable {a : E} (ha : IsSeparable F a)
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] : F⟮a⟯ = F⟮a ^ q⟯
proof:
:=
  pow_one q ▸ adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable F E ha q 1

name: adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable'
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_of_isSeparable' [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] (a : E)
    (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] : F⟮a⟯ = F⟮a ^ q⟯
proof:
:=
  pow_one q ▸ adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable' F E a q 1

name: Field.span_map_pow_expChar_pow_eq_top_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem Field.span_map_pow_expChar_pow_eq_top_of_isSeparable [Algebra.IsSeparable F E]
    (h : Submodule.span F (Set.range v) = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span F (Set.range (v · ^ q ^ n)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.top_toSubmodule, ← top_toSubalgebra, ← adjoin_univ,
    adjoin_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable' F E _ q n,
    adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x,
    Set.image_univ, Algebra.adjoin_eq_span]
  have := (MonoidHom.mrange (powMonoidHom (α := E) (q ^ n))).closure_eq
  simp only [MonoidHom.mrange, powMonoidHom, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
    Submonoid.coe_copy] at this
  rw [this]
  refine (Submodule.span_mono <| Set.range_comp_subset_range _ _).antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  rw [Set.range_comp, ← Set.image_univ]
  have := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F E).injective q
  apply h ▸ Submodule.image_span_subset_span (LinearMap.iterateFrobenius F E q n) _

name: LinearIndependent.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_fd_isSeparable
statement:
private theorem LinearIndependent.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_fd_isSeparable
    [FiniteDimensional F E] [Algebra.IsSeparable F E]
    (h : LinearIndependent F v) : LinearIndependent F (v · ^ q ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := h.linearIndepOn_id
  let ι' := h'.extend (Set.range v).subset_univ
  let b : Basis ι' F E := Basis.extend h'
  let : Fintype ι' := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
  have H := linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank
    (Field.span_map_pow_expChar_pow_eq_top_of_isSeparable q n b.span_eq).ge
    (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b).symm
  let f (i : ι) : ι' := ⟨v i, h'.subset_extend _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  convert! H.comp f fun _ _ heq ↦ h.injective (by simpa only [f, Subtype.mk.injEq] using heq)
  simp_rw [Function.comp_apply, b]
  rw [Basis.extend_apply_self]

name: LinearIndependent.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable [Algebra.IsSeparable F E]
    (h : LinearIndependent F v) : LinearIndependent F (v · ^ q ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff_finset_linearIndependent] at h ⊢
  intro s
  let E' := adjoin F (s.image v : Set E)
  have : FiniteDimensional F E' := finiteDimensional_adjoin
    fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x
  let v' (i : s) : E' := ⟨v i.1, subset_adjoin F _ (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨i.1, i.2, rfl⟩)⟩
  have h' : LinearIndependent F v' := (h s).of_comp E'.val.toLinearMap
  exact (h'.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_fd_isSeparable q n).map'
    E'.val.toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot_of_injective E'.val.injective)

name: LinearIndependent.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable'
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable'
    (hsep : ∀ i : ι, IsSeparable F (v i))
    (h : LinearIndependent F v) : LinearIndependent F (v · ^ q ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  let E' := adjoin F (Set.range v)
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable F E' := (isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable F _).2 <| by
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact hsep y
  let v' (i : ι) : E' := ⟨v i, subset_adjoin F _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  have h' : LinearIndependent F v' := h.of_comp E'.val.toLinearMap
  exact (h'.map_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable q n).map'
    E'.val.toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot_of_injective E'.val.injective)

name: minpoly.iterateFrobenius_of_isSeparable
proof:
:= by
  have hai : IsIntegral F a := hsep.isIntegral
  have hapi : IsIntegral F (iterateFrobenius E q n a) := hai.pow _
  symm
  refine Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
    (minpoly.monic hapi)
    (minpoly.monic hai |>.map _)
    (minpoly.dvd F (a ^ q ^ n) ?haeval)
    ?hdeg
  · simpa using! Eq.symm <|
      (minpoly F a).map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (RingHom.iterateFrobenius_comm _ q n) a
  · rw [(minpoly F a).natDegree_map_eq_of_injective (iterateFrobenius F q n).injective,
      ← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hai,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_eq_adjoin_pow_expChar_pow_of_isSeparable F E hsep q n,
      ← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hapi, iterateFrobenius_def]

name: minpoly.frobenius_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem minpoly.frobenius_of_isSeparable [ExpChar E q] {a : E} (hsep : IsSeparable F a) :
    minpoly F (frobenius E q a) = (minpoly F a).map (frobenius F q)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using minpoly.iterateFrobenius_of_isSeparable q 1 hsep

name: perfectField_of_perfectClosure_eq_bot
statement:
theorem perfectField_of_perfectClosure_eq_bot [h : PerfectField E] (eq : perfectClosure F E = ⊥) :
    PerfectField F
proof:
:= by
  let p := ringExpChar F
  have := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F E).injective p
  have := PerfectRing.ofSurjective F p fun x ↦ by
    obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := surjective_frobenius E p (algebraMap F E x)
    have : y ∈ perfectClosure F E := ⟨1, x, by rw [← h, pow_one, frobenius_def, ringExpChar.eq F p]⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := eq ▸ this
    simp only [Algebra.ofId] at h
    exact ⟨z, (algebraMap F E).injective (by rw [RingHom.map_frobenius]; rw [h])⟩
  exact PerfectRing.toPerfectField F p

name: perfectField_of_isSeparable_of_perfectField_top
statement:
theorem perfectField_of_isSeparable_of_perfectField_top [Algebra.IsSeparable F E] [PerfectField E] :
    PerfectField F
proof:
:=
  perfectField_of_perfectClosure_eq_bot F E (perfectClosure.eq_bot_of_isSeparable F E)

name: perfectField_iff_isSeparable_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem perfectField_iff_isSeparable_algebraicClosure [IsAlgClosure F E] :
    PerfectField F ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable F E
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ IsSepClosure.separable, fun _ ↦ haveI : IsAlgClosed E := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed F
    perfectField_of_isSeparable_of_perfectField_top F E⟩

name: valuation_algebraMap_eq_one
statement:
@[grind =>]
lemma valuation_algebraMap_eq_one (a : Fq) (ha : a ≠ 0) : v (algebraMap Fq A a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype Fq := Fintype.ofFinite Fq
  have hpow : (v (algebraMap Fq A a)) ^ (Fintype.card Fq - 1) = 1 := by
    simp [← map_pow, FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one a ha]
