name: of_exists_root
statement:
@[stacks 09GR "(3) ⟹ (4)"]
theorem of_exists_root (H : ∀ p : k[X], p.Monic → Irreducible p → ∃ x, p.eval x = 0) :
    IsAlgClosed k
proof:
:= by
  replace H (p : k[X]) (hp : Irreducible p) : ∃ x, p.eval x = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := H (p * C (leadingCoeff p)⁻¹) (monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hp.ne_zero)
      (irreducible_mul_leadingCoeff_inv.mpr hp)
    exact ⟨x, by simpa [hp.ne_zero] using hx⟩
  refine ⟨fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_prod hp0
  rw [← hu]
  refine (Splits.multisetProd fun f hf ↦ ?_).mul u.isUnit.splits
  let h := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_factor f hf
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := H f h
  exact Splits.of_degree_eq_one (degree_eq_one_of_irreducible_of_root h hx)

name: of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem of_ringEquiv (k' : Type u) [Field k'] (e : k ≃+* k')
    [IsAlgClosed k] : IsAlgClosed k'
proof:
:= by
  apply IsAlgClosed.of_exists_root
  intro p hmp hp
  have hpe : degree (p.map e.symm.toRingHom) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [degree_map]
    exact ne_of_gt (degree_pos_of_irreducible hp)
  rcases IsAlgClosed.exists_root (k := k) (p.map e.symm.toRingHom) hpe with ⟨x, hx⟩
  use e x
  rw [IsRoot] at hx
  apply e.symm.injective
  rw [map_zero, ← hx]
  clear hx hpe hp hmp
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on <;> simp_all

name: degree_eq_one_of_irreducible
statement:
@[stacks 09GR "(4) ⟹ (2)"]
theorem degree_eq_one_of_irreducible [IsAlgClosed k] {p : k[X]} (hp : Irreducible p) :
    p.degree = 1
proof:
:=
  (IsAlgClosed.splits p).degree_eq_one_of_irreducible hp

name: algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Ring K] [IsDomain K]
    [hk : IsAlgClosed k] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsIntegral k K] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨RingHom.injective _, fun x ↦ ⟨-(minpoly k x).coeff 0, ?_⟩⟩
  have hq : (minpoly k x).leadingCoeff = 1 := minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  have h : (minpoly k x).degree = 1 := degree_eq_one_of_irreducible k (minpoly.irreducible
    (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x))
  have : aeval x (minpoly k x) = 0 := minpoly.aeval k x
  rw [eq_X_add_C_of_degree_eq_one h, hq, C_1, one_mul, aeval_add, aeval_X, aeval_C,
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at this
  exact (map_neg (algebraMap k K) ((minpoly k x).coeff 0)).symm ▸ this.symm

name: ringHom_bijective_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem ringHom_bijective_of_isIntegral {k K : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing K] [IsDomain K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] (f : k →+* K) (hf : f.IsIntegral) : Function.Bijective f
proof:
:=
  let _ : Algebra k K := f.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral k K := ⟨hf⟩
  algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral

name: IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isAlgClosed_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
@[stacks 09GQ "The result is the definition of algebraically closedness in Stacks Project. \
This statement is 09GR (4) ⟹ (1)."]
theorem IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isAlgClosed_of_isAlgebraic {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [Algebra k K] (L : IntermediateField k K) [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k L] :
    L = ⊥
proof:
:= bot_unique fun x hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral (k := k)).2 (⟨x, hx⟩ : L)
  exact ⟨y, congr_arg (algebraMap L K) hy⟩

name: Polynomial.isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
lemma Polynomial.isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed (K : Type v) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [Algebra k K] (p q : k[X]) : IsCoprime p q ↔ ∀ a : K, aeval a p ≠ 0 ∨ aeval a q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => aeval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime h, fun h => isCoprime_of_dvd _ _ ?_ fun x hu h0 => ?_⟩
  · replace h := h 0
    contrapose! h
    rw [h.left, h.right, map_zero, and_self]
  · rintro ⟨_, rfl⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha : _ = _⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root (x.map <| algebraMap k K) <| by
      simpa only [degree_map] using (ne_of_lt <| degree_pos_of_ne_zero_of_nonunit h0 hu).symm
    exact not_and_or.mpr (h a) (by simp_rw [map_mul, ← eval_map_algebraMap, ha, zero_mul, true_and])

name: isAlgClosure_iff
statement:
theorem isAlgClosure_iff (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra k K] :
    IsAlgClosure k K ↔ IsAlgClosed K ∧ Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K

name: IsAlgClosure.of_splits
statement:
theorem IsAlgClosure.of_splits {R K} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Field K] [Algebra R K]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R K] [IsTorsionFree R K]
    (h : ∀ p : R[X], p.Monic → Irreducible p → (p.map (algebraMap R K)).Splits) :
    IsAlgClosure R K where
  isAlgebraic
proof:
:= inferInstance
  isAlgClosed := .of_exists_root _ fun _p _ p_irred ↦
    have ⟨g, monic, irred, dvd⟩ := p_irred.exists_dvd_monic_irreducible_of_isIntegral (K := R)
    ((h g monic irred).of_dvd (map_monic_ne_zero monic) dvd).exists_eval_eq_zero <|
      degree_ne_of_natDegree_ne p_irred.natDegree_pos.ne'

name: eval_surjective
statement: theorem eval_surjective {p : M[X]} (hp : p.natDegree ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective p.eval
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ by
    rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos] at hp
    have ⟨y, hy⟩ := (IsAlgClosed.splits (p - C x)).exists_eval_eq_zero <| by
      simpa only [degree_sub_C hp] using hp.ne'
    exact ⟨y, by simpa [eval_sub, sub_eq_zero] using hy⟩

name: surjective_domRestrict_of_isAlgebraic
proof:
:=
  fun f ↦ IntermediateField.exists_algHom_of_splits'
    (E := E) f fun s ↦ ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral s, IsAlgClosed.splits _⟩

name: nonempty_algEquiv_or_of_finrank_eq_two
statement:
theorem nonempty_algEquiv_or_of_finrank_eq_two {F F' : Type*} (E : Type*)
    [Field F] [Field F'] [Field E] [Algebra F F'] [Algebra F E]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] [IsAlgClosed F'] (h : Module.finrank F F' = 2) :
    Nonempty (E ≃ₐ[F] F) ∨ Nonempty (E ≃ₐ[F] F')
proof:
:= by
  have emb : E →ₐ[F] F' := lift
  have e := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField emb
  have := Subalgebra.isSimpleOrder_of_finrank h
  obtain h | h := IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top emb.range <;> rw [h] at e
  exacts [.inl ⟨e.trans <| Algebra.botEquiv ..⟩, .inr ⟨e.trans Subalgebra.topEquiv⟩]

name: Polynomial.isRoot_of_isRoot_iff_dvd_derivative_mul
statement:
theorem Polynomial.isRoot_of_isRoot_iff_dvd_derivative_mul {K : Type*} [Field K]
    [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {f g : K[X]} (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    (∀ x, IsRoot f x → IsRoot g x) ↔ f ∣ f.derivative * g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, isRoot_of_isRoot_of_dvd_derivative_mul hf0⟩
  by_cases hg0 : g = 0
  · simp [hg0]
  by_cases hdf0 : derivative f = 0
  · rw [eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero hdf0]
    simp only [derivative_C, zero_mul, dvd_zero, implies_true]
  have hdg : f.derivative * g ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hdf0 hg0
  classical rw [IsAlgClosed.dvd_iff_roots_le_roots hf0 hdg, Multiset.le_iff_count]
  simp only [count_roots, rootMultiplicity_mul hdg]
  refine forall_imp fun a => ?_
  by_cases haf : f.eval a = 0
  · have h0 : 0 < f.rootMultiplicity a := (rootMultiplicity_pos hf0).2 haf
    rw [derivative_rootMultiplicity_of_root haf]
    intro h
    calc rootMultiplicity a f
        = rootMultiplicity a f - 1 + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 h0)).symm
      _ ≤ rootMultiplicity a f - 1 + rootMultiplicity a g := add_le_add le_rfl (Nat.succ_le_iff.1
        ((rootMultiplicity_pos hg0).2 (h haf)))
  · simp [haf, rootMultiplicity_eq_zero haf]

name: exists_mem_of_not_isUnit_aeval_prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.prod_toList, map_list_prod] at h
  replace h := mt List.prod_isUnit h
  simp only [not_forall, exists_prop, aeval_C, Multiset.mem_toList, List.mem_map, aeval_X,
    exists_exists_and_eq_and, Multiset.mem_map, map_sub] at h
  rcases h with ⟨r, r_mem, r_nu⟩
  exact ⟨r, by rwa [mem_iff, ← IsUnit.sub_iff], (mem_roots'.1 r_mem).2⟩

name: subset_polynomial_aeval
statement: theorem subset_polynomial_aeval (a : A) (p : 𝕜[X]) : (eval · p) '' σ a ⊆ σ (aeval a p)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  let q := C (eval k p) - p
  have hroot : IsRoot q k := by simp only [q, eval_C, eval_sub, sub_self, IsRoot.def]
  rw [← mul_div_eq_iff_isRoot, ← neg_mul_neg, neg_sub] at hroot
  have aeval_q_eq : ↑ₐ (eval k p) - aeval a p = aeval a q := by
    simp only [q, aeval_C, map_sub]
  rw [mem_iff, aeval_q_eq, ← hroot, aeval_mul]
  have hcomm := (Commute.all (C k - X) (-(q / (X - C k)))).map (aeval a : 𝕜[X] →ₐ[𝕜] A)
  apply mt fun h => (hcomm.isUnit_mul_iff.mp h).1
  simpa only [aeval_X, aeval_C, map_sub] using! hk

name: map_polynomial_aeval_of_degree_pos
statement:
theorem map_polynomial_aeval_of_degree_pos [IsAlgClosed 𝕜] (a : A) (p : 𝕜[X])
    (hdeg : 0 < degree p) : σ (aeval a p) = (eval · p) '' σ a
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset (fun k hk => ?_) (subset_polynomial_aeval a p)
  
  have hprod := (IsAlgClosed.splits (C k - p)).eq_prod_roots
  have h_ne : C k - p ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_degree_gt <| by
    rwa [degree_sub_eq_right_of_degree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt degree_C_le hdeg)]
  have lead_ne := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr h_ne
  have lead_unit := (Units.map ↑ₐ.toMonoidHom (Units.mk0 _ lead_ne)).isUnit
  /- leading coefficient is a unit so product of linear factors is not a unit;
    apply `exists_mem_of_not_is_unit_aeval_prod`. -/
  have p_a_eq : aeval a (C k - p) = ↑ₐ k - aeval a p := by
    simp only [aeval_C, map_sub]
  rw [mem_iff, ← p_a_eq, hprod, aeval_mul,
    ((Commute.all _ _).map (aeval a : 𝕜[X] →ₐ[𝕜] A)).isUnit_mul_iff, aeval_C] at hk
  replace hk := exists_mem_of_not_isUnit_aeval_prod (not_and.mp hk lead_unit)
  rcases hk with ⟨r, r_mem, r_ev⟩
  exact ⟨r, r_mem, symm (by simpa [eval_sub, eval_C, sub_eq_zero] using r_ev)⟩

name: map_polynomial_aeval_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem map_polynomial_aeval_of_nonempty [IsAlgClosed 𝕜] (a : A) (p : 𝕜[X])
    (hnon : (σ a).Nonempty) : σ (aeval a p) = (fun k => eval k p) '' σ a
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  refine Or.elim (le_or_gt (degree p) 0) (fun h => ?_) (map_polynomial_aeval_of_degree_pos a p)
  rw [eq_C_of_degree_le_zero h]
  simp only [eval_C, aeval_C, scalar_eq, Set.Nonempty.image_const hnon]

name: pow_image_subset
statement: theorem pow_image_subset (a : A) (n : ℕ) : (fun x => x ^ n) '' σ a ⊆ σ (a ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [eval_X_pow, aeval_X_pow] using subset_polynomial_aeval a (X ^ n : 𝕜[X])

name: pow_mem_pow
statement: theorem pow_mem_pow (a : A) (n : ℕ) {k : 𝕜} (hk : k ∈ σ a) : k ^ n ∈ σ (a ^ n)
proof:
:=
  pow_image_subset a n ⟨k, ⟨hk, rfl⟩⟩

name: map_pow_of_pos
statement:
theorem map_pow_of_pos [IsAlgClosed 𝕜] (a : A) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    σ (a ^ n) = (· ^ n) '' σ a

name: map_pow_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem map_pow_of_nonempty [IsAlgClosed 𝕜] {a : A} (ha : (σ a).Nonempty) (n : ℕ) :
    σ (a ^ n) = (· ^ n) '' σ a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [aeval_X_pow, eval_X_pow] using map_polynomial_aeval_of_nonempty a (X ^ n) ha

name: nonempty_of_isAlgClosed_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_isAlgClosed_of_finiteDimensional [IsAlgClosed 𝕜] [Nontrivial A]
    [I : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 A] (a : A) : (σ a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨h_mon, h_eval_p⟩⟩ := isIntegral_of_noetherian (IsNoetherian.iff_fg.2 I) a
  have nu : ¬IsUnit (aeval a p) := by rw [← aeval_def] at h_eval_p; rw [h_eval_p]; simp
  rw [(IsAlgClosed.splits p).eq_prod_roots_of_monic h_mon] at nu
  obtain ⟨k, hk, _⟩ := exists_mem_of_not_isUnit_aeval_prod nu
  exact ⟨k, hk⟩

name: IsIdempotentElem.spectrum_subset
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.spectrum_subset (𝕜 : Type*) {A : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Ring A] [Algebra 𝕜 A]
    {p : A} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : spectrum 𝕜 p ⊆ {0, 1}
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  apply Set.image_subset_iff.mp (spectrum.subset_polynomial_aeval p (X ^ 2 - X)) |>.trans
  refine fun a ha => eq_zero_or_one_of_sq_eq_self ?_
  simpa [pow_two p, hp.eq, sub_eq_zero] using ha

name: IsIdempotentElem.finite_spectrum
statement:
lemma IsIdempotentElem.finite_spectrum (𝕜 : Type*) {A : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Ring A] [Algebra 𝕜 A]
    {p : A} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : (spectrum 𝕜 p).Finite
proof:
:=
  have : ({0, 1} : Set 𝕜).encard = (2 : ℕ) := Set.encard_pair (by simp)
  Set.finite_of_encard_le_coe (this ▸ Set.encard_le_encard (hp.spectrum_subset 𝕜))

name: IsIdempotentElem.quasispectrum_subset
proof:
:=
  quasispectrum_eq_spectrum_inr' 𝕜 𝕜 p ▸ (hp.inr _ |>.spectrum_subset _)

name: IsIdempotentElem.finite_quasispectrum
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.finite_quasispectrum (𝕜 : Type*) {A : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [NonUnitalRing A]
    [Module 𝕜 A] [IsScalarTower 𝕜 A A] [SMulCommClass 𝕜 A A] {p : A} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) :
    (quasispectrum 𝕜 p).Finite
proof:
:=
  have : ({0, 1} : Set 𝕜).encard = (2 : ℕ) := Set.encard_pair (by simp)
  Set.finite_of_encard_le_coe (this ▸ Set.encard_le_encard (hp.quasispectrum_subset 𝕜))

name: natDegree_le_spanFinrank
statement:
theorem natDegree_le_spanFinrank :
    (minpoly A x).natDegree ≤ (⊤ : Submodule A B).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  rcases LinearMap.exists_monic_and_natDegree_eq_and_aeval_eq_zero _ (Algebra.lmul A _ x) with
    ⟨f, f_monic, f_deg, f_aeval⟩
  refine f_deg ▸ (natDegree_le_natDegree <| minpoly.min _ _ f_monic ?_)
  rw [aeval_algHom_apply] at f_aeval
  exact Algebra.lmul_injective (R := A) <| by simpa using f_aeval

name: natDegree_le
statement: theorem natDegree_le [Module.Free A B] : (minpoly A x).natDegree ≤ Module.finrank A B
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  simpa [Module.finrank_eq_spanFinrank_of_free] using natDegree_le_spanFinrank A x

name: degree_le
statement: theorem degree_le [Module.Free A B] : (minpoly A x).degree ≤ Module.finrank A B
proof:
:=
  degree_le_of_natDegree_le <| natDegree_le x

name: minpolyDiv_spec
statement:
lemma minpolyDiv_spec :
    minpolyDiv R x * (X - C x) = (minpoly R x).map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  delta minpolyDiv
  rw [mul_comm, mul_divByMonic_eq_iff_isRoot, IsRoot, eval_map_algebraMap, minpoly.aeval]

name: coeff_minpolyDiv
statement:
lemma coeff_minpolyDiv (i) : coeff (minpolyDiv R x) i =
    algebraMap R S (coeff (minpoly R x) (i + 1)) + coeff (minpolyDiv R x) (i + 1) * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_map, ← minpolyDiv_spec R x]; simp [mul_sub]

name: minpolyDiv_eq_zero
statement: lemma minpolyDiv_eq_zero (hx : ¬IsIntegral R x) : minpolyDiv R x = 0
proof:
:= by
  delta minpolyDiv minpoly
  rw [dite_eq_right hx, Polynomial.map_zero, zero_divByMonic]

name: eval_minpolyDiv_self
statement: lemma eval_minpolyDiv_self : (minpolyDiv R x).eval x = aeval x (derivative <| minpoly R x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_map_algebraMap, ← derivative_map, ← minpolyDiv_spec R x]; simp

name: minpolyDiv_eval_eq_zero_of_ne_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
lemma minpolyDiv_eval_eq_zero_of_ne_of_aeval_eq_zero [IsDomain S]
    {y} (hxy : y ≠ x) (hy : aeval y (minpoly R x) = 0) : (minpolyDiv R x).eval y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_map_algebraMap, ← minpolyDiv_spec R x] at hy
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, mul_eq_zero] at hy
  exact hy.resolve_right (by rwa [sub_eq_zero])

name: eval
statement:
lemma eval₂_minpolyDiv_of_eval₂_eq_zero {T} [CommRing T]
    [IsDomain T] [DecidableEq T] {x y}
    (σ : S →+* T) (hy : eval₂ (σ.comp (algebraMap R S)) y (minpoly R x) = 0) :
    eval₂ σ y (minpolyDiv R x) =
      if σ x = y then σ (aeval x (derivative <| minpoly R x)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← h, eval₂_hom, eval_minpolyDiv_self]
  · rw [← eval₂_map, ← minpolyDiv_spec] at hy
    simpa [sub_eq_zero, Ne.symm h] using hy

name: eval
statement:
lemma eval₂_minpolyDiv_self {T} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [IsDomain T] [DecidableEq T] (x : S)
    (σ₁ σ₂ : S →ₐ[R] T) :
    eval₂ σ₁ (σ₂ x) (minpolyDiv R x) =
      if σ₁ x = σ₂ x then σ₁ (aeval x (derivative <| minpoly R x)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eval₂_minpolyDiv_of_eval₂_eq_zero
  rw [AlgHom.comp_algebraMap, ← σ₂.comp_algebraMap, ← eval₂_map, ← RingHom.coe_coe, eval₂_hom,
    eval_map_algebraMap, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]

name: eval_minpolyDiv_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eval_minpolyDiv_of_aeval_eq_zero [IsDomain S] [DecidableEq S]
    {y} (hy : aeval y (minpoly R x) = 0) :
    (minpolyDiv R x).eval y = if x = y then aeval x (derivative <| minpoly R x) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval, eval₂_minpolyDiv_of_eval₂_eq_zero, RingHom.id_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
  simpa [aeval_def] using hy

name: coeff_minpolyDiv_mem_adjoin
statement:
lemma coeff_minpolyDiv_mem_adjoin (x : S) (i) :
    coeff (minpolyDiv R x) i ∈ R[x]
proof:
:= by
  by_contra H
  have : ∀ j, coeff (minpolyDiv R x) (i + j) ∉ R[x] := by
    intro j; induction j with
    | zero => exact H
    | succ j IH =>
      intro H; apply IH
      rw [coeff_minpolyDiv]
      refine add_mem ?_ (mul_mem H (self_mem_adjoin_singleton R x))
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  apply this (natDegree (minpolyDiv R x) + 1)
  rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt]
  · exact zero_mem _
  · lia

name: minpolyDiv_ne_zero
statement: lemma minpolyDiv_ne_zero [Nontrivial S] : minpolyDiv R x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  have := minpolyDiv_spec R x
  rw [e, zero_mul] at this
  exact ((minpoly.monic hx).map (algebraMap R S)).ne_zero this.symm

name: minpolyDiv_monic
statement: lemma minpolyDiv_monic : Monic (minpolyDiv R x)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality S
  have := congr_arg leadingCoeff (minpolyDiv_spec R x)
  rw [leadingCoeff_mul', ((minpoly.monic hx).map (algebraMap R S)).leadingCoeff] at this
  · simpa using! this
  · simpa using! minpolyDiv_ne_zero hx

name: natDegree_minpolyDiv_succ
statement:
lemma natDegree_minpolyDiv_succ [Nontrivial S] :
    natDegree (minpolyDiv R x) + 1 = natDegree (minpoly R x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (minpoly.monic hx).natDegree_map (algebraMap R S), ← minpolyDiv_spec, natDegree_mul']
  · simp
  · simpa using minpolyDiv_ne_zero hx

name: natDegree_minpolyDiv_lt
statement:
lemma natDegree_minpolyDiv_lt [Nontrivial S] :
    natDegree (minpolyDiv R x) < natDegree (minpoly R x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natDegree_minpolyDiv_succ hx]
  exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

name: minpolyDiv_eq_of_isIntegrallyClosed
statement:
lemma minpolyDiv_eq_of_isIntegrallyClosed [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R K] [Algebra K S] [IsScalarTower R K S] [IsFractionRing R K] :
    minpolyDiv R x = minpolyDiv K x
proof:
:= by
  delta minpolyDiv
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R K S, ← map_map,
    ← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' _ hx]

name: coeff_minpolyDiv_sub_pow_mem_span
statement:
lemma coeff_minpolyDiv_sub_pow_mem_span {i} (hi : i ≤ natDegree (minpolyDiv R x)) :
    coeff (minpolyDiv R x) (natDegree (minpolyDiv R x) - i) - x ^ i ∈
      Submodule.span R ((x ^ ·) '' Set.Iio i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp [(minpolyDiv_monic hx).leadingCoeff]
  | succ i IH =>
    rw [coeff_minpolyDiv, add_sub_assoc, pow_succ, ← sub_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · apply Submodule.smul_mem
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _, pow_zero _⟩
    · rw [← tsub_tsub, tsub_add_cancel_of_le (le_tsub_of_add_le_left (b := 1) hi)]
      apply SetLike.le_def.mp ?_
        (Submodule.mul_mem_mul (IH ((Nat.le_succ _).trans hi))
          (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x))
      rw [Submodule.span_mul_span, Set.mul_singleton, Set.image_image]
      apply Submodule.span_mono
      rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      rw [Set.mem_Iio] at hj
      exact ⟨j + 1, Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub hj, pow_succ x j⟩

name: span_coeff_minpolyDiv
statement:
lemma span_coeff_minpolyDiv :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range (coeff (minpolyDiv R x))) =
      Subalgebra.toSubmodule (R[x])
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality S
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply coeff_minpolyDiv_mem_adjoin
  · rw [← Submodule.span_range_natDegree_eq_adjoin (minpoly.monic hx) (minpoly.aeval _ _),
      Submodule.span_le]
    simp only [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_range, Set.image_subset_iff]
    intro i
    induction i using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind i hi => ?_
    intro hi'
    have : coeff (minpolyDiv R x) (natDegree (minpolyDiv R x) - i) ∈
        Submodule.span R (Set.range (coeff (minpolyDiv R x))) :=
      Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self _)
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, SetLike.mem_coe, ← Submodule.sub_mem_iff_right _ this]
    refine SetLike.le_def.mp ?_ (coeff_minpolyDiv_sub_pow_mem_span hx ?_)
    · rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.image_subset_iff]
      intro j (hj : j < i)
      exact hi j hj (lt_trans hj hi')
    · rwa [← natDegree_minpolyDiv_succ hx, Set.mem_Iio, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hi'

name: natDegree_minpolyDiv
statement:
lemma natDegree_minpolyDiv :
    natDegree (minpolyDiv R x) = natDegree (minpoly R x) - 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality S
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral R x
  · rw [← natDegree_minpolyDiv_succ hx]; rfl
  · rw [minpolyDiv_eq_zero hx, minpoly.eq_zero hx]; rfl

name: sum_smul_minpolyDiv_eq_X_pow
statement:
lemma sum_smul_minpolyDiv_eq_X_pow (E) [Field E] [Algebra K E] [IsAlgClosed E]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    {x : L} (hxL : K[x] = ⊤) {r : ℕ} (hr : r < finrank K L) :
    ∑ σ : L →ₐ[K] E, ((x ^ r / aeval x (derivative <| minpoly K x)) •
      minpolyDiv K x).map σ = (X ^ r : E[X])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  have : Function.Injective (fun σ : L →ₐ[K] E ↦ σ x) := fun _ _ h =>
    AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top hxL (fun _ hx ↦ hx ▸ h)
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero _ this
  · intro σ
    simp only [Polynomial.map_smul, map_div₀, map_pow, RingHom.coe_coe, eval_sub, eval_finsetSum,
      eval_smul, eval_map, eval₂_minpolyDiv_self, this.eq_iff, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, eval_X_pow]
    rw [sub_eq_zero, div_mul_cancel₀]
    rw [ne_eq, map_eq_zero_iff σ σ.toRingHom.injective]
    exact (IsSeparable.isSeparable _ _).aeval_derivative_ne_zero (minpoly.aeval _ _)
  · refine (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt
      (max_lt ((Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt ?_) ?_)
    · simp only [Polynomial.map_smul,
        map_div₀, map_pow, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
        Finset.mem_univ, forall_true_left, Finset.fold_max_lt, AlgHom.card]
      refine ⟨finrank_pos, ?_⟩
      intro σ
      exact ((Polynomial.natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans natDegree_map_le).trans_lt
        ((natDegree_minpolyDiv_lt (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)).trans_le
          (minpoly.natDegree_le _))
    · rwa [natDegree_pow, natDegree_X, mul_one, AlgHom.card]

name: isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions [IsDomain S] {s : S} (hs : IsIntegral R s) :
    minpoly K (algebraMap S L s) = (minpoly R s).map (algebraMap R K)
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_of_irreducible_of_monic ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  · exact ((monic hs).irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map).1 (irreducible hs)
  · rw [aeval_map_algebraMap, aeval_algebraMap_apply, aeval, map_zero]
  · exact (monic hs).map _

name: isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions'
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' [IsDomain S] [Algebra K S] [IsScalarTower R K S]
    {s : S} (hs : IsIntegral R s) : minpoly K s = (minpoly R s).map (algebraMap R K)
proof:
:= by
  let L := FractionRing S
  rw [← isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions K L hs, algebraMap_eq (IsFractionRing.injective S L)]

name: isIntegrallyClosed_dvd
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_dvd {s : S} (hs : IsIntegral R s) {p : R[X]}
    (hp : Polynomial.aeval s p = 0) : minpoly R s ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  let L := FractionRing S
  let _ : Algebra K L := FractionRing.liftAlgebra R L
  have : minpoly K (algebraMap S L s) ∣ map (algebraMap R K) (p %ₘ minpoly R s) := by
    rw [map_modByMonic _ (minpoly.monic hs), modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div]
    refine dvd_sub (minpoly.dvd K (algebraMap S L s) ?_) ?_
    · rw [← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map, hp, map_zero]
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_left
    rw [isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions K L hs]
  rw [isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions _ _ hs,
    map_dvd_map (algebraMap R K) (IsFractionRing.injective R K) (minpoly.monic hs)] at this
  rw [← modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd (minpoly.monic hs)]
  exact Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt this (degree_modByMonic_lt p <| minpoly.monic hs)

name: isIntegrallyClosed_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_dvd_iff {s : S} (hs : IsIntegral R s) (p : R[X]) :
    Polynomial.aeval s p = 0 ↔ minpoly R s ∣ p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hp => isIntegrallyClosed_dvd hs hp, fun hp => by
    simpa only [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.coe_comp, coe_evalRingHom, coe_mapRingHom,
      Function.comp_apply, eval_map_algebraMap] using
      aeval_eq_zero_of_dvd_aeval_eq_zero hp (minpoly.aeval R s)⟩

name: ker_eval
statement:
theorem ker_eval {s : S} (hs : IsIntegral R s) :
    RingHom.ker ((Polynomial.aeval s).toRingHom : R[X] →+* S) =
    Ideal.span ({minpoly R s} : Set R[X])
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp_rw [RingHom.mem_ker, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
    isIntegrallyClosed_dvd_iff hs, ← Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: IsIntegrallyClosed.degree_le_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsIntegrallyClosed.degree_le_of_ne_zero {s : S} {p : R[X]}
    (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hp : Polynomial.aeval s p = 0) : degree (minpoly R s) ≤ degree p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hs : ¬IsIntegral R s
  · simp [minpoly, hs]
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (minpoly.ne_zero hs), degree_eq_natDegree hp0]
  norm_cast
  exact natDegree_le_of_dvd ((isIntegrallyClosed_dvd_iff hs _).mp hp) hp0

name: IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff_isUnit_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff_isUnit_leadingCoeff {x : S} {p : R[X]}
    (hirr : Irreducible p) (hp : p.aeval x = 0) :
    IsIntegral R x ↔ IsUnit p.leadingCoeff where
  mp int_x
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := isIntegrallyClosed_dvd int_x hp
    rw [leadingCoeff_mul, monic int_x, one_mul]
    exact ((of_irreducible_mul hirr).resolve_left (not_isUnit R x)).map leadingCoeffHom
  mpr isUnit := by
    simpa [smul_smul] using (isIntegral_leadingCoeff_smul _ _ hp).smul ((isUnit.unit⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)

name: _root_.IsIntegrallyClosed.minpoly.unique
statement:
theorem _root_.IsIntegrallyClosed.minpoly.unique {s : S} {P : R[X]} (hmo : P.Monic)
    (hP : Polynomial.aeval s P = 0)
    (Pmin : ∀ Q : R[X], Q.Monic → Polynomial.aeval s Q = 0 → degree P ≤ degree Q) :
    P = minpoly R s
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsIntegral R s := ⟨P, hmo, hP⟩
  symm; apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
  by_contra hnz
  refine IsIntegrallyClosed.degree_le_of_ne_zero (s := s) hnz (by simp [hP]) |>.not_gt ?_
  refine degree_sub_lt_left ?_ (ne_zero hs) ?_
  · exact le_antisymm (min R s hmo hP) (Pmin (minpoly R s) (monic hs) (aeval R s))
  · rw [(monic hs).leadingCoeff, hmo.leadingCoeff]

name: IsIntegrallyClosed.unique_of_degree_le_degree_minpoly
statement:
theorem IsIntegrallyClosed.unique_of_degree_le_degree_minpoly {s : S} {p : R[X]} (hmo : p.Monic)
    (hp : p.aeval s = 0) (pmin : p.degree ≤ (minpoly R s).degree) : p = minpoly R s
proof:
:=
  IsIntegrallyClosed.minpoly.unique hmo hp fun _ qm hq ↦ pmin.trans <| min _ _ qm hq

name: IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff_leadingCoeff_dvd
statement:
theorem IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff_leadingCoeff_dvd {s : S} {p : R[X]} (hp : p.aeval s = 0)
    (h₀ : p ≠ 0) (pmin : ∀ q : R[X], q.Monic → q.aeval s = 0 → p.degree ≤ q.degree) :
    IsIntegral R s ↔ C p.leadingCoeff ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hInt ↦ ?_, fun ⟨q, hMul⟩ ↦ minpoly.ne_zero_iff.mp ?_⟩
  · use minpoly R s
    have ⟨q, hMul⟩ := isIntegrallyClosed_dvd hInt hp
    suffices q.degree ≤ 0 by simp [degree_le_zero_iff.mp this ▸ hMul, minpoly.monic hInt, mul_comm]
    apply WithBot.le_of_add_le_add_left <| Polynomial.degree_ne_bot.mpr <| minpoly.ne_zero hInt
    convert! pmin _ (minpoly.monic hInt) (minpoly.aeval ..)
    · rw [hMul, degree_mul]
    · rw [add_zero]
  · convert! right_ne_zero_of_mul <| hMul ▸ h₀
    refine IsIntegrallyClosed.minpoly.unique ?_ ?_ ?_ |>.symm
    · have := hMul ▸ leadingCoeff_mul .. |>.symm
      simp only [leadingCoeff_C, ne_eq, leadingCoeff_eq_zero, h₀, not_false_eq_true, mul_eq_left₀]
        at this
      exact this
    · have := congrArg (Polynomial.aeval s) hMul
      simp only [hp, h₀, map_mul, aeval_C, zero_eq_mul, FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff,
        leadingCoeff_eq_zero, false_or] at this
      exact this
    · exact (hMul ▸ degree_C_mul <| by simp [h₀]) ▸ pmin

name: prime_of_isIntegrallyClosed
statement: theorem prime_of_isIntegrallyClosed {x : S} (hx : IsIntegral R x) : Prime (minpoly R x)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨(minpoly.monic hx).ne_zero,
      ⟨fun h_contra => (ne_of_lt (minpoly.degree_pos hx)) (degree_eq_zero_of_isUnit h_contra).symm,
        fun a b h => or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr fun h' => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_dvd_iff hx] at h' h ⊢
  rw [aeval_mul] at h
  exact eq_zero_of_ne_zero_of_mul_left_eq_zero h' h

name: _root_.IsIntegrallyClosed.minpoly_smul
statement:
lemma _root_.IsIntegrallyClosed.minpoly_smul {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) {s : S} (hs : IsIntegral R s) :
    minpoly R (r • s) = (minpoly R s).scaleRoots r
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  let L := FractionRing S
  let : Algebra K L := FractionRing.liftAlgebra _ _
  apply map_injective _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K)
  rw [← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions K L (hs.smul r),
    map_scaleRoots _ _ _ (by simpa [minpoly.ne_zero_iff]),
    ← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions K L hs]
  simp_rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L]
  refine eq_of_monic_of_associated (minpoly.monic ?_) ?_
    (associated_of_dvd_dvd (minpoly.dvd _ _ ?_) ?_)
  · refine isIntegral_algebraMap.mul (hs.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S L)).tower_top
  · simpa [monic_scaleRoots_iff] using minpoly.monic
      (hs.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S L)).tower_top
  · exact scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero (minpoly.aeval _ _)
  · rw [← Polynomial.scaleRoots_dvd_iff _ _ (r := (algebraMap R K r)⁻¹) (IsUnit.mk0 _ (by simpa)),
      ← scaleRoots_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by simpa), scaleRoots_one]
    refine minpoly.dvd _ _ ?_
    nth_rw 1 [← inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (b := algebraMap S L s)
      (a := algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K r)) (by simpa), ← map_inv₀]
    exact scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero (minpoly.aeval _ _)

name: ToAdjoin.injective
statement: theorem ToAdjoin.injective (hx : IsIntegral R x) : Function.Injective (Minpoly.toAdjoin R x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun P₁ hP₁ => ?_
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective P₁
  simpa [← Subalgebra.coe_eq_zero, isIntegrallyClosed_dvd_iff hx, ← aeval_def] using hP₁

name: equivAdjoin_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivAdjoin_toAlgHom (hx : IsIntegral R x) : equivAdjoin hx = Minpoly.toAdjoin R x
proof: := rfl

name: coe_equivAdjoin

@[simp]
theorem coe_equivAdjoin (hx : IsIntegral R x) : ⇑(equivAdjoin hx) = Minpoly.toAdjoin R x
proof: := rfl

name: _root_.Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis'_dim
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis'_dim (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    (Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis' hx).dim = (minpoly R x).natDegree
proof: := rfl

name: _root_.Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis'_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis'_gen (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    (adjoin.powerBasis' hx).gen = ⟨x, SetLike.mem_coe.1 <| subset_adjoin <| mem_singleton x⟩
proof:

  rw [Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis', PowerBasis.map_gen, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'_gen, equivAdjoin,
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective_apply, Minpoly.toAdjoin, liftAlgHom_root]

name: _root_.PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop'_dim

theorem _root_.PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop'_dim {x : S} (hx : IsIntegral R x)

name: _root_.PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop'_gen

@[simp]
theorem _root_.PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop'_gen {x : S} (hx : IsIntegral R x)

name: ofSubring
statement:
theorem ofSubring (x : integralClosure A L) :
    Polynomial.map (algebraMap A K) (minpoly A x) = minpoly K (x : L)
proof:
:=
  eq_comm.mpr (isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions K L (IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral A L x))

name: monic
statement: theorem monic (hx : IsIntegral A x) : Monic (minpoly A x)
proof:
:= by
  delta minpoly
  rw [dite_eq_left hx]
  exact (degree_lt_wf.min_mem _ hx).1

name: ne_zero
statement: theorem ne_zero [Nontrivial A] (hx : IsIntegral A x) : minpoly A x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (monic hx).ne_zero

name: eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero (hx : ¬IsIntegral A x) : minpoly A x = 0
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right hx

name: ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem ne_zero_iff [Nontrivial A] : minpoly A x ≠ 0 ↔ IsIntegral A x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => of_not_not <| eq_zero.mt h, ne_zero⟩

name: algHom_eq
statement:
theorem algHom_eq (f : B →ₐ[A] B') (hf : Function.Injective f) (x : B) :
    minpoly A (f x) = minpoly A x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [minpoly, isIntegral_algHom_iff _ hf, ← Polynomial.aeval_def, aeval_algHom,
    AlgHom.comp_apply, _root_.map_eq_zero_iff f hf]

name: algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eq {B} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower A B B']
    (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap B B')) (x : B) :
    minpoly A (algebraMap B B' x) = minpoly A x
proof:
:=
  algHom_eq (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B B') h x

name: algEquiv_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algEquiv_eq (f : B ≃ₐ[A] B') (x : B) : minpoly A (f x) = minpoly A x
proof:
:=
  algHom_eq (f : B →ₐ[A] B') f.injective x

name: aeval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aeval : aeval x (minpoly A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  delta minpoly
  split_ifs with hx
  · exact (degree_lt_wf.min_mem _ hx).2
  · exact aeval_zero _

name: aeval_algHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aeval_algHom (f : B →ₐ[A] B') (x : B) : (Polynomial.aeval (f x)) (minpoly A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom, AlgHom.coe_comp, comp_apply, aeval, map_zero]

name: ne_one
statement: theorem ne_one [Nontrivial B] : minpoly A x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine (one_ne_zero : (1 : B) ≠ 0) ?_
  simpa using congr_arg (Polynomial.aeval x) h

name: map_ne_one
statement:
theorem map_ne_one [Nontrivial B] {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] (f : A →+* R) :
    (minpoly A x).map f ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral A x
  · exact mt ((monic hx).eq_one_of_map_eq_one f) (ne_one A x)
  · rw [eq_zero hx, Polynomial.map_zero]
    exact zero_ne_one

name: not_isUnit
statement: theorem not_isUnit [Nontrivial B] : ¬IsUnit (minpoly A x)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial A := (algebraMap A B).domain_nontrivial
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral A x
  · exact mt (monic hx).eq_one_of_isUnit (ne_one A x)
  · rw [eq_zero hx]
    exact not_isUnit_zero

name: mem_range_of_degree_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_range_of_degree_eq_one (hx : (minpoly A x).degree = 1) :
    x ∈ (algebraMap A B).range
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsIntegral A x := by
    by_contra h
    rw [eq_zero h, degree_zero, ← WithBot.coe_one] at hx
    exact ne_of_lt (show ⊥ < ↑1 from WithBot.bot_lt_coe 1) hx
  have key := minpoly.aeval A x
  rw [eq_X_add_C_of_degree_eq_one hx, (minpoly.monic h).leadingCoeff, C_1, one_mul, aeval_add,
    aeval_C, aeval_X, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← map_neg] at key
  exact ⟨-(minpoly A x).coeff 0, key.symm⟩

name: min
statement:
theorem min {p : A[X]} (pmonic : p.Monic) (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) :
    degree (minpoly A x) ≤ degree p
proof:
:= by
  delta minpoly; split_ifs with hx
  · refine le_of_not_gt <| degree_lt_wf.not_lt_min _ ?_
    exact ⟨pmonic, hp⟩
  · simp only [degree_zero, bot_le]

name: unique'
statement:
theorem unique' {p : A[X]} (hm : p.Monic) (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0)
    (hl : ∀ q : A[X], degree q < degree p → q = 0 ∨ Polynomial.aeval x q ≠ 0) :
    p = minpoly A x
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  have hx : IsIntegral A x := ⟨p, hm, hp⟩
  obtain h | h := hl _ ((minpoly A x).degree_modByMonic_lt hm)
  swap
  · exact (h <| (aeval_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root hp).trans <| aeval A x).elim
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hm).1 h
  rw [hr]
  have hlead := congr_arg leadingCoeff hr
  rw [mul_comm, leadingCoeff_mul_monic hm, (monic hx).leadingCoeff] at hlead
  have : natDegree r ≤ 0 := by
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact ne_zero hx (mul_zero p ▸ hr)
    apply_fun natDegree at hr
    rw [hm.natDegree_mul' hr0] at hr
    apply Nat.le_of_add_le_add_left
    rw [add_zero]
    exact hr.symm.trans_le (natDegree_le_natDegree <| min A x hm hp)
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero this, ← Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero this, ← leadingCoeff, ← hlead, C_1,
    mul_one]

name: eq_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem eq_of_linearIndependent {p : A[X]} (monic : p.Monic) (hp0 : p.aeval x = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hpn : p.degree = n) (ind : LinearIndependent A fun i : Fin n ↦ x ^ i.val) :
    minpoly A x = p
proof:
:=
  .symm <| unique' _ _ monic hp0 fun q lt ↦ or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr fun ne hq ↦ ne <| ext fun i ↦ by
    rw [q.as_sum_range' _ ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt ne).mpr (hpn ▸ lt))] at hq
    obtain lt | le := lt_or_ge i n
    · simpa using Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp ind (q.coeff ·)
        (by simpa [Finset.sum_range, Algebra.smul_def] using hq) ⟨i, lt⟩
    · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt ((hpn ▸ lt).trans_le <| WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr le)

name: subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem subsingleton [Subsingleton B] : minpoly A x = 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  have := minpoly.min A x monic_one (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [degree_one] at this
  rcases le_or_gt (minpoly A x).degree 0 with h | h
  · rwa [(monic ⟨1, monic_one, by simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]⟩ :
           (minpoly A x).Monic).degree_le_zero_iff_eq_one] at h
  · exact (this.not_gt h).elim

name: natDegree_pos
statement: theorem natDegree_pos [Nontrivial B] (hx : IsIntegral A x) : 0 < natDegree (minpoly A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro ndeg_eq_zero
  have eq_one : minpoly A x = 1 := by
    rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero ndeg_eq_zero]
    convert C_1 (R := A)
    simpa only [ndeg_eq_zero.symm] using! (monic hx).leadingCoeff
  simpa only [eq_one, map_one, one_ne_zero] using! aeval A x

name: degree_pos
statement: theorem degree_pos [Nontrivial B] (hx : IsIntegral A x) : 0 < degree (minpoly A x)
proof:
:=
  natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp (natDegree_pos hx)

name: aeval_modByMonic_minpoly
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aeval_modByMonic_minpoly (p : A[X]) (x : B) : (p %ₘ minpoly A x).aeval x = p.aeval x
proof:
:=
  aeval_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root (minpoly.aeval ..)

name: degree_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem degree_eq_one_iff : (minpoly A x).degree = 1 ↔ x ∈ (algebraMap A B).range
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨minpoly.mem_range_of_degree_eq_one _ _, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have := Module.nontrivial A B
  exact (degree_X_sub_C x ▸ minpoly.min A (algebraMap A B x) (monic_X_sub_C x) (by simp)).antisymm
    (Nat.WithBot.add_one_le_of_lt <| minpoly.degree_pos isIntegral_algebraMap)

name: natDegree_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem natDegree_eq_one_iff :
    (minpoly A x).natDegree = 1 ↔ x ∈ (algebraMap A B).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.degree_eq_iff_natDegree_eq_of_pos zero_lt_one]
  exact degree_eq_one_iff

name: two_le_natDegree_iff
statement:
theorem two_le_natDegree_iff (int : IsIntegral A x) :
    2 ≤ (minpoly A x).natDegree ↔ x ∉ (algebraMap A B).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_not_comm, ← natDegree_eq_one_iff, not_le]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.trans_lt one_lt_two, fun h ↦ by linarith only [minpoly.natDegree_pos int, h]⟩

name: two_le_natDegree_subalgebra
statement:
theorem two_le_natDegree_subalgebra {B} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Nontrivial B]
    {S : Subalgebra A B} {x : B} (int : IsIntegral S x) : 2 ≤ (minpoly S x).natDegree ↔ x ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_le_natDegree_iff int, Iff.not]
  apply Set.ext_iff.mp Subtype.range_val_subtype

name: eq_X_sub_C_of_algebraMap_inj
statement:
theorem eq_X_sub_C_of_algebraMap_inj (a : A) (hf : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B)) :
    minpoly A (algebraMap A B a) = X - C a
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  refine (unique' A _ (monic_X_sub_C a) ?_ ?_).symm
  · rw [map_sub, aeval_C, aeval_X, sub_self]
  simp_rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro q hl h0
  rw [← natDegree_lt_natDegree_iff h0, natDegree_X_sub_C, Nat.lt_one_iff] at hl
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hl] at h0 ⊢
  rwa [aeval_C, map_ne_zero_iff _ hf, ← C_ne_zero]

name: aeval_ne_zero_of_dvdNotUnit_minpoly
statement:
theorem aeval_ne_zero_of_dvdNotUnit_minpoly {a : A[X]} (hx : IsIntegral A x) (hamonic : a.Monic)
    (hdvd : DvdNotUnit a (minpoly A x)) : Polynomial.aeval x a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine fun ha => (min A x hamonic ha).not_gt (degree_lt_degree ?_)
  obtain ⟨_, c, hu, he⟩ := hdvd
  have hcm := hamonic.of_mul_monic_left (he.subst <| monic hx)
  rw [he, hamonic.natDegree_mul hcm]
  
  apply lt_add_of_pos_right
  refine (lt_of_not_ge fun h => hu ?_)
  rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero h, ← Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h, ← leadingCoeff, hcm.leadingCoeff,
    C_1]
  exact isUnit_one

name: irreducible
statement: theorem irreducible (hx : IsIntegral A x) : Irreducible (minpoly A x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (irreducible_of_monic (monic hx) <| ne_one A x).2 fun f g hf hg he => ?_
  rw [← hf.isUnit_iff, ← hg.isUnit_iff]
  by_contra! h
  have heval := congr_arg (Polynomial.aeval x) he
  rw [aeval A x, aeval_mul, mul_eq_zero] at heval
  rcases heval with heval | heval
  · exact aeval_ne_zero_of_dvdNotUnit_minpoly hx hf ⟨hf.ne_zero, g, h.2, he.symm⟩ heval
  · refine aeval_ne_zero_of_dvdNotUnit_minpoly hx hg ⟨hg.ne_zero, f, h.1, ?_⟩ heval
    rw [mul_comm, he]

name: mk_def
statement:
@[simp]

proof: := rfl

name: ind
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, cases_eliminator, induction_eliminator]
lemma ind {motive : ConjRootClass K L → Prop} (h : ∀ x : L, motive (mk K x))
    (c : ConjRootClass K L) : motive c
proof:

  Quotient.ind h c

name: mk_eq_mk
statement:

theorem mk_eq_mk {x y : L} : mk K x = mk K y ↔ IsConjRoot K x y
proof: := Quotient.eq

name: mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero : mk K (0 : L) = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff (x : L) : mk K x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm (b := 0), ← mk_zero, mk_eq_mk, isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero]

name: mem_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_carrier {x : L} {c : ConjRootClass K L} : x ∈ c.carrier ↔ mk K x = c
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: carrier_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carrier_zero : (0 : ConjRootClass K L).carrier = {0}
proof:
:= by
  ext; rw [mem_carrier, mk_eq_zero_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]

name: carrier_inj
statement: theorem carrier_inj : Function.Injective (carrier (K := K) (L := L))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y H
  induction x with | h x => ?_
  induction y with | h y => ?_
  simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_carrier] at H
  rw [← H]

name: mk_neg
statement: theorem mk_neg (x : L) : - mk K x = mk K (-x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: carrier_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carrier_neg (c : ConjRootClass K L) : carrier (-c) = - carrier c
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [mem_carrier, ← mk_neg, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]

name: exists_mem_carrier_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mem_carrier_add_eq_zero (x y : ConjRootClass K L) :
    (∃ᵉ (a ∈ x.carrier) (b ∈ y.carrier), a + b = 0) ↔ x = -y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_carrier]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl, b, rfl, h⟩
    rw [mk_neg, mk_eq_mk, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp h]
  · rintro rfl
    induction y with
    | h y => exact ⟨-y, mk_neg y, y, rfl, neg_add_cancel _⟩

name: minpoly_mk
statement:

theorem minpoly_mk (x : L) : (mk K x).minpoly = minpoly K x
proof:
:=

name: minpoly_inj

  exact minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _)

name: minpoly_ne_zero

  c.monic_minpoly.ne_zero

name: aeval_minpoly_iff

name: rootSet_minpoly_eq_carrier

  ext x

  simp [c.minpoly_ne_zero]

name: separable_minpoly
statement: theorem separable_minpoly (c : ConjRootClass K L) : Separable c.minpoly
proof:
:= by
  induction c
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K _

name: nodup_aroots_minpoly
statement: theorem nodup_aroots_minpoly (c : ConjRootClass K L) : (c.minpoly.aroots L).Nodup
proof:
:=
  nodup_roots c.separable_minpoly.map

name: aroots_minpoly_eq_carrier_val
statement:
theorem aroots_minpoly_eq_carrier_val (c : ConjRootClass K L) [Fintype c.carrier] :
    c.minpoly.aroots L = c.carrier.toFinset.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [← rootSet_minpoly_eq_carrier, rootSet_def, Finset.toFinset_coe, Multiset.toFinset_val,
    c.nodup_aroots_minpoly.dedup]

name: carrier_eq_mk_aroots_minpoly
statement:
theorem carrier_eq_mk_aroots_minpoly (c : ConjRootClass K L) [Fintype c.carrier] :
    c.carrier.toFinset = ⟨c.minpoly.aroots L, c.nodup_aroots_minpoly⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [aroots_minpoly_eq_carrier_val]

name: minpoly.map_eq_prod
statement:
theorem minpoly.map_eq_prod [Normal K L] (c : ConjRootClass K L) [Fintype c.carrier] :
    c.minpoly.map (algebraMap K L) = ∏ x ∈ c.carrier.toFinset, (X - C x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [← rootSet_minpoly_eq_carrier, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, rootSet_def,
    Finset.toFinset_coe, Multiset.toFinset_val]
  rw [Multiset.dedup_eq_self.mpr (nodup_roots c.separable_minpoly.map),
    prod_multiset_X_sub_C_of_monic_of_roots_card_eq (c.monic_minpoly.map _)]
  rw [← splits_iff_card_roots]
  exact c.splits_minpoly

name: degree_le_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degree_le_of_ne_zero {p : A[X]} (pnz : p ≠ 0) (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) :
    degree (minpoly A x) ≤ degree p
proof:
:=
  calc
    degree (minpoly A x) ≤ degree (p * C (leadingCoeff p)⁻¹) :=
      min A x (monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv pnz) (by simp [hp])
    _ = degree p := degree_mul_leadingCoeff_inv p pnz

name: ne_zero_of_finite
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_finite (e : B) [FiniteDimensional A B] : minpoly A e ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  minpoly.ne_zero <| .of_finite A _

name: unique
statement:
theorem unique {p : A[X]} (pmonic : p.Monic) (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0)
    (pmin : ∀ q : A[X], q.Monic → Polynomial.aeval x q = 0 → degree p ≤ degree q) :
    p = minpoly A x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : IsIntegral A x := ⟨p, pmonic, hp⟩
  symm; apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
  by_contra hnz
  apply degree_le_of_ne_zero A x hnz (by simp [hp]) |>.not_gt
  apply degree_sub_lt_left _ (minpoly.ne_zero hx)
  · rw [(monic hx).leadingCoeff, pmonic.leadingCoeff]
  · exact le_antisymm (min A x pmonic hp) (pmin (minpoly A x) (monic hx) (aeval A x))

name: unique_of_degree_le_degree_minpoly
statement:
theorem unique_of_degree_le_degree_minpoly {p : A[X]} (pmonic : p.Monic) (hp : p.aeval x = 0)
    (pmin : p.degree ≤ (minpoly A x).degree) : p = minpoly A x
proof:
:=
  unique _ _ pmonic hp fun _ qm hq ↦ pmin.trans <| min _ _ qm hq

name: dvd
statement: theorem dvd {p : A[X]} (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) : minpoly A x ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp only [hp0, dvd_zero]
  have hx : IsIntegral A x := IsAlgebraic.isIntegral ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩
  rw [← modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd (monic hx)]
  by_contra hnz
  apply degree_le_of_ne_zero A x hnz
    ((aeval_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root (aeval _ _)).trans hp) |>.not_gt
  exact degree_modByMonic_lt _ (monic hx)

name: dvd_iff
statement: lemma dvd_iff {p : A[X]} : minpoly A x ∣ p ↔ Polynomial.aeval x p = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨q, hq⟩ ↦ by rw [hq, map_mul, aeval, zero_mul], minpoly.dvd A x⟩

name: isRadical
statement: theorem isRadical [IsReduced B] : IsRadical (minpoly A x)
proof:
:= fun n p dvd ↦ by
  rw [dvd_iff] at dvd ⊢; rw [map_pow] at dvd; exact IsReduced.eq_zero _ ⟨n, dvd⟩

name: dvd_map_of_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem dvd_map_of_isScalarTower (A K : Type*) {R : Type*} [CommRing A] [Field K] [Ring R]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra A R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower A K R] (x : R) :
    minpoly K x ∣ (minpoly A x).map (algebraMap A K)
proof:
:= by
  refine minpoly.dvd K x ?_
  rw [aeval_map_algebraMap, minpoly.aeval]

name: dvd_map_of_isScalarTower'
statement:
theorem dvd_map_of_isScalarTower' (R : Type*) {S : Type*} (K L : Type*) [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [Field K] [Ring L] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R K] [Algebra S L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R K L] [IsScalarTower R S L] (s : S) :
    minpoly K (algebraMap S L s) ∣ map (algebraMap R K) (minpoly R s)
proof:
:= by
  apply minpoly.dvd K (algebraMap S L s)
  rw [← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]

name: aeval_of_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem aeval_of_isScalarTower (R : Type*) {K T U : Type*} [CommRing R] [Field K] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R K] [Algebra K T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R K T] [CommSemiring U] [Algebra K U]
    [Algebra R U] [IsScalarTower R K U] (x : T) (y : U)
    (hy : Polynomial.aeval y (minpoly K x) = 0) : Polynomial.aeval y (minpoly R x) = 0
proof:
:=
  aeval_map_algebraMap K y (minpoly R x) ▸
    eval₂_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval₂_eq_zero (algebraMap K U) y
      (minpoly.dvd_map_of_isScalarTower R K x) hy

name: map_algebraMap
statement:
theorem map_algebraMap {F E A : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra F E] [Algebra E A] [Algebra F A] [IsScalarTower F E A]
    {a : A} (ha : IsIntegral F a) (h : minpoly E a ∈ lifts (algebraMap F E)) :
    (minpoly F a).map (algebraMap F E) = minpoly E a
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.monic ha.tower_top)
    ((algebraMap F E).injective.monic_map_iff.mp <| minpoly.monic ha)
    (minpoly.dvd E a (by simp)) ?_
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgdeg, hgmon⟩ := lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic h (minpoly.monic ha.tower_top)
  rw [natDegree_map, ← hgdeg]
  refine natDegree_le_of_dvd (minpoly.dvd F a ?_) hgmon.ne_zero
  rw [← aeval_map_algebraMap A, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq F E A, ← coe_mapRingHom,
    ← mapRingHom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, coe_mapRingHom, coe_mapRingHom, hg,
    aeval_map_algebraMap, minpoly.aeval]

name: ker_aeval_eq_span_minpoly
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ker_aeval_eq_span_minpoly :
    RingHom.ker (Polynomial.aeval x) = A[X] ∙ minpoly A x
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp_rw [RingHom.mem_ker, ← minpoly.dvd_iff, Submodule.mem_span_singleton,
    dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_left, smul_eq_mul, eq_comm (a := p)]

name: eq_of_irreducible_of_monic
statement:
theorem eq_of_irreducible_of_monic [Nontrivial B] {p : A[X]} (hp1 : Irreducible p)
    (hp2 : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) (hp3 : p.Monic) : p = minpoly A x
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hq⟩ := dvd A x hp2
  eq_of_monic_of_associated hp3 (monic ⟨p, ⟨hp3, hp2⟩⟩) <|
    mul_one (minpoly A x) ▸ hq.symm ▸ Associated.mul_left _
      (associated_one_iff_isUnit.2 <| (hp1.isUnit_or_isUnit hq).resolve_left <| not_isUnit A x)

name: eq_iff_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_iff_aeval_eq_zero [Nontrivial B] {p : A[X]} (irr : Irreducible p) (monic : p.Monic) :
    p = minpoly A x ↔ Polynomial.aeval x p = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨(· ▸ aeval A x), (eq_of_irreducible_of_monic irr · monic)⟩

name: eq_iff_aeval_minpoly_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_iff_aeval_minpoly_eq_zero [IsDomain B] {C} [Ring C] [Algebra A C] [Nontrivial C]
    {b : B} (h : IsIntegral A b) {c : C} :
    minpoly A b = minpoly A c ↔ Polynomial.aeval c (minpoly A b) = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_iff_aeval_eq_zero (irreducible h) (monic h)

name: eq_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem eq_of_irreducible [Nontrivial B] {p : A[X]} (hp1 : Irreducible p)
    (hp2 : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) : p * C p.leadingCoeff⁻¹ = minpoly A x
proof:
:= by
  have : p.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp1.ne_zero
  apply eq_of_irreducible_of_monic
  · exact Associated.irreducible ⟨⟨C p.leadingCoeff⁻¹, C p.leadingCoeff,
      by rwa [← C_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀, C_1], by rwa [← C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀, C_1]⟩, rfl⟩ hp1
  · rw [aeval_mul, hp2, zero_mul]
  · rwa [Polynomial.Monic, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, mul_inv_cancel₀]

name: Irreducible.eq_minpoly
statement:
theorem Irreducible.eq_minpoly [Nontrivial B] {p : A[X]} (hi : Irreducible p)
    (hx : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) : p = C p.leadingCoeff * minpoly A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minpoly.eq_of_irreducible hi hx, mul_comm, mul_assoc, ← C_mul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hi.ne_zero), C_1, mul_one]

name: _root_.Irreducible.dvd_iff_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.Irreducible.dvd_iff_aeval_eq_zero [Nontrivial B] {p q : A[X]} (hi : Irreducible p)
    {b : B} (hfa : p.aeval b = 0) : q.aeval b = 0 ↔ p ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hga ↦ dvd_trans ?_ (minpoly.dvd A b hga), ?_⟩
  · rw [← minpoly.eq_of_irreducible hi hfa]
    exact dvd_mul_right _ _
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    simp [hfa]

name: add_algebraMap
statement:
theorem add_algebraMap {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (x : B)
    (a : A) : minpoly A (x + algebraMap A B a) = (minpoly A x).comp (X - C a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral A x
  · refine (minpoly.unique _ _ ((minpoly.monic hx).comp_X_sub_C _) ?_ fun q qmo hq => ?_).symm
    · simp [aeval_comp]
    · have : (Polynomial.aeval x) (q.comp (X + C a)) = 0 := by simpa [aeval_comp] using hq
      have H := minpoly.min A x (qmo.comp_X_add_C _) this
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree qmo.ne_zero,
        degree_eq_natDegree ((minpoly.monic hx).comp_X_sub_C _).ne_zero, natDegree_comp,
        natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
      rwa [degree_eq_natDegree (minpoly.ne_zero hx),
        degree_eq_natDegree (qmo.comp_X_add_C _).ne_zero, natDegree_comp,
        natDegree_X_add_C, mul_one] at H
  · rw [minpoly.eq_zero hx, minpoly.eq_zero, zero_comp]
    refine fun h ↦ hx ?_
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using IsIntegral.sub h (isIntegral_algebraMap (x := a))

name: sub_algebraMap
statement:
theorem sub_algebraMap {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (x : B)
    (a : A) : minpoly A (x - algebraMap A B a) = (minpoly A x).comp (X + C a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using add_algebraMap x (-a)

name: neg
statement:
theorem neg {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra A B] (x : B) :
    minpoly A (-x) = (-1) ^ (natDegree (minpoly A x)) * (minpoly A x).comp (-X)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral A x
  · refine (minpoly.unique _ _ ((minpoly.monic hx).neg_one_pow_natDegree_mul_comp_neg_X)
        ?_ fun q qmo hq => ?_).symm
    · simp [aeval_comp]
    · have : (Polynomial.aeval x) ((-1) ^ q.natDegree * q.comp (-X)) = 0 := by
        simpa [aeval_comp] using hq
      have H := minpoly.min A x qmo.neg_one_pow_natDegree_mul_comp_neg_X this
      simp_all
  · rw [minpoly.eq_zero hx, minpoly.eq_zero, zero_comp]
    · simp only [natDegree_zero, pow_zero, mul_zero]
    · exact IsIntegral.neg_iff.not.mpr hx

name: map_eq_of_equiv_equiv
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_equiv_equiv {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Ring S] [Ring T]
    [IsDomain S] [IsDomain T] [Algebra R S] [Algebra A T] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    {f : R ≃+* A} {g : S ≃+* T}
    (hcomp : (algebraMap A T).comp f = (g : S →+* T).comp (algebraMap R S)) (x : S) :
    map f (minpoly R x) = minpoly A (g x)
proof:
:= by
  refine minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [← mapEquiv_apply, MulEquiv.irreducible_iff]
    exact minpoly.irreducible (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  · simpa using (map_aeval_eq_aeval_map hcomp (minpoly R x) x).symm
  · exact (monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)).map _

name: aux_inj_roots_of_min_poly
statement: theorem aux_inj_roots_of_min_poly : Injective (rootsOfMinPolyPiType F E K)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  
  suffices (f : E →ₗ[F] K) = (g : E →ₗ[F] K) by rwa [DFunLike.ext'_iff] at this ⊢
  rw [funext_iff] at h
  exact LinearMap.ext_on (Module.finBasis F E).span_eq fun e he =>
    Subtype.ext_iff.mp (h ⟨e, he⟩)

name: eq_X_sub_C
statement: theorem eq_X_sub_C (a : A) : minpoly A (algebraMap A B a) = X - C a
proof:
:=
  eq_X_sub_C_of_algebraMap_inj a (algebraMap A B).injective

name: eq_X_sub_C'
statement: theorem eq_X_sub_C' (a : A) : minpoly A a = X - C a
proof:
:=
  eq_X_sub_C A a

name: zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero : minpoly A (0 : B) = X
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_zero, C_0, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_zero, map_zero] using eq_X_sub_C B (0 : A)

name: one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one : minpoly A (1 : B) = X - 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_one, C_1, sub_eq_add_neg] using eq_X_sub_C B (1 : A)

name: prime
statement: theorem prime (hx : IsIntegral A x) : Prime (minpoly A x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨minpoly.ne_zero hx, not_isUnit A x, ?_⟩
  rintro p q ⟨d, h⟩
  have : Polynomial.aeval x (p * q) = 0 := by simp [h, aeval A x]
  replace : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0 ∨ Polynomial.aeval x q = 0 := by simpa
  exact Or.imp (dvd A x) (dvd A x) this

name: root
statement:
theorem root {x : B} (hx : IsIntegral A x) {y : A} (h : IsRoot (minpoly A x) y) :
    algebraMap A B y = x
proof:
:= by
  have key : minpoly A x = X - C y := eq_of_monic_of_associated (monic hx) (monic_X_sub_C y)
    (associated_of_dvd_dvd ((irreducible_X_sub_C y).dvd_symm (irreducible hx) (dvd_iff_isRoot.2 h))
      (dvd_iff_isRoot.2 h))
  have := aeval A x
  rwa [key, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at this

name: coeff_zero_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_eq_zero (hx : IsIntegral A x) : coeff (minpoly A x) 0 = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have zero_root := zero_isRoot_of_coeff_zero_eq_zero h
    rw [← root hx zero_root]
    exact map_zero _
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: coeff_zero_ne_zero
statement: theorem coeff_zero_ne_zero (hx : IsIntegral A x) (h : x ≠ 0) : coeff (minpoly A x) 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h
  simpa only [hx, coeff_zero_eq_zero] using h

name: minpoly_algEquiv_toLinearMap
statement:
lemma minpoly_algEquiv_toLinearMap (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (hσ : IsOfFinOrder σ) :
    minpoly K σ.toLinearMap = X ^ (orderOf σ) - C 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (minpoly.unique _ _ (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hσ.orderOf_pos.ne.symm) ?_ ?_).symm
  · simp [← AlgEquiv.pow_toLinearMap, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
  · intro q hq hs
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero, degree_X_pow_sub_C hσ.orderOf_pos, Nat.cast_le, ← not_lt]
    intro H
    rw [aeval_eq_sum_range' H, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range] at hs
    simp_rw [← AlgEquiv.pow_toLinearMap] at hs
    apply hq.ne_zero
    simpa using Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp
      (((linearIndependent_algHom_toLinearMap' K L L).comp _ AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective).comp _
        (Subtype.val_injective.comp ((finEquivPowers hσ).injective)))
      (q.coeff ∘ (↑)) hs ⟨_, H⟩

name: minpoly_algHom_toLinearMap
statement:
lemma minpoly_algHom_toLinearMap (σ : L →ₐ[K] L) (hσ : IsOfFinOrder σ) :
    minpoly K σ.toLinearMap = X ^ (orderOf σ) - C 1
proof:
:= by
  have : orderOf σ = orderOf (AlgEquiv.algHomUnitsEquiv _ _ hσ.unit) := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.coe_coe, orderOf_injective, ← orderOf_units, IsOfFinOrder.val_unit]
    exact (AlgEquiv.algHomUnitsEquiv K L).injective
  rw [this, ← minpoly_algEquiv_toLinearMap]
  · apply congr_arg
    ext
    simp
  · rwa [← orderOf_pos_iff, ← this, orderOf_pos_iff]

name: isConjRoot_def
statement: theorem isConjRoot_def {x y : A} : IsConjRoot R x y ↔ minpoly R x = minpoly R y
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: refl
statement: @[refl] theorem refl {x : A} : IsConjRoot R x x
proof: := rfl

name: symm
statement: @[symm] theorem symm {x y : A} (h : IsConjRoot R x y) : IsConjRoot R y x
proof: := Eq.symm h

name: trans
statement:
@[trans] theorem trans {x y z : A} (h₁ : IsConjRoot R x y) (h₂ : IsConjRoot R y z) :
    IsConjRoot R x z
proof: := Eq.trans h₁ h₂

name: comm
statement: theorem comm {x y : A} : IsConjRoot R x y ↔ IsConjRoot R y x
proof:
:=
  ⟨symm, symm⟩

name: aeval_eq_zero
statement: theorem aeval_eq_zero {x y : A} (h : IsConjRoot R x y) : aeval y (minpoly R x) = 0
proof:
:=
  h ▸ minpoly.aeval R y

name: add_algebraMap
statement:
theorem add_algebraMap {x y : S} (r : K) (h : IsConjRoot K x y) :
    IsConjRoot K (x + algebraMap K S r) (y + algebraMap K S r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isConjRoot_def, minpoly.add_algebraMap x r, minpoly.add_algebraMap y r, h]

name: sub_algebraMap
statement:
theorem sub_algebraMap {x y : S} (r : K) (h : IsConjRoot K x y) :
    IsConjRoot K (x - algebraMap K S r) (y - algebraMap K S r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, map_neg] using add_algebraMap (-r) h

name: neg
statement:
theorem neg {x y : S} (h : IsConjRoot K x y) :
    IsConjRoot K (-x) (-y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isConjRoot_def, minpoly.neg x, minpoly.neg y, h]

name: isConjRoot_algHom_iff_of_injective
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_algHom_iff_of_injective {x y : A} {f : A →ₐ[R] B}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : IsConjRoot R (f x) (f y) ↔ IsConjRoot R x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [isConjRoot_def, isConjRoot_def, algHom_eq f hf, algHom_eq f hf]

name: isConjRoot_algHom_iff
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_algHom_iff {A} [DivisionRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [Nontrivial B] {x y : A} (f : A →ₐ[R] B) : IsConjRoot R (f x) (f y) ↔ IsConjRoot R x y
proof:
:=
  isConjRoot_algHom_iff_of_injective f.injective

name: isConjRoot_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_of_aeval_eq_zero [IsDomain A] {x y : A} (hx : IsIntegral K x)
    (h : aeval y (minpoly K x) = 0) : IsConjRoot K x y
proof:
:=
  minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic (minpoly.irreducible hx) h (minpoly.monic hx)

name: isConjRoot_iff_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_iff_aeval_eq_zero [IsDomain A] {x y : A}
    (h : IsIntegral K x) : IsConjRoot K x y ↔ aeval y (minpoly K x) = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsConjRoot.aeval_eq_zero, isConjRoot_of_aeval_eq_zero h⟩

name: isConjRoot_of_algEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_of_algEquiv (x : A) (s : A ≃ₐ[R] A) : IsConjRoot R x (s x)
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm (minpoly.algEquiv_eq s x)

name: isConjRoot_of_algEquiv'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_of_algEquiv' (x : A) (s : A ≃ₐ[R] A) : IsConjRoot R (s x) x
proof:
:=
  (minpoly.algEquiv_eq s x)

name: isConjRoot_of_algEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_of_algEquiv₂ (x : A) (s₁ s₂ : A ≃ₐ[R] A) : IsConjRoot R (s₁ x) (s₂ x)
proof:
:=
  isConjRoot_def.mpr <| (minpoly.algEquiv_eq s₂ x) ▸ (minpoly.algEquiv_eq s₁ x)

name: IsConjRoot.exists_algEquiv
statement:
theorem IsConjRoot.exists_algEquiv [Normal K L] {x y : L} (h : IsConjRoot K x y) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(L/K), σ y = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ :=
    exists_algHom_of_splits_of_aeval (normal_iff.mp inferInstance) (h ▸ minpoly.aeval K x)
  exact ⟨AlgEquiv.ofBijective σ (σ.normal_bijective _ _ _), hσ⟩

name: isConjRoot_iff_exists_algEquiv
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_iff_exists_algEquiv [Normal K L] {x y : L} :
    IsConjRoot K x y ↔ ∃ σ : Gal(L/K), σ y = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_algEquiv, fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h ▸ (isConjRoot_of_algEquiv _ _).symm⟩

name: isConjRoot_iff_orbitRel
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_iff_orbitRel [Normal K L] {x y : L} :
    IsConjRoot K x y ↔ MulAction.orbitRel Gal(L/K) L x y
proof:
:=
  (isConjRoot_iff_exists_algEquiv)

name: IsConjRoot.of_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem IsConjRoot.of_isScalarTower [IsScalarTower K L S] {x y : S} (hx : IsIntegral K x)
    (h : IsConjRoot L x y) : IsConjRoot K x y
proof:
:=
  isConjRoot_of_aeval_eq_zero hx <| minpoly.aeval_of_isScalarTower K x y (aeval_eq_zero h)

name: isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_aroots
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_aroots {x y : S} (h : IsIntegral K x) :
    IsConjRoot K x y ↔ y ∈ (minpoly K x).aroots S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.mem_aroots, isConjRoot_iff_aeval_eq_zero h]
  simp only [iff_and_self]
  exact fun _ => minpoly.ne_zero h

name: isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_rootSet
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_rootSet {x y : S}
    (h : IsIntegral K x) : IsConjRoot K x y ↔ y ∈ (minpoly K x).rootSet S
proof:
:=
  (isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_aroots h).trans (by simp [rootSet])

name: isIntegral
statement:
theorem isIntegral {x y : A} (hx : IsIntegral R x) (h : IsConjRoot R x y) :
    IsIntegral R y
proof:
:=
  ⟨minpoly R x, minpoly.monic hx, h ▸ minpoly.aeval R y⟩

name: isIntegral_iff
statement: theorem isIntegral_iff {x y : A} (h : IsConjRoot R x y) : IsIntegral R x ↔ IsIntegral R y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx ↦ isIntegral hx h, fun hy ↦ isIntegral hy h.symm⟩

name: eq_algebraMap_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsConjRoot, minpoly.eq_X_sub_C_of_algebraMap_inj _ hf] at h
  have : x ∈ (X - C r).aroots S := by
    rw [mem_aroots]
    simp [X_sub_C_ne_zero, h ▸ minpoly.aeval R x]
  simpa [aroots_X_sub_C] using this

name: eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem eq_algebraMap {r : K} {x : S} (h : IsConjRoot K (algebraMap K S r) x) :
    x = algebraMap K S r
proof:
:=
  eq_algebraMap_of_injective h (algebraMap K S).injective

name: eq_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_injective [IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R S] {x : S} (h : IsConjRoot R 0 x)
    (hf : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  (algebraMap R S).map_zero ▸ (eq_algebraMap_of_injective ((algebraMap R S).map_zero ▸ h) hf)

name: eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero {x : S} (h : IsConjRoot K 0 x) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_injective h (algebraMap K S).injective

name: isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap_of_injective
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => eq_algebraMap_of_injective h hf, fun h => h.symm ▸ rfl⟩

name: isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap {r : K} {x : S} :
    IsConjRoot K (algebraMap K S r) x ↔ x = algebraMap K S r
proof:
:=
  isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap_of_injective (algebraMap K S).injective

name: isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap' {r : K} {x : S} :
    IsConjRoot K x (algebraMap K S r) ↔ x = algebraMap K S r
proof:
:=
  eq_comm.trans <| isConjRoot_iff_eq_algebraMap_of_injective (algebraMap K S).injective

name: isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero_of_injective [IsDomain R] {x : S} [IsTorsionFree R S]
    (hf : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)) : IsConjRoot R 0 x ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => eq_zero_of_injective h hf, fun h => h.symm ▸ rfl⟩

name: isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero {x : S} : IsConjRoot K 0 x ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero_of_injective (algebraMap K S).injective

name: isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero' {x : S} : IsConjRoot K x 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
