  eq_top_iff.mpr fun g _ ↦ (mem_adjoin_simple_iff _ _).mpr ⟨g.num, g.denom, by simp⟩

name: IntermediateField.adjoin_X
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.adjoin_X (E : IntermediateField K K⟮X⟯) :
    E⟮(X : K⟮X⟯)⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictScalars_eq_top_iff (K := K), IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin,
    _root_.eq_top_iff]
  exact le_trans (le_of_eq RatFunc.adjoin_X.symm) (adjoin.mono _ _ _ (by simp))

name: minpolyX_map
statement:
theorem minpolyX_map (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra (Algebra.adjoin K {f}) A]
    (B : Type*) [CommRing B] [Algebra K B] [Algebra K[f] B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower K A B]
    [IsScalarTower K[f] A B] : (f.minpolyX A).map (algebraMap A B) = f.minpolyX B
proof:
:= by
  simp [minpolyX, Polynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]

name: C_minpolyX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_minpolyX (x : K) : (C x).minpolyX K⟮C x⟯ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [minpolyX, sub_eq_zero, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: minpolyX_aeval_X
statement: theorem minpolyX_aeval_X : (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯).aeval (X : K⟮X⟯) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [aeval_sub, aeval_map_algebraMap, aeval_X_left_eq_algebraMap, map_mul, aeval_C,
    IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply, coe_algebraMap]
  nth_rw 2 [← num_div_denom f]
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (algebraMap_ne_zero f.denom_ne_zero)]
  exact sub_self _

name: eq_C_of_minpolyX_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_C_of_minpolyX_coeff_eq_zero
  (hf : (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯).coeff f.denom.natDegree = (0 : K⟮X⟯)) : ∃ c, f = C c
proof:
:= by
  use f.num.coeff f.denom.natDegree / f.denom.leadingCoeff
  rw [map_div₀, eq_div_iff ((_root_.map_ne_zero C).mpr
    (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr f.denom_ne_zero)), eq_comm]
  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using hf

name: minpolyX_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem minpolyX_eq_zero_iff : (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯) = 0 ↔ ∃ c, f = C c
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ f.eq_C_of_minpolyX_coeff_eq_zero (by simp [h]), by rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩; simp⟩

name: isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) : IsAlgebraic K⟮f⟯ (X : K⟮X⟯)
proof:
:=
  ⟨f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯, fun H ↦ hf (f.minpolyX_eq_zero_iff.mp H), f.minpolyX_aeval_X⟩

name: isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X'
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X' (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic K⟮f⟯ K⟮X⟯
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K⟮f⟯ K⟮f⟯⟮(X : K⟮X⟯)⟯ :=
    isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple <| isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mp <| f.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X hf
  exact (IntermediateField.adjoinXEquiv K⟮f⟯).isAlgebraic

name: natDegree_denom_le_natDegree_minpolyX
statement:
theorem natDegree_denom_le_natDegree_minpolyX (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) :
    f.denom.natDegree ≤ (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯).natDegree
proof:
:=
  le_natDegree_of_ne_zero fun H ↦ hf (f.eq_C_of_minpolyX_coeff_eq_zero congr($(H).val))

name: natDegree_num_le_natDegree_minpolyX
statement:
theorem natDegree_num_le_natDegree_minpolyX (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) :
    f.num.natDegree ≤ (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have f_ne_zero : f ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hf ⟨0, (RingHom.map_zero C).symm⟩
  apply le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
  intro H
  replace H := congr($(H).val)
  simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_map, coeff_natDegree, coeff_C_mul, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub,
    SubalgebraClass.coe_algebraMap, algebraMap_eq_C, MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_algebraMap,
    ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at H
  rw [sub_eq_zero, ← mul_right_inj' (inv_ne_zero f_ne_zero), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ f_ne_zero,
    one_mul, ← eq_div_iff <| (_root_.map_ne_zero C).mpr <| Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr
    (num_ne_zero f_ne_zero), ← inv_inj, inv_inv, ← map_div₀, ← map_inv₀] at H
  exact hf ⟨_, H⟩

name: natDegree_minpolyX
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpolyX :
    (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯).natDegree = max f.num.natDegree f.denom.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : ∃ c, f = C c
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hf
    simp
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯).natDegree ≤ _ := natDegree_sub_le _ _
    rw [natDegree_map, natDegree_C_mul fun H ↦ hf ⟨0, by simpa [map_zero] using congr($(H).val)⟩,
      natDegree_map] at this
    exact this
  · exact max_le (natDegree_num_le_natDegree_minpolyX f hf) <| le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
      fun H ↦ hf (f.eq_C_of_minpolyX_coeff_eq_zero congr($(H).val))

name: transcendental_of_ne_C
statement: theorem transcendental_of_ne_C (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) : Transcendental K f
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  have := isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple H.isIntegral
  have tr : Algebra.Transcendental K K⟮X⟯ := by infer_instance
  rw [Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic] at tr
  exact tr <| Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans _ _ _ (alg := f.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X' hf)

name: irreducible_minpolyX'
statement: theorem irreducible_minpolyX' (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) : Irreducible (f.minpolyX K[f])
proof:
:= by
  let e := Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental K f (f.transcendental_of_ne_C hf)
  let φ : K[X][X] := f.num.map (algebraMap ..) -
    Polynomial.C Polynomial.X * f.denom.map (algebraMap ..)
  have φ_map : φ.mapEquiv e.toRingEquiv = (f.minpolyX K[f]) := by
    simp only [algebraMap_eq, map_sub, mapEquiv_apply,
      AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv_toRingHom, algEquivOfTranscendental_coe, Polynomial.map_map, map_mul,
      map_C, RingHom.coe_coe, aeval_X, e, φ]
    congr 2 <;> ext <;> simp
  rw [← φ_map, MulEquiv.irreducible_iff]
  have : φ = Bivariate.swap
      (Polynomial.C f.num - Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C f.denom) := by
    simp only [X_mul_C, Bivariate.swap_apply, aevalAeval, aevalAevalEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars', coe_aeval_eq_eval, Function.comp_apply,
      aeval_sub, aeval_C, algebraMap_def, coe_mapRingHom, map_mul, aeval_X, eval_sub,
      eval_map_algebraMap, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  rw [this, MulEquiv.irreducible_iff]
  convert!
    irreducible_C_mul_X_add_C (neg_ne_zero.mpr f.denom_ne_zero)
      ((IsCoprime.neg_right_iff _ _).mpr f.isCoprime_num_denom).symm.isRelPrime using 1
  rw [add_comm, X_mul_C, map_neg, neg_mul]
  exact sub_eq_add_neg (Polynomial.C f.num) (Polynomial.C f.denom * Polynomial.X)

name: irreducible_minpolyX
statement: theorem irreducible_minpolyX (hf : ¬∃ c, f = C c) : Irreducible (f.minpolyX K⟮f⟯)
proof:
:= by
  have : UniqueFactorizationMonoid K[f] :=
    (f.transcendental_of_ne_C hf).uniqueFactorizationMonoid_adjoin
  rw [← f.minpolyX_map K[f] K⟮f⟯,
    ← IsPrimitive.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map]
  · exact f.irreducible_minpolyX' hf
  · apply (f.irreducible_minpolyX' hf).isPrimitive
    intro H
    have := natDegree_map_le (f := algebraMap K[f] K⟮f⟯) (p := f.minpolyX K[f])
    rw [f.minpolyX_map K[f] K⟮f⟯, H, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, f.natDegree_minpolyX,
      Nat.max_eq_zero_iff, ← f.eq_C_iff] at this
    exact hf this

name: finrank_eq_max_natDegree
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_max_natDegree :
    Module.finrank K⟮f⟯ K⟮X⟯ = max f.num.natDegree f.denom.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : ∃ c, f = C c
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hf
    rw [adjoin_simple_eq_bot_iff.mpr (show C c ∈ ⊥ from ⟨c, rfl⟩), finrank_bot',
      Module.finrank_of_not_finite fun H ↦ Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic.mp
      transcendental <| Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite K K⟮X⟯]
    simp
  rw [← (IntermediateField.adjoinXEquiv K⟮f⟯).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq,
    adjoin.finrank (f.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X hf).isIntegral,
    ← minpoly.eq_of_irreducible (f.irreducible_minpolyX hf) f.minpolyX_aeval_X, mul_comm,
    natDegree_C_mul <| inv_ne_zero <| leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr fun H ↦
    hf ((minpolyX_eq_zero_iff f).mp H), natDegree_minpolyX]

name: IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_X
statement:
theorem IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_X {E : IntermediateField K K⟮X⟯} (hE : E ≠ ⊥) :
    IsAlgebraic E (X : K⟮X⟯)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, ← le_bot_iff, SetLike.not_le_iff_exists] at hE
  obtain ⟨f, hf₁, hf₂⟩ := hE
  exact IsAlgebraic.tower_top_of_subalgebra_le (adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr hf₁) <|
    f.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple_X (by rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact hf₂ ⟨c, rfl⟩)

name: algebraMap_eq_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_eq_C : algebraMap K K⟮X⟯ = C
proof:
:=

name: algebraMap_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_C (a : K) : algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯ (Polynomial.C a) = C a

statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_comp_C : (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯).comp Polynomial.C = C

name: X_ne_zero

name: eq_C_iff
statement:
theorem eq_C_iff (f : K⟮X⟯) :
    (∃ c, f = C c) ↔ f.num.natDegree = 0 ∧ f.denom.natDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩; simp, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero, Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero]
  rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
  use a / b
  rw [← num_div_denom f, ← ha, ← hb, algebraMap_C, algebraMap_C, map_div₀]

name: eval_eq_zero_of_eval

theorem eval_eq_zero_of_eval₂_denom_eq_zero {x : K⟮X⟯}
    (h : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom x) = 0) : eval f a x = 0
proof: := by rw [eval, h, div_zero]

theorem eval₂_denom_ne_zero {x : K⟮X⟯} (h : eval f a x ≠ 0) :

proof:
:=
  mt eval_eq_zero_of_eval₂_denom_eq_zero h

name: eval_C

proof: := by simp [eval]

name: eval_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_algebraMap {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] [Algebra S K[X]] (p : S) :
    eval f a (algebraMap _ _ p) = (algebraMap _ K[X] p).eval₂ f a
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S K[X] K⟮X⟯]

name: eval_add
statement:
theorem eval_add {x y : K⟮X⟯} (hx : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom x) ≠ 0)
    (hy : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom y) ≠ 0) : eval f a (x + y) = eval f a x + eval f a y
proof:
:= by
  unfold eval
  by_cases hxy : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom (x + y)) = 0
  · have := Polynomial.eval₂_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval₂_eq_zero f a (denom_add_dvd x y) hxy
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_mul] at this
    cases mul_eq_zero.mp this <;> contradiction
  rw [div_add_div _ _ hx hy, eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hx hy), div_eq_mul_inv, mul_right_comm, ←
    div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff hxy]
  simp only [← Polynomial.eval₂_mul, ← Polynomial.eval₂_add]
  congr 1
  apply num_denom_add

name: eval_mul
statement:
theorem eval_mul {x y : K⟮X⟯} (hx : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom x) ≠ 0)
    (hy : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom y) ≠ 0) : eval f a (x * y) = eval f a x * eval f a y
proof:
:= by
  unfold eval
  by_cases hxy : Polynomial.eval₂ f a (denom (x * y)) = 0
  · have := Polynomial.eval₂_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval₂_eq_zero f a (denom_mul_dvd x y) hxy
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_mul] at this
    cases mul_eq_zero.mp this <;> contradiction
  rw [div_mul_div_comm, eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hx hy), div_eq_mul_inv, mul_right_comm, ←
    div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff hxy]
  repeat' rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_mul]
  congr 1
  apply num_denom_mul

name: algEquivOfTranscendental_algebraMap

name: valuation_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X

theorem valuation_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X
     (hlt : 1 < v RatFunc.X) {p : K[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : v p = v RatFunc.X ^ p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  convert! valuation_aeval_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X .X hlt hp

name: valuation_le_one_of_valuation_X_le_one
statement: theorem valuation_le_one_of_valuation_X_le_one (hle : v RatFunc.X ≤ 1) (p : K[X]) : v p ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [as_sum_range p, RatFunc.coePolynomial, map_sum]
  apply map_sum_le v
  intro i
  by_cases h0 : p.coeff i = 0
  · simp_all
  · rw [← RatFunc.coePolynomial]
    simp_all [pow_le_one', ← RatFunc.algebraMap_eq_C, hv.eq_one _ h0]

name: valuation_surjective

name: ofFractionRing_zero
statement: theorem ofFractionRing_zero : (ofFractionRing 0 : K⟮X⟯) = 0
proof:
:=
  zero_def.symm

name: ofFractionRing_add

theorem ofFractionRing_add (p q : FractionRing K[X]) :

:=

name: ofFractionRing_neg

:=
  (neg_def _).symm

name: ofFractionRing_one
statement: theorem ofFractionRing_one : (ofFractionRing 1 : K⟮X⟯) = 1
proof:
:=
  one_def.symm

name: ofFractionRing_mul
statement:
theorem ofFractionRing_mul (p q : FractionRing K[X]) :

name: ofFractionRing_div

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_inv_cancel : ∀ {p : K⟮X⟯}, p ≠ 0 → p * p⁻¹ = 1
  | ⟨p⟩, h => by
    have : p ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun hp => h <| by rw [hp, ofFractionRing_zero]
    simpa only [← ofFractionRing_inv, ← ofFractionRing_mul, ← ofFractionRing_one,
        ofFractionRing.injEq] using
      mul_inv_cancel₀ this

theorem toFractionRing_smul [SMul R (FractionRing K[X])] (c : R) (p : K⟮X⟯) :

proof:
:= by
  cases p

name: smul_eq_C_smul
statement: theorem smul_eq_C_smul (x : K⟮X⟯) (r : K) : r • x = Polynomial.C r • x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := x
  induction x using Localization.induction_on
  rw [← ofFractionRing_smul, ← ofFractionRing_smul, Localization.smul_mk,
    Localization.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]

name: mk_smul
statement: theorem mk_smul (c : R) (p q : K[X]) : RatFunc.mk (c • p) q = c • RatFunc.mk p q
proof:
:= by
  let : SMulZeroClass R (FractionRing K[X]) := inferInstance
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · rw [hq, mk_zero, mk_zero, ← ofFractionRing_smul, smul_zero]
  · rw [mk_eq_localization_mk _ hq, mk_eq_localization_mk _ hq, ← Localization.smul_mk, ←
      ofFractionRing_smul]

name: map_apply_ofFractionRing_mk
statement:
theorem map_apply_ofFractionRing_mk [MonoidHomClass F R[X] S[X]] (φ : F)
    (hφ : R[X]⁰ ≤ S[X]⁰.comap φ) (n : R[X]) (d : R[X]⁰) :
    map φ hφ (ofFractionRing (Localization.mk n d)) =
      ofFractionRing (Localization.mk (φ n) ⟨φ d, hφ d.prop⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, liftOn_ofFractionRing_mk,
    Submonoid.mem_comap.mp (hφ d.2), ↓reduceDIte]

name: map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective [MonoidHomClass F R[X] S[X]] (φ : F) (hφ : R[X]⁰ ≤ S[X]⁰.comap φ)
    (hf : Function.Injective φ) : Function.Injective (map φ hφ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x⟩ ⟨y⟩ h
  induction x using Localization.induction_on
  induction y using Localization.induction_on
  simpa only [map_apply_ofFractionRing_mk, ofFractionRing_injective.eq_iff,
    Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists, mul_cancel_left_coe_nonZeroDivisors,
    exists_const, ← map_mul, hf.eq_iff] using h

name: coe_mapRingHom_eq_coe_map
statement:
theorem coe_mapRingHom_eq_coe_map [RingHomClass F R[X] S[X]] (φ : F) (hφ : R[X]⁰ ≤ S[X]⁰.comap φ) :
    (mapRingHom φ hφ : R⟮X⟯ → S⟮X⟯) = map φ hφ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk
statement:
theorem liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk (φ : R[X] →*₀ G₀) (hφ : R[X]⁰ ≤ G₀⁰.comap φ)
    (n : R[X]) (d : R[X]⁰) :
    liftMonoidWithZeroHom φ hφ (ofFractionRing (Localization.mk n d)) = φ n / φ d
proof:
:=
  liftOn_ofFractionRing_mk _ _ _ _

name: liftMonoidWithZeroHom_injective
statement:
theorem liftMonoidWithZeroHom_injective [Nontrivial R] (φ : R[X] →*₀ G₀) (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (hφ' : R[X]⁰ ≤ G₀⁰.comap φ := nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective _ hφ) :
    Function.Injective (liftMonoidWithZeroHom φ hφ')
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x⟩ ⟨y⟩
  cases x using Localization.induction_on
  cases y using Localization.induction_on with | _ a'
  simp_rw [liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk]
  intro h
  congr 1
  refine Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr (Localization.r_of_eq (M := R[X]) ?_)
  have := mul_eq_mul_of_div_eq_div _ _ ?_ ?_ h
  · rwa [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hφ.eq_iff, mul_comm, mul_comm a'.fst] at this
  all_goals exact map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors _ hφ (SetLike.coe_mem _)

name: liftRingHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk
statement:
theorem liftRingHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk (φ : R[X] →+* L) (hφ : R[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) (n : R[X])
    (d : R[X]⁰) : liftRingHom φ hφ (ofFractionRing (Localization.mk n d)) = φ n / φ d
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk _ hφ _ _

name: liftRingHom_ofFractionRing_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftRingHom_ofFractionRing_algebraMap
    (φ : R[X] →+* L) (hφ : R[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) (x : R[X]) :
    RatFunc.liftRingHom φ hφ (ofFractionRing <| algebraMap R[X] _ x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, liftRingHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk]
  simp

name: liftRingHom_injective
statement:
theorem liftRingHom_injective [Nontrivial R] (φ : R[X] →+* L) (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (hφ' : R[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ := nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective _ hφ) :
    Function.Injective (liftRingHom φ hφ')
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_injective _ hφ

name: mk_one
statement: theorem mk_one (x : K[X]) : RatFunc.mk x 1 = algebraMap _ _ x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ofFractionRing_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ofFractionRing_algebraMap (x : K[X]) :
    ofFractionRing (algebraMap _ (FractionRing K[X]) x) = algebraMap _ _ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_one, mk_one']

name: mk_eq_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_div (p q : K[X]) : RatFunc.mk p q = algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mk_eq_div', ofFractionRing_div, ofFractionRing_algebraMap]

name: div_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_smul {R} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R K[X]] [IsScalarTower R K[X] K[X]] (c : R)
    (p q : K[X]) :
    algebraMap _ K⟮X⟯ (c • p) / algebraMap _ _ q =
      c • (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_div, mk_smul, mk_eq_div]

name: algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Algebra R K[X]] (x : R) :
    algebraMap R K⟮X⟯ x = algebraMap _ _ (algebraMap R K[X] x) / algebraMap K[X] _ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_div]
  rfl

name: map_apply_div_ne_zero
statement:
theorem map_apply_div_ne_zero {R F : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [FunLike F K[X] R[X]] [MonoidHomClass F K[X] R[X]]
    (φ : F) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ R[X]⁰.comap φ) (p q : K[X]) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    map φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) =
      algebraMap _ _ (φ p) / algebraMap _ _ (φ q)
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : φ q ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero (hφ (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hq))
  simp only [← mk_eq_div, mk_eq_localization_mk _ hq, map_apply_ofFractionRing_mk,
    mk_eq_localization_mk _ hq']

name: map_apply_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply_div {R F : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [FunLike F K[X] R[X]] [MonoidWithZeroHomClass F K[X] R[X]]
    (φ : F) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ R[X]⁰.comap φ) (p q : K[X]) :
    map φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) =
      algebraMap _ _ (φ p) / algebraMap _ _ (φ q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with (rfl | hq)
  · have : (0 : K⟮X⟯) = algebraMap K[X] _ 0 / algebraMap K[X] _ 1 := by simp
    rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, div_zero, div_zero, this, map_apply_div_ne_zero, map_one,
      map_one, div_one, map_zero, map_zero]
    exact one_ne_zero
  exact map_apply_div_ne_zero _ _ _ _ hq

name: liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div
statement:
theorem liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div {L : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero L]
    (φ : MonoidWithZeroHom K[X] L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) (p q : K[X]) :
    liftMonoidWithZeroHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) = φ p / φ q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with (rfl | hq)
  · simp only [div_zero, map_zero]
  simp only [← mk_eq_div, mk_eq_localization_mk _ hq,
    liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk]

name: liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div' {L : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero L]
    (φ : MonoidWithZeroHom K[X] L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) (p q : K[X]) :
    liftMonoidWithZeroHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p) / liftMonoidWithZeroHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ q) =
      φ p / φ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_div₀, liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div]

name: liftRingHom_apply_div
statement:
theorem liftRingHom_apply_div {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : K[X] →+* L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ)
    (p q : K[X]) : liftRingHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) = φ p / φ q
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div _ hφ _ _

name: liftRingHom_apply_div'
statement:
theorem liftRingHom_apply_div' {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : K[X] →+* L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ)
    (p q : K[X]) : liftRingHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p) / liftRingHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ q) =
      φ p / φ q
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div' _ hφ _ _

name: liftRingHom_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftRingHom_algebraMap {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : K[X] →+* L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ)
    (x : K[X]) : liftRingHom φ hφ (algebraMap K[X] _ x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using liftRingHom_apply_div' φ hφ x 1

name: liftRingHom_comp_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftRingHom_comp_algebraMap {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : K[X] →+* L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) :
    (liftRingHom φ hφ).comp (algebraMap K[X] _) = φ
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ liftRingHom_algebraMap _ hφ _

name: ofFractionRing_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ofFractionRing_comp_algebraMap :
    ofFractionRing ∘ algebraMap K[X] (FractionRing K[X]) = algebraMap _ _
proof:
:=
  funext ofFractionRing_algebraMap

name: algebraMap_injective
statement: theorem algebraMap_injective : Function.Injective (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofFractionRing_comp_algebraMap]
  exact ofFractionRing_injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)

name: coe_mapAlgHom_eq_coe_map
statement:
theorem coe_mapAlgHom_eq_coe_map (φ : K[X] →ₐ[S] R[X]) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ R[X]⁰.comap φ) :
    (mapAlgHom φ hφ : K⟮X⟯ → R⟮X⟯) = map φ hφ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: liftAlgHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk (n : K[X]) (d : K[X]⁰) :
    liftAlgHom φ hφ (ofFractionRing (Localization.mk n d)) = φ n / φ d
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_ofFractionRing_mk _ hφ _ _

name: liftAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_injective (φ : K[X] →ₐ[S] L) (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (hφ' : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ := nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective _ hφ) :
    Function.Injective (liftAlgHom φ hφ')
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_injective _ hφ

name: liftAlgHom_apply_div'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlgHom_apply_div' (p q : K[X]) :
    liftAlgHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p) / liftAlgHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ q) = φ p / φ q
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div' _ hφ _ _

name: liftAlgHom_apply_div
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_apply_div (p q : K[X]) :
    liftAlgHom φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) = φ p / φ q
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div _ hφ _ _

name: algebraMap_ne_zero
statement: theorem algebraMap_ne_zero {x : K[X]} (hx : x ≠ 0) : algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa

name: liftOn_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftOn_div {P : Sort v} (p q : K[X]) (f : K[X] → K[X] → P) (f0 : ∀ p, f p 0 = f 0 1)
    (H' : ∀ {p q p' q'} (_hq : q ≠ 0) (_hq' : q' ≠ 0), q' * p = q * p' → f p q = f p' q')
    (H : ∀ {p q p' q'} (_hq : q ∈ K[X]⁰) (_hq' : q' ∈ K[X]⁰), q' * p = q * p' → f p q = f p' q' :=
      fun {_ _ _ _} hq hq' h => H' (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hq) (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hq') h) :
    (RatFunc.liftOn (algebraMap _ K⟮X⟯ p / algebraMap _ _ q)) f @H = f p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_div, liftOn_mk _ _ f f0 @H']

name: liftOn'_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftOn'_div {P : Sort v} (p q : K[X]) (f : K[X] → K[X] → P) (f0 : ∀ p, f p 0 = f 0 1)
    (H) :
    (RatFunc.liftOn' (algebraMap _ K⟮X⟯ p / algebraMap _ _ q)) f @H = f p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [RatFunc.liftOn', liftOn_div _ _ _ f0]
  apply liftOn_condition_of_liftOn'_condition H

name: induction_on
statement:
protected theorem induction_on {P : K⟮X⟯ → Prop} (x : K⟮X⟯)
    (f : ∀ (p q : K[X]) (_ : q ≠ 0), P (algebraMap _ K⟮X⟯ p / algebraMap _ _ q)) : P x
proof:
:=
  x.induction_on' fun p q hq => by simpa using f p q hq

name: ofFractionRing_mk'
statement:
theorem ofFractionRing_mk' (x : K[X]) (y : K[X]⁰) :
    ofFractionRing (IsLocalization.mk' _ x y) =
      IsLocalization.mk' K⟮X⟯ x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div, ← mk_eq_div', ← mk_eq_div]

name: mk_eq_mk'
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk' (f : Polynomial K) {g : Polynomial K} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    RatFunc.mk f g = IsLocalization.mk' K⟮X⟯ f
      ⟨g, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.2 hg⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mk_eq_div, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div]

name: ofFractionRing_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFractionRing_eq :
    (ofFractionRing : FractionRing K[X] → K⟮X⟯) = IsLocalization.algEquiv K[X]⁰ _ _
proof:
:=
  funext fun x =>
    Localization.induction_on x fun x => by
      simp only [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, ofFractionRing_mk', IsLocalization.algEquiv_apply,
        IsLocalization.map_mk', RingHom.id_apply]

name: toFractionRing_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFractionRing_eq :
    (toFractionRing : K⟮X⟯ → FractionRing K[X]) = IsLocalization.algEquiv K[X]⁰ _ _
proof:
:=
  funext fun ⟨x⟩ =>
    Localization.induction_on x fun x => by
      simp only [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, ofFractionRing_mk', IsLocalization.algEquiv_apply,
        IsLocalization.map_mk', RingHom.id_apply]

name: toFractionRingRingEquiv_symm_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFractionRingRingEquiv_symm_eq :
    (toFractionRingRingEquiv K).symm = (IsLocalization.algEquiv K[X]⁰ _ _).toRingEquiv
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [toFractionRingRingEquiv, ofFractionRing_eq]

name: rank_ratFunc_ratFunc
statement: theorem rank_ratFunc_ratFunc : Module.rank k⟮X⟯ K⟮X⟯ = Module.rank k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.IsAlgebraic.rank_of_isFractionRing k[X] k⟮X⟯ K[X] K⟮X⟯,
    rank_polynomial_polynomial]

name: finrank_ratFunc_ratFunc
statement: theorem finrank_ratFunc_ratFunc : Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K⟮X⟯ = Module.finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Module.Finite k⟮X⟯ K⟮X⟯
  · have hrank := rank_ratFunc_ratFunc k K
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank] at hrank
    exact (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq hrank.symm).symm
  · have hf' : ¬ Module.Finite k K := by
      rwa [← Module.rank_lt_aleph0_iff, ← rank_ratFunc_ratFunc, Module.rank_lt_aleph0_iff]
    rw [Module.finrank_of_not_finite hf, Module.finrank_of_not_finite hf']

name: numDenom_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem numDenom_div (p : K[X]) {q : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    numDenom (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) =
      (Polynomial.C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (p / gcd p q),
        Polynomial.C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (q / gcd p q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [numDenom, liftOn'_div, ite_eq_right hq]
  intro p
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (one_ne_zero' K[X])]
  simp

name: num_div'
proof:
:= by
  rw [num, numDenom_div _ hq]

name: num_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_zero : num (0 : K⟮X⟯) = 0
proof: := by convert! num_div' (0 : K[X]) one_ne_zero <;> simp

name: num_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_div (p q : K[X]) :
    num (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) =
      Polynomial.C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (p / gcd p q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq]
  · exact num_div' p hq

name: num_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_one : num (1 : K⟮X⟯) = 1
proof: := by convert! num_div (1 : K[X]) 1 <;> simp

name: num_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_algebraMap (p : K[X]) : num (algebraMap _ _ p) = p
proof: := by convert! num_div p 1 <;> simp

name: num_div_dvd
statement:
theorem num_div_dvd (p : K[X]) {q : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    num (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [num_div _ q, C_mul_dvd]
  · exact EuclideanDomain.div_dvd_of_dvd (gcd_dvd_left p q)
  · simpa only [Ne, inv_eq_zero, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero] using right_div_gcd_ne_zero hq

name: num_div_dvd'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_div_dvd' (p : K[X]) {q : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (p / gcd p q) ∣ p
proof: := by simpa using num_div_dvd p hq

name: denom_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denom_div (p : K[X]) {q : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    denom (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) =
      Polynomial.C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (q / gcd p q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [denom, numDenom_div _ hq]

name: monic_denom
statement: theorem monic_denom (x : K⟮X⟯) : (denom x).Monic
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using RatFunc.induction_on with
  | f p q hq =>
    rw [denom_div p hq, mul_comm]
    exact Polynomial.monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv (right_div_gcd_ne_zero hq)

name: denom_ne_zero
statement: theorem denom_ne_zero (x : K⟮X⟯) : denom x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (monic_denom x).ne_zero

name: denom_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denom_zero : denom (0 : K⟮X⟯) = 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! denom_div (0 : K[X]) one_ne_zero <;> simp

name: denom_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denom_one : denom (1 : K⟮X⟯) = 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! denom_div (1 : K[X]) one_ne_zero <;> simp

name: denom_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denom_algebraMap (p : K[X]) : denom (algebraMap _ K⟮X⟯ p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! denom_div p one_ne_zero <;> simp

name: denom_div_dvd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denom_div_dvd (p q : K[X]) : denom (algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q) ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq]
  rw [denom_div _ hq, C_mul_dvd]
  · exact EuclideanDomain.div_dvd_of_dvd (gcd_dvd_right p q)
  · simpa only [Ne, inv_eq_zero, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero] using right_div_gcd_ne_zero hq

name: num_div_denom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_div_denom (x : K⟮X⟯) : algebraMap _ _ (num x) / algebraMap _ _ (denom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using RatFunc.induction_on with | _ p q hq
  have q_div_ne_zero : q / gcd p q ≠ 0 := right_div_gcd_ne_zero hq
  rw [num_div p q, denom_div p hq, map_mul, map_mul, mul_div_mul_left,
    div_eq_div_iff, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm _ q, ←
    EuclideanDomain.mul_div_assoc, ← EuclideanDomain.mul_div_assoc, mul_comm]
  · apply gcd_dvd_right
  · apply gcd_dvd_left
  · exact algebraMap_ne_zero q_div_ne_zero
  · exact algebraMap_ne_zero hq
  · refine algebraMap_ne_zero (mt Polynomial.C_eq_zero.mp ?_)
    exact inv_ne_zero (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr q_div_ne_zero)

name: isCoprime_num_denom
statement: theorem isCoprime_num_denom (x : K⟮X⟯) : IsCoprime x.num x.denom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using RatFunc.induction_on with | _ p q hq
  rw [num_div, denom_div _ hq]
  exact (isCoprime_mul_unit_left
    ((leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 <| right_div_gcd_ne_zero hq).isUnit.inv.map C) _ _).2
      (isCoprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hq)

name: num_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem num_eq_zero_iff {x : K⟮X⟯} : num x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← num_div_denom x, h, map_zero, zero_div], fun h => h.symm ▸ num_zero⟩

name: num_ne_zero
statement: theorem num_ne_zero {x : K⟮X⟯} (hx : x ≠ 0) : num x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mt num_eq_zero_iff.mp hx

name: num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff
statement:
theorem num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff {x : K⟮X⟯} {p q : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    x.num * q = p * x.denom ↔ x = algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (algebraMap_injective K).eq_iff, eq_div_iff (algebraMap_ne_zero hq)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← num_div_denom x]
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm (Inv.inv _), ←
    mul_assoc, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff]
  exact algebraMap_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x)

name: num_denom_add
statement:
theorem num_denom_add (x y : K⟮X⟯) :
    (x + y).num * (x.denom * y.denom) = (x.num * y.denom + x.denom * y.num) * (x + y).denom
proof:
:=
  (num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff (mul_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x) (denom_ne_zero y))).mpr <| by
    conv_lhs => rw [← num_div_denom x, ← num_div_denom y]
    rw [div_add_div, map_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul]
    · exact algebraMap_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x)
    · exact algebraMap_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero y)

name: num_denom_neg
statement: theorem num_denom_neg (x : K⟮X⟯) : (-x).num * x.denom = -x.num * (-x).denom
proof:
:= by
  rw [num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff (denom_ne_zero x), map_neg, neg_div, num_div_denom]

name: num_denom_mul
statement:
theorem num_denom_mul (x y : K⟮X⟯) :
    (x * y).num * (x.denom * y.denom) = x.num * y.num * (x * y).denom
proof:
:=
  (num_mul_eq_mul_denom_iff (mul_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x) (denom_ne_zero y))).mpr <| by
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [← num_div_denom x, ← num_div_denom y, div_mul_div_comm, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]

name: num_dvd
statement:
theorem num_dvd {x : K⟮X⟯} {p : K[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    num x ∣ p ↔ ∃ q : K[X], q ≠ 0 ∧ x = algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨_hx, hq⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hp
    use denom x * q
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← div_mul_div_comm, div_self, mul_one, num_div_denom]
    · exact ⟨mul_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x) hq, rfl⟩
    · exact algebraMap_ne_zero hq
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact num_div_dvd p hq

name: denom_dvd
statement:
theorem denom_dvd {x : K⟮X⟯} {q : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    denom x ∣ q ↔ ∃ p : K[X], x = algebraMap _ _ p / algebraMap _ _ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨_hx, hp⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hq
    use num x * p
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← div_mul_div_comm, div_self, mul_one, num_div_denom]
    exact algebraMap_ne_zero hp
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact denom_div_dvd p q

name: num_mul_dvd
statement: theorem num_mul_dvd (x y : K⟮X⟯) : num (x * y) ∣ num x * num y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · simp [hy]
  rw [num_dvd (mul_ne_zero (num_ne_zero hx) (num_ne_zero hy))]
  refine ⟨x.denom * y.denom, mul_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x) (denom_ne_zero y), ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← div_mul_div_comm, num_div_denom, num_div_denom]

name: denom_mul_dvd
statement: theorem denom_mul_dvd (x y : K⟮X⟯) : denom (x * y) ∣ denom x * denom y
proof:
:= by
  rw [denom_dvd (mul_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x) (denom_ne_zero y))]
  refine ⟨x.num * y.num, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← div_mul_div_comm, num_div_denom, num_div_denom]

name: denom_add_dvd
statement: theorem denom_add_dvd (x y : K⟮X⟯) : denom (x + y) ∣ denom x * denom y
proof:
:= by
  rw [denom_dvd (mul_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x) (denom_ne_zero y))]
  refine ⟨x.num * y.denom + x.denom * y.num, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, ← div_add_div, num_div_denom, num_div_denom]
  · exact algebraMap_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero x)
  · exact algebraMap_ne_zero (denom_ne_zero y)

name: num_inv_dvd
statement: theorem num_inv_dvd {x : K⟮X⟯} (hx : x ≠ 0) : num x⁻¹ ∣ denom x
proof:
:= by
  rw [num_dvd x.denom_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨x.num, num_ne_zero hx, ?_⟩
  nth_rw 1 [← x.num_div_denom]
  rw [inv_div]

name: denom_inv_dvd
statement: theorem denom_inv_dvd {x : K⟮X⟯} (hx : x ≠ 0) : denom x⁻¹ ∣ num x
proof:
:= by
  rw [denom_dvd (num_ne_zero hx)]
  refine ⟨x.denom, ?_⟩
  nth_rw 1 [← x.num_div_denom]
  rw [inv_div]

name: associated_num_inv
statement: theorem associated_num_inv {x : K⟮X⟯} (hx : x ≠ 0) : Associated (num x⁻¹) (denom x)
proof:
:= by
  apply associated_of_dvd_dvd (num_inv_dvd hx)
  convert! denom_inv_dvd (inv_ne_zero hx)
  rw [inv_inv]

name: associated_denom_inv
statement: theorem associated_denom_inv {x : K⟮X⟯} (hx : x ≠ 0) : Associated (denom x⁻¹) (num x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Associated.symm
  convert! associated_num_inv (inv_ne_zero hx)
  rw [inv_inv]

name: map_denom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem map_denom_ne_zero {L F : Type*} [Zero L] [FunLike F K[X] L] [ZeroHomClass F K[X] L]
    (φ : F) (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (f : K⟮X⟯) : φ f.denom ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun H =>
  (denom_ne_zero f) ((map_eq_zero_iff φ hφ).mp H)

name: map_apply
statement:
theorem map_apply {R F : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [FunLike F K[X] R[X]] [MonoidHomClass F K[X] R[X]] (φ : F)
    (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ R[X]⁰.comap φ) (f : K⟮X⟯) :
    map φ hφ f = algebraMap _ _ (φ f.num) / algebraMap _ _ (φ f.denom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← num_div_denom f, map_apply_div_ne_zero, num_div_denom f]
  exact denom_ne_zero _

name: liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply
statement:
theorem liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply {L : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero L] (φ : K[X] →*₀ L)
    (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) (f : K⟮X⟯) :
    liftMonoidWithZeroHom φ hφ f = φ f.num / φ f.denom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← num_div_denom f, liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply_div, num_div_denom]

name: liftRingHom_apply
statement:
theorem liftRingHom_apply {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : K[X] →+* L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ)
    (f : K⟮X⟯) : liftRingHom φ hφ f = φ f.num / φ f.denom
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply _ hφ _

name: liftAlgHom_apply
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_apply {L S : Type*} [Field L] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra S K[X]] [Algebra S L]
    (φ : K[X] →ₐ[S] L) (hφ : K[X]⁰ ≤ L⁰.comap φ) (f : K⟮X⟯) :
    liftAlgHom φ hφ f = φ f.num / φ f.denom
proof:
:=
  liftMonoidWithZeroHom_apply _ hφ _

name: num_mul_denom_add_denom_mul_num_ne_zero
statement:
theorem num_mul_denom_add_denom_mul_num_ne_zero {x y : K⟮X⟯} (hxy : x + y ≠ 0) :
    x.num * y.denom + x.denom * y.num ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h_zero
  have h := num_denom_add x y
  rw [h_zero, zero_mul] at h
  exact (mul_ne_zero (num_ne_zero hxy) (mul_ne_zero x.denom_ne_zero y.denom_ne_zero)) h

name: exists_
statement:
lemma exists_φ_coeff_not_mem (h : E ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ i, (φ E).coeff i ∉ (algebraMap K E).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← notMem_map_range]
  intro ⟨f, hf⟩
  rw [coe_mapRingHom] at hf
  refine transcendental_X ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective K E)).mp
    exact hf ▸ φ_ne_zero h
  · simpa using congr(aeval (X : K⟮X⟯) $(hf))

name: generator_eq_coeff
statement: lemma generator_eq_coeff (h : E ≠ ⊥) : generator E = (φ E).coeff (generatorIndex h)
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right h

name: b_ne_zero
statement: lemma b_ne_zero : b E ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero <| (IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec _
    ((φ E).map (algebraMap ..))).choose_spec.1

name: c_ne_zero
statement: lemma c_ne_zero (h : E ≠ ⊥) : c E ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨inv_ne_zero <| (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff _ _).not.mpr <|
    content_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr (Φ'_ne_zero h),
  (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff _ _).not.mpr b_ne_zero⟩

name: C_c_mul_
statement:
lemma C_c_mul_φ (h : E ≠ ⊥) :
    Polynomial.C (c E) * (φ E).map (algebraMap E K⟮X⟯) = (Φ E).map (algebraMap ..)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
  conv =>
    enter [1, 2]
    rw [← Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul, algebraMap_smul, ← Φ'_map, eq_C_content_mul_primPart (Φ' E)]
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀, map_one, one_mul]
  · rw [ne_eq, FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff, content_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Φ'_ne_zero h

name: c_denom
statement: lemma c_denom (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (c E).denom = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Φ_coeff_φ_natDegree h]
  exact denom_algebraMap _

name: generator_denom_dvd_c_num
statement: lemma generator_denom_dvd_c_num (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (g E) ∣ (c E).num
proof:
:= by
  rw [denom_dvd (num_ne_zero (c_ne_zero h))]
  use (Φ E).coeff (generatorIndex h)
  rw [Φ_coeff_generatorIndex h,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (algebraMap_ne_zero (num_ne_zero (c_ne_zero h)))]

name: le_
statement:
lemma le_Φ_coeff_generatorIndex_natDegree (h : E ≠ ⊥) :
    (f E).natDegree ≤ ((Φ E).coeff (generatorIndex h)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have := congr($(Φ_coeff_generatorIndex h) * algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯ (g E))
  conv at this => enter [2, 1, 2]; rw [← num_div_denom (generator E)]
  rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (algebraMap_ne_zero (generator E).denom_ne_zero),
    ← map_mul, ← map_mul] at this
  replace this := congr($(algebraMap_injective K this).natDegree)
  rw [natDegree_mul (Φ_coeff_generatorIndex_ne_zero h) (generator E).denom_ne_zero,
    natDegree_mul (num_ne_zero (c_ne_zero h)) (num_ne_zero (generator_ne_zero h))] at this
  grind [natDegree_le_of_dvd (generator_denom_dvd_c_num h) (num_ne_zero (c_ne_zero h))]

name: le_
statement:
lemma le_Φ_coeff_natDegree_natDegree (h : E ≠ ⊥) :
    (g E).natDegree ≤ ((Φ E).coeff (φ E).natDegree).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_coeff_φ_natDegree' h]
  exact natDegree_le_of_dvd (generator_denom_dvd_c_num h) (num_ne_zero (c_ne_zero h))

name: m_le_swap_
statement:
lemma m_le_swap_Φ_natDegree (h : E ≠ ⊥) :
    m E ≤ (Bivariate.swap (Φ E)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_monomial_eq (Φ E), sum_def, map_sum]
  conv in (fun _ ↦ _) =>
    ext
    rw [Bivariate.swap_monomial, mul_comm, ← Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul,
      ← monomial_one_right_eq_X_pow, ← Polynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [natDegree_sum_eq_of_linearIndepOn _
    (coe_basisMonomials K ▸ (basisMonomials K).linearIndepOn (Φ E).support)]
  apply max_le
  · exact (le_Φ_coeff_generatorIndex_natDegree h).trans <|
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ ((Φ E).coeff i).natDegree) <|
      mem_support_iff.mpr (Φ_coeff_generatorIndex_ne_zero h)
  · exact (le_Φ_coeff_natDegree_natDegree h).trans <|
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ ((Φ E).coeff i).natDegree) <|
      mem_support_iff.mpr (Φ_coeff_φ_natDegree_ne_zero h)

name: q_ne_zero
statement: lemma q_ne_zero (h : E ≠ ⊥) : q E ≠ 0
proof:
:= right_ne_zero_of_mul <|
  φ_mul_q (E := E) ▸ Polynomial.map_ne_zero <|
    (generator E).minpolyX_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr (generator_ne_C h)

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₀_ne_zero (h : E ≠ ⊥) : Q₀ E ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact C_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero (algebraMap_ne_zero (generator E).denom_ne_zero) (c_ne_zero h))
  · exact Polynomial.map_ne_zero (q_ne_zero h)

name: swap_
statement: lemma swap_θ : Bivariate.swap (θ E) = -(θ E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, Bivariate.swap_C, Bivariate.swap_map_C, Bivariate.swap_C,
    Bivariate.swap_map_C]
  ring

name: Q
statement:
lemma Q₀_mul_Φ (h : E ≠ ⊥) :
    Q₀ E * (Φ E).map (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯) = (θ E).map (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    Polynomial.C ((algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯) (g E)) * (q E).map (algebraMap (↥E) K⟮X⟯) *
       (φ E).map (algebraMap (↥E) K⟮X⟯) = (θ E).map (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯) by
    rw [← C_c_mul_φ h, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ (Polynomial.C (c E)) _,
      mul_comm _ (Polynomial.C (c E))]
    simpa only [← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (c_ne_zero h)] using this
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.map_mul, mul_comm (q E) (φ E), φ_mul_q, Polynomial.map_map,
    Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply, Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, mul_sub,
    ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, (inclusion adjoin_generator_le).algebraMap_toAlgebra,
    AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, coe_inclusion, coe_algebraMap]
  conv => enter [1, 2, 1, 2, 2]; rw [← num_div_denom (generator E)]
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (algebraMap_ne_zero (generator E).denom_ne_zero), Polynomial.map_sub,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, map_C, Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map]
  rfl

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₀_mem_lifts (h : E ≠ ⊥) : Q₀ E ∈ lifts (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Φ' E).isPrimitive_primPart.mul_map_mem_lifts_iff.mp
  rw [Q₀_mul_Φ h]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: map_Q
statement: lemma map_Q₁ (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (Q₁ h).map (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯) = Q₀ E
proof:
:=
  (Q₀_mem_lifts h).choose_spec

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₁_ne_zero (h : E ≠ ⊥) : Q₁ h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun Polynomial.map (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯)
  rw [map_Q₁, Polynomial.map_zero]
  exact Q₀_ne_zero h

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₁_mul_Φ (h : E ≠ ⊥) : Q₁ h * Φ E = θ E
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun Polynomial.map (algebraMap K[X] K⟮X⟯) using
    Polynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap_injective K)
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul, map_Q₁, Q₀_mul_Φ h]

name: swap_Q
statement: lemma swap_Q₁_natDegree (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (Bivariate.swap (Q₁ h)).natDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Q₁ h * Φ E = θ E := Q₁_mul_Φ h
  apply_fun Bivariate.swap at this
  rw [map_mul] at this
  apply_fun natDegree at this
  rw [natDegree_mul
    ((map_ne_zero_iff _ Bivariate.swap.injective).mpr (Q₁_ne_zero h))
    ((map_ne_zero_iff _ Bivariate.swap.injective).mpr (Φ_ne_zero h))] at this
  have h₁ : (Bivariate.swap (θ E)).natDegree ≤ m E := by
    rw [swap_θ, natDegree_neg]
    exact θ_natDegree_le h
  grind [m_le_swap_Φ_natDegree h]

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₂_map (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (Q₂ h).map Polynomial.C = Q₁ h
proof:
:= by
  have := eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero (swap_Q₁_natDegree h)
  apply_fun Bivariate.swap at this
  rw [Bivariate.swap_swap_apply, Bivariate.swap_C] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₂_ne_zero (h : E ≠ ⊥) : Q₂ h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun Polynomial.map Polynomial.C
  rw [Polynomial.map_zero, Q₂_map]
  exact Q₁_ne_zero h

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₂_mul_Φ (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (Q₂ h).map Polynomial.C * Φ E = θ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q₂_map h, Q₁_mul_Φ h]

name: Q
statement: lemma Q₂_natDegree (h : E ≠ ⊥) : (Q₂ h).natDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  
  by_contra H
  apply (generator E).eq_C_iff.not.mp (generator_ne_C h)
  let F := AlgebraicClosure K
  rw [natDegree_eq_zero_iff_degree_le_zero.not, ← degree_map _ (algebraMap K F)] at H
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root ((Q₂ h).map (algebraMap K F)) (ne_of_not_ge H).symm
  
  rw [IsRoot.def, eval_map_algebraMap] at hα
  have eq :
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap K F)) (g E) * Polynomial.C ((aeval α) (f E)) =
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap K F)) (f E) * Polynomial.C ((aeval α) (g E)) := by
    have := congr(aeval (Polynomial.C α) $(Q₂_mul_Φ h)).symm
    rwa [aeval_mul, ← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (by ext; simp), hα, map_zero, zero_mul, aeval_sub,
      aeval_mul, aeval_mul, aeval_C, aeval_C, ← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (by ext; simp),
      ← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (by ext; simp), algebraMap_def, coe_mapRingHom, sub_eq_zero,
      ← Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom] at this
  obtain ⟨isUnit₁, isUnit₂⟩ :
      IsUnit (Polynomial.C <| aeval α (f E)) ∧ IsUnit (Polynomial.C <| aeval α (g E)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.isUnit_C, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Polynomial.isUnit_C, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    obtain (H | H) := aeval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime (generator E).isCoprime_num_denom α
    · refine ⟨H, Polynomial.C_injective.ne_iff.mp ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, ← mul_ne_zero_iff_left <| Polynomial.map_ne_zero <|
        num_ne_zero (generator_ne_zero h)]
      exact eq ▸ mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.map_ne_zero (generator E).denom_ne_zero) <|
        Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr H
    · refine ⟨Polynomial.C_injective.ne_iff.mp ?_, H⟩
      rw [map_zero, ← mul_ne_zero_iff_left <| Polynomial.map_ne_zero (generator E).denom_ne_zero]
      exact eq ▸ mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.map_ne_zero (num_ne_zero (generator_ne_zero h))) <|
        Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr H
  
  have isCoprime := IsCoprime.map (generator E).isCoprime_num_denom <|
    Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap K F)
  have : Associated ((f E).mapRingHom (algebraMap K F)) ((g E).mapRingHom (algebraMap K F)) := by
    rw [← associated_mul_isUnit_left_iff isUnit₂, Associated.comm]
    exact ⟨isUnit₁.unit, by simpa⟩
  have := isCoprime.isUnit_of_associated this
  exact ⟨by simpa using (natDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit this.1),
    by simpa using (natDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit this.2)⟩

name: swap_
statement:
lemma swap_Φ_natDegree_eq_θ_natDegree (h : E ≠ ⊥) :

name: liftOn_ofFractionRing_mk
statement:
theorem liftOn_ofFractionRing_mk {P : Sort v} (n : K[X]) (d : K[X]⁰) (f : K[X] → K[X] → P)
    (H : ∀ {p q p' q'} (_hq : q ∈ K[X]⁰) (_hq' : q' ∈ K[X]⁰), q' * p = q * p' → f p q = f p' q') :
    RatFunc.liftOn (ofFractionRing (Localization.mk n d)) f @H = f n d
proof:
:= by
  rw [RatFunc.liftOn]
  exact Localization.liftOn_mk _ _ _ _

name: liftOn_condition_of_liftOn'_condition
proof:
:=
  calc
    f p q = f (q' * p) (q' * q) := (H hq hq').symm
    _ = f (q * p') (q * q') := by rw [h, mul_comm q']
    _ = f p' q' := H hq' hq

statement:

name: mk_eq_mk
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk {p q p' q' : K[X]} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq' : q' ≠ 0) :
    RatFunc.mk p q = RatFunc.mk p' q' ↔ p * q' = p' * q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_def_of_ne _ hq, mk_def_of_ne _ hq', ofFractionRing_injective.eq_iff,
    IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq',
    (IsFractionRing.injective K[X] (FractionRing K[X])).eq_iff]

name: liftOn_mk
statement:
theorem liftOn_mk {P : Sort v} (p q : K[X]) (f : K[X] → K[X] → P) (f0 : ∀ p, f p 0 = f 0 1)
    (H' : ∀ {p q p' q'} (_hq : q ≠ 0) (_hq' : q' ≠ 0), q' * p = q * p' → f p q = f p' q')
    (H : ∀ {p q p' q'} (_hq : q ∈ K[X]⁰) (_hq' : q' ∈ K[X]⁰), q' * p = q * p' → f p q = f p' q' :=
      fun {_ _ _ _} hq hq' h => H' (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hq) (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hq') h) :
    (RatFunc.mk p q).liftOn f @H = f p q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · subst hq
    simp only [mk_zero, f0, ← Localization.mk_zero 1,
      liftOn_ofFractionRing_mk, Submonoid.coe_one]
  · simp only [mk_eq_localization_mk _ hq, liftOn_ofFractionRing_mk]

name: liftOn'_mk
statement:
theorem liftOn'_mk {P : Sort v} (p q : K[X]) (f : K[X] → K[X] → P) (f0 : ∀ p, f p 0 = f 0 1)
    (H : ∀ {p q a} (_hq : q ≠ 0) (_ha : a ≠ 0), f (a * p) (a * q) = f p q) :
    (RatFunc.mk p q).liftOn' f @H = f p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [RatFunc.liftOn', RatFunc.liftOn_mk _ _ _ f0]
  apply liftOn_condition_of_liftOn'_condition H

name: intDegree_mul
statement:
theorem intDegree_mul {x y : K⟮X⟯} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    intDegree (x * y) = intDegree x + intDegree y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intDegree, add_sub, sub_add, sub_sub_eq_add_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add]
  norm_cast
  rw [← Polynomial.natDegree_mul x.denom_ne_zero y.denom_ne_zero, ←
    Polynomial.natDegree_mul (RatFunc.num_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hx hy))
      (mul_ne_zero x.denom_ne_zero y.denom_ne_zero),
    ← Polynomial.natDegree_mul (RatFunc.num_ne_zero hx) (RatFunc.num_ne_zero hy), ←
    Polynomial.natDegree_mul (mul_ne_zero (RatFunc.num_ne_zero hx) (RatFunc.num_ne_zero hy))
      (x * y).denom_ne_zero,
    RatFunc.num_denom_mul]

proof:

  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, intDegree_mul, intDegree_inv, ← sub_eq_add_neg] <;> grind

name: intDegree_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intDegree_neg (x : K⟮X⟯) : intDegree (-x) = intDegree x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, neg_zero]
  · rw [intDegree, intDegree, ← natDegree_neg x.num]
    exact
      natDegree_sub_eq_of_prod_eq (num_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hx)) (denom_ne_zero (-x))
        (neg_ne_zero.mpr (num_ne_zero hx)) (denom_ne_zero x) (num_denom_neg x)

name: intDegree_add
statement:
theorem intDegree_add {x y : K⟮X⟯} (hxy : x + y ≠ 0) :
    (x + y).intDegree =
      (x.num * y.denom + x.denom * y.num).natDegree - (x.denom * y.denom).natDegree
proof:
:=
  natDegree_sub_eq_of_prod_eq (num_ne_zero hxy) (x + y).denom_ne_zero
    (num_mul_denom_add_denom_mul_num_ne_zero hxy) (mul_ne_zero x.denom_ne_zero y.denom_ne_zero)
    (num_denom_add x y)

name: natDegree_num_mul_right_sub_natDegree_denom_mul_left_eq_intDegree
proof:
:= by
  apply natDegree_sub_eq_of_prod_eq (mul_ne_zero (num_ne_zero hx) hs)
    (mul_ne_zero hs x.denom_ne_zero) (num_ne_zero hx) x.denom_ne_zero
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: intDegree_add_le
statement:
theorem intDegree_add_le {x y : K⟮X⟯} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : x + y ≠ 0) :
    intDegree (x + y) ≤ max (intDegree x) (intDegree y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  rw [intDegree_add hxy, ←
    natDegree_num_mul_right_sub_natDegree_denom_mul_left_eq_intDegree hx y.denom_ne_zero,
    mul_comm y.denom, ←
    natDegree_num_mul_right_sub_natDegree_denom_mul_left_eq_intDegree hy x.denom_ne_zero,
    le_max_iff, sub_le_sub_iff_right, Int.ofNat_le, sub_le_sub_iff_right, Int.ofNat_le, ←
    le_max_iff, mul_comm y.num]
  exact natDegree_add_le _ _

  rwa [← mem_extendScalars (le_refl F), eq_of_le_of_finrank_le''

    (s • x : F.extendRight M) = s • (x : M)
proof: := rfl

name: coe_extendRightEquiv'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_extendRightEquiv' (a : F) :
    (extendRightEquiv' F M S a : M) = algebraMap F M a
proof: := rfl

name: algebraMap_extendRightEquiv'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_extendRightEquiv' (a : F) :
    algebraMap (F.extendRight M) M (extendRightEquiv' F M S a) = algebraMap F M a
proof: := rfl

name: algebraMap_extendRightEquiv'_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_extendRightEquiv'_symm (a : F.extendRight M) :
    algebraMap F M ((extendRightEquiv' F M S).symm a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_extendRightEquiv' F M S, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, algebraMap_apply]

name: restrictScalars_le_iff
statement:
lemma restrictScalars_le_iff (K : Type*) {L E : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    [Field E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra L E] [IsScalarTower K L E]
    {E₁ E₂ : IntermediateField L E} : E₁.restrictScalars K ≤ E₂.restrictScalars K ↔ E₁ ≤ E₂
proof: := .rfl

name: FG.of_restrictScalars
statement:
lemma FG.of_restrictScalars {K L E : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Field E]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra L E] [IsScalarTower K L E]
    {E' : IntermediateField L E} (H : (E'.restrictScalars K).FG) : E'.FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := H
  refine ⟨s, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [adjoin_le_iff]
    exact (subset_adjoin K _).trans_eq congr(($hs : Set E))
  · rw [← restrictScalars_le_iff K, ← hs, adjoin_le_iff]
    exact subset_adjoin L _

name: mem_adjoin_range_iff
statement:
theorem mem_adjoin_range_iff {ι : Type*} (i : ι → E) (x : E) :
    x ∈ adjoin F (Set.range i) ↔ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial ι F,
      x = MvPolynomial.aeval i r / MvPolynomial.aeval i s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_adjoin_iff_div, Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval,
    AlgHom.mem_range, exists_exists_eq_and]

name: mem_adjoin_iff
statement:
theorem mem_adjoin_iff (x : E) :
    x ∈ adjoin F S ↔ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial S F,
      x = MvPolynomial.aeval Subtype.val r / MvPolynomial.aeval Subtype.val s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_adjoin_range_iff, Subtype.range_coe]

name: mem_adjoin_simple_iff
statement:
theorem mem_adjoin_simple_iff {α : E} (x : E) :
    x ∈ adjoin F {α} ↔ ∃ r s : F[X], x = aeval α r / aeval α s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_adjoin_iff_div, Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval,
    AlgHom.mem_range, exists_exists_eq_and]

name: forall_mem_adjoin_smul_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem forall_mem_adjoin_smul_eq_self_iff {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [MulSemiringAction M E]
    [SMulCommClass M F E] (m : M) :
    (∀ x ∈ adjoin F S, m • x = x) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, m • x = x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [-adjoin_le_iff, Set.subset_def, SetLike.le_def, FixedBy.intermediateField_mem_iff] using
    adjoin_le_iff (T := FixedBy.intermediateField F E m)

name: rank_sup_le_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem rank_sup_le_of_isAlgebraic
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E1 ∨ Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E2) :
    Module.rank K ↥(E1 ⊔ E2) ≤ Module.rank K E1 * Module.rank K E2
proof:
:= by
  have := E1.toSubalgebra.rank_sup_le_of_free E2.toSubalgebra
  rwa [← sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic E1 E2 halg] at this

name: finrank_sup_le
statement:
theorem finrank_sup_le :
    finrank K ↥(E1 ⊔ E2) ≤ finrank K E1 * finrank K E2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : FiniteDimensional K E1
  · have := E1.toSubalgebra.finrank_sup_le_of_free E2.toSubalgebra
    change _ ≤ finrank K E1 * finrank K E2 at this
    rwa [← sup_toSubalgebra_of_left] at this
  rw [FiniteDimensional, ← rank_lt_aleph0_iff, not_lt] at h
  have := LinearMap.rank_le_of_injective _ <| Submodule.inclusion_injective <|
    show Subalgebra.toSubmodule E1.toSubalgebra ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra by
      simp
  rw [show finrank K E1 = 0 from Cardinal.toNat_apply_of_aleph0_le h,
    show finrank K ↥(E1 ⊔ E2) = 0 from Cardinal.toNat_apply_of_aleph0_le (h.trans this), zero_mul]

name: coe_iSup_of_directed
statement:
theorem coe_iSup_of_directed [Nonempty ι] (dir : Directed (· ≤ ·) t) :
    ↑(iSup t) = ⋃ i, (t i : Set L)
proof:
:=
  let M : IntermediateField K L :=
    { __ := Subalgebra.copy _ _ (Subalgebra.coe_iSup_of_directed dir).symm
      inv_mem' := fun _ hx ↦ have ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, (t i).inv_mem hi⟩ }
  have : iSup t = M := le_antisymm
    (iSup_le fun i ↦ le_iSup (fun i ↦ (t i : Set L)) i) (Set.iUnion_subset fun _ ↦ le_iSup t _)
  this.symm ▸ rfl

name: toSubalgebra_iSup_of_directed
statement:
theorem toSubalgebra_iSup_of_directed (dir : Directed (· ≤ ·) t) :
    (iSup t).toSubalgebra = ⨆ i, (t i).toSubalgebra
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp_rw [iSup_of_empty, bot_toSubalgebra]
  · exact SetLike.ext' ((coe_iSup_of_directed dir).trans (Subalgebra.coe_iSup_of_directed dir).symm)

name: finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finset'
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finset'
    {s : Finset ι} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, FiniteDimensional K (t i)) :
    FiniteDimensional K (⨆ i ∈ s, t i : IntermediateField K L)
proof:
:=
  have := Subtype.forall'.mp h
  iSup_subtype'' s t ▸ IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finite

name: isSplittingField_iSup
proof:
:= by
  let F : IntermediateField K L := ⨆ i ∈ s, t i
  have hF : ∀ i ∈ s, t i ≤ F := fun i hi ↦ le_iSup_of_le i (le_iSup (fun _ ↦ t i) hi)
  simp only [isSplittingField_iff, Polynomial.map_prod] at h ⊢
  refine ⟨Splits.prod fun i hi ↦ by
    simpa [Polynomial.map_map] using (h i hi).1.map (inclusion (hF i hi)).toRingHom, ?_⟩
  simp only [rootSet_prod p s h0, ← Set.iSup_eq_iUnion, (@gc K _ L _ _).l_iSup₂]
  exact iSup_congr fun i ↦ iSup_congr fun hi ↦ (h i hi).2

name: adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic (L : IntermediateField F K)
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E ∨ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L) :
    Module.rank E (adjoin E (L : Set K)) ≤ Module.rank F L
proof:
:= by
  have h : (adjoin E (L.toSubalgebra : Set K)).toSubalgebra =
      Algebra.adjoin E (L.toSubalgebra : Set K) :=
    L.adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic E halg
  have := L.toSubalgebra.adjoin_rank_le E
  rwa [(Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ h).symm.toLinearEquiv.rank_eq] at this

name: adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic_left
statement:
theorem adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic_left (L : IntermediateField F K)
    [halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    Module.rank E (adjoin E (L : Set K)) ≤ Module.rank F L
proof:
:=
  adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic E L (Or.inl halg)

name: adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic_right
statement:
theorem adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic_right (L : IntermediateField F K)
    [halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L] :
    Module.rank E (adjoin E (L : Set K)) ≤ Module.rank F L
proof:
:=
  adjoin_rank_le_of_isAlgebraic E L (Or.inr halg)

name: adjoin_simple_isCompactElement
statement: theorem adjoin_simple_isCompactElement (x : E) : IsCompactElement F⟮x⟯
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le,
    adjoin_simple_le_iff, sSup_eq_iSup', ← exists_prop]
  intro s hne hs hx
  have := hne.to_subtype
  rwa [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_iSup_of_directed hs.directed_val, mem_iUnion, Subtype.exists] at hx

name: adjoin_finset_isCompactElement
statement:
theorem adjoin_finset_isCompactElement (S : Finset E) :
    IsCompactElement (adjoin F S : IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← biSup_adjoin_simple]
  simp_rw [Finset.mem_coe, ← Finset.sup_eq_iSup]
  exact isCompactElement_finsetSup S fun x _ => adjoin_simple_isCompactElement x

name: adjoin_finite_isCompactElement
statement: theorem adjoin_finite_isCompactElement {S : Set E} (h : S.Finite) : IsCompactElement (adjoin F S)
proof:
:=
  Finite.coe_toFinset h ▸ adjoin_finset_isCompactElement h.toFinset

name: exists_finset_of_mem_iSup
statement:
theorem exists_finset_of_mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {f : ι → IntermediateField F E} {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, f i) : ∃ s : Finset ι, x ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= by
  have := (adjoin_simple_isCompactElement x).exists_finset_of_le_iSup f
  simp only [adjoin_simple_le_iff] at this
  exact this hx

name: exists_finset_of_mem_supr'
statement:
theorem exists_finset_of_mem_supr' {ι : Type*} {f : ι → IntermediateField F E} {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, f i) : ∃ s : Finset (Σ i, f i), x ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, F⟮(i.2 : E)⟯
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_finset_of_mem_iSup (SetLike.le_def.mp (iSup_le fun i x h ↦ ?_) hx)
  exact SetLike.le_def.mp (le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, x, h⟩ (by simp)) (mem_adjoin_simple_self F x)

name: exists_finset_of_mem_supr''
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_finset_of_mem_iSup (SetLike.le_def.mp (iSup_le (fun i x1 hx1 => ?_)) hx)
  refine SetLike.le_def.mp (le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, x1, hx1⟩ ?_)
    (subset_adjoin F (rootSet (minpoly F x1) E) ?_)
  · rw [IntermediateField.minpoly_eq, Subtype.coe_mk]
  · rw [mem_rootSet_of_ne, minpoly.aeval]
    exact minpoly.ne_zero (isIntegral_iff.mp (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (⟨x1, hx1⟩ : f i)))

name: exists_finset_of_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem exists_finset_of_mem_adjoin {S : Set E} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ adjoin F S) :
    ∃ T : Finset E, (T : Set E) ⊆ S ∧ x ∈ adjoin F (T : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← biSup_adjoin_simple S, ← iSup_subtype''] at hx
  obtain ⟨s, hx'⟩ := exists_finset_of_mem_iSup hx
  classical
  refine ⟨s.image Subtype.val, by simp, SetLike.le_def.mp ?_ hx'⟩
  simp_rw [Finset.coe_image, iSup_le_iff, adjoin_le_iff]
  rintro _ h _ rfl
  exact subset_adjoin F _ ⟨_, h, rfl⟩

name: adjoin_simple_add_algebraMap
statement: theorem adjoin_simple_add_algebraMap (x : E) (y : F) : F⟮x + algebraMap F E y⟯ = F⟮x⟯
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [adjoin_le_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
    exact add_mem (mem_adjoin_simple_self F x) (algebraMap_mem _ y)
  · rw [adjoin_simple_le_iff]
    convert IntermediateField.sub_mem _ (mem_adjoin_simple_self F _) (algebraMap_mem _ y)
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]

name: adjoin_simple_mul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_mul_algebraMap (x : E) (y : F) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    F⟮x * algebraMap F E y⟯ = F⟮x⟯
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [adjoin_le_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
    exact mul_mem (mem_adjoin_simple_self F x) (algebraMap_mem _ y)
  · rw [adjoin_simple_le_iff]
    convert IntermediateField.div_mem _ (mem_adjoin_simple_self F _) (algebraMap_mem _ y)
    rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ x (by rwa [_root_.map_ne_zero])]

name: rank_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_eq_one_iff : Module.rank F K = 1 ↔ K = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toSubalgebra_inj, ← rank_eq_rank_subalgebra, Subalgebra.rank_eq_one_iff,
    bot_toSubalgebra]

name: finrank_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_eq_one_iff : finrank F K = 1 ↔ K = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toSubalgebra_inj, ← finrank_eq_finrank_subalgebra, Subalgebra.finrank_eq_one_iff,
    bot_toSubalgebra]

name: rank_bot
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem rank_bot : Module.rank F (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_eq_one_iff]

name: finrank_bot
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem finrank_bot : finrank F (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_eq_one_iff]

name: rank_bot'
statement: @[simp] theorem rank_bot' : Module.rank (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) E = Module.rank F E
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rank_mul_rank F (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) E, IntermediateField.rank_bot, one_mul]

name: finrank_bot'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_bot' : finrank (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) E = finrank F E
proof:
:=
  congr(Cardinal.toNat $(rank_bot'))

name: rank_top
statement: @[simp] protected theorem rank_top : Module.rank (⊤ : IntermediateField F E) E = 1
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.bot_eq_top_iff_rank_eq_one.mp <| top_le_iff.mp fun x _ ↦ ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, rfl⟩

name: finrank_top
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem finrank_top : finrank (⊤ : IntermediateField F E) E = 1
proof:
:=
  rank_eq_one_iff_finrank_eq_one.mp IntermediateField.rank_top

name: rank_top'
statement: @[simp] theorem rank_top' : Module.rank F (⊤ : IntermediateField F E) = Module.rank F E
proof:
:=
  rank_top F E

name: finrank_top'
statement: @[simp] theorem finrank_top' : finrank F (⊤ : IntermediateField F E) = finrank F E
proof:
:=
  finrank_top F E

name: finrank_eq_one_iff_eq_top
statement:
lemma finrank_eq_one_iff_eq_top {K : IntermediateField F E} :
    Module.finrank K E = 1 ↔ K = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, (· ▸ IntermediateField.finrank_top)⟩
  rw [← Subalgebra.bot_eq_top_iff_finrank_eq_one, ← top_le_iff, ← top_le_iff]
  intro H x _
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := @H x IntermediateField.mem_top
  exact x.2

name: bot_eq_top_iff_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem bot_eq_top_iff_finrank_eq_one :
    (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = ⊤ ↔ Module.finrank F E = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IntermediateField.finrank_bot', ← finrank_eq_one_iff_eq_top]

name: isSimpleOrder_of_finrank_prime
statement:
theorem isSimpleOrder_of_finrank_prime (hp : Nat.Prime (Module.finrank F E)) :
    IsSimpleOrder (IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:= by
  refine { toNontrivial := ?_, eq_bot_or_eq_top := ?_ }
  · exact ⟨⊥, ⊤, fun h ↦ Nat.prime_one_false (bot_eq_top_iff_finrank_eq_one.mp h ▸ hp)⟩
  · intro K
    simpa [← toSubalgebra_strictMono.apply_eq_bot_iff, ← toSubalgebra_strictMono.apply_eq_top_iff]
      using (Subalgebra.isSimpleOrder_of_finrank_prime _ _ hp).eq_bot_or_eq_top K.toSubalgebra

name: rank_adjoin_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem rank_adjoin_eq_one_iff : Module.rank F (adjoin F S) = 1 ↔ S ⊆ (⊥ : IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans rank_eq_one_iff adjoin_eq_bot_iff

name: rank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem rank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff :
    Module.rank F F⟮α⟯ = 1 ↔ α ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_adjoin_eq_one_iff]; exact Set.singleton_subset_iff

name: finrank_adjoin_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem finrank_adjoin_eq_one_iff : finrank F (adjoin F S) = 1 ↔ S ⊆ (⊥ : IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans finrank_eq_one_iff adjoin_eq_bot_iff

name: finrank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff :
    finrank F F⟮α⟯ = 1 ↔ α ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_adjoin_eq_one_iff]; exact Set.singleton_subset_iff

name: bot_eq_top_of_rank_adjoin_eq_one
statement:
theorem bot_eq_top_of_rank_adjoin_eq_one (h : ∀ x : E, Module.rank F F⟮x⟯ = 1) :
    (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [iff_true_right IntermediateField.mem_top]
  exact rank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff.mp (h y)

name: bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_eq_one
statement:
theorem bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_eq_one (h : ∀ x : E, finrank F F⟮x⟯ = 1) :
    (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [iff_true_right IntermediateField.mem_top]
  exact finrank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff.mp (h y)

name: subsingleton_of_rank_adjoin_eq_one
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_rank_adjoin_eq_one (h : ∀ x : E, Module.rank F F⟮x⟯ = 1) :
    Subsingleton (IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_of_bot_eq_top (bot_eq_top_of_rank_adjoin_eq_one h)

name: subsingleton_of_finrank_adjoin_eq_one
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_finrank_adjoin_eq_one (h : ∀ x : E, finrank F F⟮x⟯ = 1) :
    Subsingleton (IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_of_bot_eq_top (bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_eq_one h)

name: bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_le_one
statement:
theorem bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_le_one [FiniteDimensional F E]
    (h : ∀ x : E, finrank F F⟮x⟯ ≤ 1) : (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_eq_one
  exact fun x => by linarith [h x, show 0 < finrank F F⟮x⟯ from finrank_pos]

name: subsingleton_of_finrank_adjoin_le_one
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_finrank_adjoin_le_one [FiniteDimensional F E]
    (h : ∀ x : E, finrank F F⟮x⟯ ≤ 1) : Subsingleton (IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_of_bot_eq_top (bot_eq_top_of_finrank_adjoin_le_one h)

name: minpoly_gen
statement:
theorem minpoly_gen (α : E) :
    minpoly F (AdjoinSimple.gen F α) = minpoly F α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minpoly.algebraMap_eq (algebraMap F⟮α⟯ E).injective, AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen]

name: aeval_gen_minpoly
statement: theorem aeval_gen_minpoly (α : E) : aeval (AdjoinSimple.gen F α) (minpoly F α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  convert! minpoly.aeval F α
  conv in aeval α => rw [← AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen F α]
  exact (aeval_algebraMap_apply E (AdjoinSimple.gen F α) _).symm

name: adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root
statement:
theorem adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root (h : IsIntegral F α) :
    adjoinRootEquivAdjoin F h (AdjoinRoot.root (minpoly F α)) = AdjoinSimple.gen F α
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.lift_root (aeval_gen_minpoly F α)

name: adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_symm_apply_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_symm_apply_gen (h : IsIntegral F α) :
    (adjoinRootEquivAdjoin F h).symm (AdjoinSimple.gen F α) = AdjoinRoot.root (minpoly F α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root]

name: adjoin_root_eq_top
statement: theorem adjoin_root_eq_top (p : K[X]) [Fact (Irreducible p)] : K⟮AdjoinRoot.root p⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (eq_adjoin_of_eq_algebra_adjoin K _ ⊤ (AdjoinRoot.adjoinRoot_eq_top (f := p)).symm).symm

name: adjoin.finiteDimensional
statement: theorem adjoin.finiteDimensional {x : L} (hx : IsIntegral K x) : FiniteDimensional K K⟮x⟯
proof:
:=
  (adjoin.powerBasis hx).finite

name: isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple {x : L} (hx : IsIntegral K x) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K K⟮x⟯
proof:
:=
  have := adjoin.finiteDimensional hx; Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite K K⟮x⟯

name: adjoin.finrank
statement:
@[stacks 09GN]
theorem adjoin.finrank {x : L} (hx : IsIntegral K x) :
    Module.finrank K K⟮x⟯ = (minpoly K x).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerBasis.finrank (adjoin.powerBasis hx :)]
  rfl

name: adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top [Algebra E K] [IsScalarTower F E K]
    {S : Set K} (hprim : adjoin F S = ⊤) : adjoin E S = ⊤
proof:
:=
  restrictScalars_injective F <| by
    rw [restrictScalars_top, ← top_le_iff, ← hprim, adjoin_le_iff,
      coe_restrictScalars, ← adjoin_le_iff]

name: adjoin_minpoly_coeff_of_exists_primitive_element
statement:
theorem adjoin_minpoly_coeff_of_exists_primitive_element
    [FiniteDimensional F E] (hprim : adjoin F {α} = ⊤) (K : IntermediateField F E) :
    adjoin F ((minpoly K α).map (algebraMap K E)).coeffs = K
proof:
:= by
  set g := (minpoly K α).map (algebraMap K E)
  set K' : IntermediateField F E := adjoin F g.coeffs
  have hsub : K' ≤ K := by
    refine adjoin_le_iff.mpr fun x ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_coeffs_iff]
    rintro ⟨n, -, rfl⟩
    rw [coeff_map]
    apply Subtype.mem
  have dvd_g : minpoly K' α ∣ g.toSubring K'.toSubring (subset_adjoin F _) := by
    apply minpoly.dvd
    rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map]
    erw [g.map_toSubring K'.toSubring]
    rw [eval_map_algebraMap]
    exact minpoly.aeval K α
  have finrank_eq : ∀ K : IntermediateField F E, finrank K E = natDegree (minpoly K α) := by
    intro K
    have := adjoin.finrank (.of_finite K α)
    rw [adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top F hprim] at this
    simp_all
  refine eq_of_le_of_finrank_le' hsub ?_
  simp_rw [finrank_eq]
  convert!
    natDegree_le_of_dvd dvd_g
      ((g.monic_toSubring _ _).mpr <| (minpoly.monic <| .of_finite K α).map _).ne_zero using 1
  rw [natDegree_toSubring, natDegree_map]

name: exists_lt_finrank_of_infinite_dimensional
statement:
theorem exists_lt_finrank_of_infinite_dimensional
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (hnfd : ¬ FiniteDimensional F E) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : IntermediateField F E, FiniteDimensional F L ∧ n < finrank F L
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨⊥, Subalgebra.finite_bot, finrank_pos⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨L, fin, hn⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : E, x ∉ L := by
      contrapose! hnfd
      rw [show L = ⊤ from eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ hnfd x] at fin
      exact topEquiv.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    let L' := L ⊔ F⟮x⟯
    have := adjoin.finiteDimensional (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := F) x)
    refine ⟨L', inferInstance, by_contra fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    have h1 : L = L' := eq_of_le_of_finrank_le le_sup_left ((not_lt.1 h).trans hn)
    have h2 : F⟮x⟯ ≤ L' := le_sup_right
    exact hx <| (h1.symm ▸ h2) <| mem_adjoin_simple_self F x

name: _root_.minpoly.degree_dvd
statement:
theorem _root_.minpoly.degree_dvd {x : L} (hx : IsIntegral K x) :
    (minpoly K x).natDegree ∣ finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  rw [dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_left, ← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hx]
  use finrank K⟮x⟯ L
  rw [mul_comm, finrank_mul_finrank]

name: _root_.Polynomial.Irreducible.natDegree_dvd_finrank
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.Irreducible.natDegree_dvd_finrank {f : K[X]} (hi : Irreducible f)
    (hs : (f.map (algebraMap K L)).Splits) : f.natDegree ∣ finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  have := hi.degree_pos.ne'
  rw [← f.degree_map (algebraMap K L)] at this
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs.exists_eval_eq_zero this
  rw [eval_map_algebraMap] at hx
  have key := minpoly.Irreducible.eq_minpoly hi hx
  replace hi := hi.ne_zero
  rw [key, natDegree_C_mul (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hi)]
  apply minpoly.degree_dvd
  rw [← minpoly.ne_zero_iff]
  contrapose hi
  rwa [hi, mul_zero] at key

name: isAlgebraic_iSup
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hx⟩ := exists_finset_of_mem_supr' hx
  rw [isAlgebraic_iff, Subtype.coe_mk, ← Subtype.coe_mk (p := (· ∈ _)) x hx, ← isAlgebraic_iff]
  have : ∀ i : Σ i, t i, FiniteDimensional K K⟮(i.2 : L)⟯ := fun ⟨i, x⟩ ↦
    adjoin.finiteDimensional (isIntegral_iff.1 (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x))

name: card_algHom_adjoin_integral
statement:
theorem card_algHom_adjoin_integral (h : IsIntegral F α) (h_sep : IsSeparable F α)
    (h_splits : ((minpoly F α).map (algebraMap F K)).Splits) :
    Nat.card (F⟮α⟯ →ₐ[F] K) = (minpoly F α).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fintype (F⟮α⟯ →ₐ[F] K) := fintypeOfAlgHomAdjoinIntegral F h
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, AlgHom.card_of_powerBasis] <;>
    simp only [IsSeparable, adjoin.powerBasis_dim, adjoin.powerBasis_gen, minpoly_gen, h_splits]
  exact h_sep

name: _root_.Polynomial.irreducible_comp
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.irreducible_comp {f g : K[X]} (hfm : f.Monic) (hgm : g.Monic)
    (hf : Irreducible f)
    (hg : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra K E] (x : E) (_ : minpoly K x = f),
      Irreducible (g.map (algebraMap _ _) - C (AdjoinSimple.gen K x))) :
    Irreducible (f.comp g)
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : natDegree f ≠ 0 :=
    fun e ↦ not_irreducible_C (f.coeff 0) (eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero e ▸ hf)
  have hg' : natDegree g ≠ 0 := by
    have := Fact.mk hf
    intro e
    apply not_irreducible_C ((g.map (algebraMap _ _)).coeff 0 - AdjoinSimple.gen K (root f))
    
    rw [RingHom.map_sub, coeff_map, ← map_C, ← eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero e]
    apply hg (AdjoinRoot f)
    rw [AdjoinRoot.minpoly_root hf.ne_zero, hfm, inv_one, map_one, mul_one]
  have H₁ : f.comp g ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by simpa [hf', hg', natDegree_comp] using congr_arg natDegree h
  have H₂ : ¬ IsUnit (f.comp g) := fun h ↦
    by simpa [hf', hg', natDegree_comp] using natDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit h
  have ⟨p, hp₁, hp₂⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor H₂ H₁
  suffices natDegree p = natDegree f * natDegree g from (associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hp₂ H₁
    (this.trans natDegree_comp.symm).ge).irreducible hp₁
  have := Fact.mk hp₁
  let Kx := AdjoinRoot p
  let := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hp₁.ne_zero).finite
  have key₁ : f = minpoly K (aeval (root p) g) := by
    refine minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic hf ?_ hfm
    rw [← aeval_comp]
    exact aeval_eq_zero_of_dvd_aeval_eq_zero hp₂ (AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root p)
  have key₁' : finrank K K⟮aeval (root p) g⟯ = natDegree f := by
    rw [adjoin.finrank, ← key₁]
    exact IsIntegral.of_finite _ _
  have key₂ : g.map (algebraMap _ _) - C (AdjoinSimple.gen K (aeval (root p) g)) =
      minpoly K⟮aeval (root p) g⟯ (root p) :=
    minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic (hg _ _ key₁.symm) (by simp [AdjoinSimple.gen])
      (Monic.sub_of_left (hgm.map _) (degree_lt_degree (by simpa [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] using hg')))
  have key₂' : finrank K⟮aeval (root p) g⟯ Kx = natDegree g := by
    trans natDegree (minpoly K⟮aeval (root p) g⟯ (root p))
    · have : K⟮aeval (root p) g⟯⟮root p⟯ = ⊤ := by
        apply restrictScalars_injective K
        rw [restrictScalars_top, adjoin_adjoin_left, Set.union_comm, ← adjoin_adjoin_left,
          adjoin_root_eq_top p, restrictScalars_adjoin]
        simp
      rw [← finrank_top', ← this, adjoin.finrank]
      exact IsIntegral.of_finite _ _
    · simp [← key₂]
  have := Module.finrank_mul_finrank K K⟮aeval (root p) g⟯ Kx
  rwa [key₁', key₂', (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hp₁.ne_zero).finrank, powerBasis_dim, eq_comm] at this

name: eq_of_root

name: algEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem algEquiv_apply {x y : L} (hx : IsAlgebraic K x) (h_mp : minpoly K x = minpoly K y) :
    algEquiv hx h_mp (AdjoinSimple.gen K x) = AdjoinSimple.gen K y
proof:
:= by
  have hy : IsAlgebraic K y := ⟨minpoly K x, ne_zero hx.isIntegral, (h_mp ▸ aeval _ _)⟩
  rw [algEquiv, trans_apply, ← adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root K hx.isIntegral,
    symm_apply_apply, trans_apply, AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq_root,
    adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root K hy.isIntegral]

name: lift_cardinalMk_adjoin_le
statement:
theorem lift_cardinalMk_adjoin_le {E : Type v} [Field E] [Algebra F E] (s : Set E) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} #(adjoin F s) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} #F ⊔ Cardinal.lift.{u} #s ⊔ ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ↥(adjoin F s) = (adjoin F s).toSubfield from rfl, adjoin_toSubfield]
  apply (Cardinal.lift_le.mpr (Subfield.cardinalMk_closure_le_max _)).trans
  rw [lift_max, sup_le_iff, lift_aleph0]
  refine ⟨(Cardinal.lift_le.mpr ((mk_union_le _ _).trans <| add_le_max _ _)).trans ?_, le_sup_right⟩
  simp_rw [lift_max, lift_aleph0]
  grw [mk_range_le_lift]

    #(adjoin F s) ≤ #F ⊔ #s ⊔ ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lift_cardinalMk_adjoin_le F s

      (Set.union_subset (IntermediateField.set_range_subset T) H)⟩

name: sSup_toSubfield
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sSup_toSubfield (S : Set (IntermediateField F E)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (sSup S).toSubfield = sSup (toSubfield '' S)
proof:
:= by
  have h : toSubfield '' S = Subfield.closure '' SetLike.coe '' S := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    congr! with x
    exact x.toSubfield.closure_eq.symm
  rw [h, sSup_image, ← Subfield.closure_sUnion, sSup_def, adjoin_toSubfield]
  congr 1
  rw [Set.union_eq_right]
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hS
  simp only [Set.mem_sUnion, Set.mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and, SetLike.mem_coe]
  exact ⟨y, hy, algebraMap_mem y x⟩

    (algebraMap (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) F : (⊥ : IntermediateField F E) → F) =

theorem restrictScalars_bot_eq_self (K : IntermediateField F E) :

proof:

name: restrictScalars_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictScalars_top : (⊤ : IntermediateField F E).restrictScalars K = ⊤
proof:

name: restrictScalars_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictScalars_eq_top_iff {L : IntermediateField F E} :

proof:

name: restrictScalars_sup
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_sup :

proof:

name: restrictScalars_inf
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_inf :
    L.restrictScalars K ⊓ L'.restrictScalars K = (L ⊓ L').restrictScalars K
proof: := rfl

name: map_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bot (f : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    IntermediateField.map f ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  toSubalgebra_injective <| Algebra.map_bot _

name: map_sup
statement: theorem map_sup (s t : IntermediateField F E) (f : E →ₐ[F] K) : (s ⊔ t).map f = s.map f ⊔ t.map f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).l_sup

name: map_iSup
statement:
theorem map_iSup {ι : Sort*} (f : E →ₐ[F] K) (s : ι → IntermediateField F E) :
    (iSup s).map f = ⨆ i, (s i).map f
proof:
:=

name: map_inf
statement:
theorem map_inf (s t : IntermediateField F E) (f : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    (s ⊓ t).map f = s.map f ⊓ t.map f
proof: := SetLike.coe_injective (Set.image_inter f.injective)

name: map_iInf
statement:
theorem map_iInf {ι : Sort*} [Nonempty ι] (f : E →ₐ[F] K) (s : ι → IntermediateField F E) :
    (iInf s).map f = ⨅ i, (s i).map f
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  simpa using (Set.injOn_of_injective f.injective).image_iInter_eq (s := SetLike.coe ∘ s)

name: _root_.AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_map
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_map (f : E →ₐ[F] K) :
    f.fieldRange = IntermediateField.map f ⊤
proof:
:=
  SetLike.ext' Set.image_univ.symm

name: _root_.AlgHom.map_fieldRange
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgHom.map_fieldRange {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L]
    (f : E →ₐ[F] K) (g : K →ₐ[F] L) : f.fieldRange.map g = (g.comp f).fieldRange
proof:
:=
  SetLike.ext' (Set.range_comp g f).symm

name: _root_.AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_top
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_top {f : E →ₐ[F] K} :
    f.fieldRange = ⊤ ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:=

name: _root_.AlgEquiv.fieldRange_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.AlgEquiv.fieldRange_eq_top (f : E ≃ₐ[F] K) :

proof:

theorem adjoin_eq_range_algebraMap_adjoin :

proof:

name: adjoin.algebraMap_mem
statement: theorem adjoin.algebraMap_mem (x : F) : algebraMap F E x ∈ adjoin F S

name: adjoin.range_algebraMap_subset
statement: theorem adjoin.range_algebraMap_subset : Set.range (algebraMap F E) ⊆ adjoin F S
proof:
:=
