name: subset_adjoin
statement: theorem subset_adjoin : S ⊆ adjoin F S
proof: := fun _ hx => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr hx)

name: mem_adjoin_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_adjoin_of_mem {S : Set E} {s : E} (hs : s ∈ S) : s ∈ adjoin F S
proof: := subset_adjoin F S hs

name: notMem_of_notMem_adjoin
statement: theorem notMem_of_notMem_adjoin {S : Set E} {s : E} (hs : s ∉ adjoin F S) : s ∉ S
proof:
:= fun h =>
  hs <| mem_adjoin_of_mem F h

name: adjoin.mono
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem adjoin.mono (T : Set E) (h : S ⊆ T) : adjoin F S ≤ adjoin F T
proof:
:=
  GaloisConnection.monotone_l gc h

name: adjoin_contains_field_as_subfield
statement: theorem adjoin_contains_field_as_subfield (F : Subfield E) : (F : Set E) ⊆ adjoin F S
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  adjoin.algebraMap_mem F S ⟨x, hx⟩

name: subset_adjoin_of_subset_left
statement: theorem subset_adjoin_of_subset_left {F : Subfield E} {T : Set E} (HT : T ⊆ F) : T ⊆ adjoin F S
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => (adjoin F S).algebraMap_mem ⟨x, HT hx⟩

name: subset_adjoin_of_subset_right
statement: theorem subset_adjoin_of_subset_right {T : Set E} (H : T ⊆ S) : T ⊆ adjoin F S
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  subset_adjoin F S (H hx)

name: adjoin_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_empty (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] : adjoin F (∅ : Set E) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.mpr (adjoin_le_iff.mpr (Set.empty_subset _))

name: adjoin_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_univ (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] :
    adjoin F (Set.univ : Set E) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr <| subset_adjoin _ _

name: adjoin_union
statement: theorem adjoin_union {S T : Set E} : adjoin F (S ∪ T) = adjoin F S ⊔ adjoin F T
proof:
:=
  gc.l_sup

name: adjoin_le_subfield
statement:
theorem adjoin_le_subfield {K : Subfield E} (HF : Set.range (algebraMap F E) ⊆ K) (HS : S ⊆ K) :
    (adjoin F S).toSubfield ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ⟨HF, HS⟩

name: adjoin_subset_adjoin_iff
statement:
theorem adjoin_subset_adjoin_iff {F' : Type*} [Field F'] [Algebra F' E] {S S' : Set E} :
    (adjoin F S : Set E) ⊆ adjoin F' S' ↔
      Set.range (algebraMap F E) ⊆ adjoin F' S' ∧ S ⊆ adjoin F' S'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨(adjoin.range_algebraMap_subset _ _).trans h,
    (subset_adjoin _ _).trans h⟩, fun ⟨hF, hS⟩ =>
      (Subfield.closure_le (t := (adjoin F' S').toSubfield)).mpr (Set.union_subset hF hS)⟩

name: adjoin_adjoin_left
statement:
theorem adjoin_adjoin_left (T : Set E) :
    (adjoin (adjoin F S) T).restrictScalars _ = adjoin F (S ∪ T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetLike.ext'_iff]
  change (adjoin (adjoin F S) T : Set E) = _
  apply subset_antisymm <;> rw [adjoin_subset_adjoin_iff] <;> constructor
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩; exact adjoin.mono _ _ _ Set.subset_union_left hx
  · exact subset_adjoin_of_subset_right _ _ Set.subset_union_right
  · exact Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun f ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (.inl ⟨f, rfl⟩)
  · exact Set.union_subset
      (fun x hx ↦ Subfield.subset_closure <| .inl ⟨⟨x, Subfield.subset_closure (.inr hx)⟩, rfl⟩)
      (fun x hx ↦ Subfield.subset_closure <| .inr hx)

name: adjoin_adjoin_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma adjoin_adjoin_right {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra K F] [Algebra K E] [IsScalarTower K F E] :
    adjoin F (adjoin K S) = adjoin F S
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (adjoin.mono F S (adjoin K S) (subset_adjoin K S))
  rw [adjoin_le_iff, ← (adjoin F S).coe_restrictScalars K, SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
  simp

name: adjoin_insert_adjoin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_insert_adjoin (x : E) :
    adjoin F (insert x (adjoin F S : Set E)) = adjoin F (insert x S)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Set.singleton_union, adjoin_union, adjoin_adjoin_right]

name: adjoin_adjoin_comm
statement:
theorem adjoin_adjoin_comm (T : Set E) :
    (adjoin (adjoin F S) T).restrictScalars F = (adjoin (adjoin F T) S).restrictScalars F
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, adjoin_adjoin_left, Set.union_comm]

name: adjoin_map
statement:
theorem adjoin_map {E' : Type*} [Field E'] [Algebra F E'] (f : E →ₐ[F] E') :
    (adjoin F S).map f = adjoin F (f '' S)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr <| adjoin_le_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    (adjoin_le_iff.mpr <| Set.monotone_image <| subset_adjoin _ _)

name: lift_adjoin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_adjoin (K : IntermediateField F E) (S : Set K) :
    lift (adjoin F S) = adjoin F (Subtype.val '' S)
proof:
:=
  adjoin_map _ _ _

name: lift_adjoin_simple
statement:
theorem lift_adjoin_simple (K : IntermediateField F E) (α : K) :
    lift (adjoin F {α}) = adjoin F {α.1}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lift_adjoin, Set.image_singleton]

name: lift_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_bot (K : IntermediateField F E) :
    lift (F := K) ⊥ = ⊥
proof: := map_bot _

name: lift_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_top (K : IntermediateField F E) :
    lift (F := K) ⊤ = K
proof: := by rw [lift, ← AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_map, fieldRange_val]

name: lift_sup
statement:
theorem lift_sup (K : IntermediateField F E) (L L' : IntermediateField F K) :
    lift (L ⊔ L') = lift L ⊔ lift L'
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, map_sup]

name: lift_inf
statement:
theorem lift_inf (K : IntermediateField F E) (L L' : IntermediateField F K) :
    lift (L ⊓ L') = lift L ⊓ lift L'
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, map_inf]

name: adjoin_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_self (K : IntermediateField F E) :
    adjoin F K = K
proof: := le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 fun _ ↦ id) (subset_adjoin F _)

name: restrictScalars_adjoin
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_adjoin (K : IntermediateField F E) (S : Set E) :
    restrictScalars F (adjoin K S) = adjoin F (K ∪ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← adjoin_self _ K, adjoin_adjoin_left, adjoin_self _ K]

name: extendScalars_adjoin
statement:
theorem extendScalars_adjoin {K : IntermediateField F E} {S : Set E} (h : K ≤ adjoin F S) :
    extendScalars h = adjoin K S
proof:
:= restrictScalars_injective F <| by
  rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin]
  exact le_antisymm (adjoin.mono F S _ Set.subset_union_right) <| adjoin_le_iff.2 <|
    Set.union_subset h (subset_adjoin F S)

name: restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup (K : IntermediateField F E) (S : Set E) :
    restrictScalars F (adjoin K S) = K ⊔ adjoin F S
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictScalars_adjoin, adjoin_union, adjoin_self]

name: adjoin_iUnion
statement: theorem adjoin_iUnion {ι} (f : ι → Set E) : adjoin F (⋃ i, f i) = ⨆ i, adjoin F (f i)
proof:
:=
  gc.l_iSup

name: iSup_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem iSup_eq_adjoin {ι} (f : ι → IntermediateField F E) :
    ⨆ i, f i = adjoin F (⋃ i, f i : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [adjoin_iUnion, adjoin_self]

name: restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv
    {L L' : Type*} [Field L] [Field L']
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra L E] [Algebra F L'] [Algebra L' E]
    [IsScalarTower F L E] [IsScalarTower F L' E] (i : L ≃ₐ[F] L')
    (hi : algebraMap L E = (algebraMap L' E) ∘ i) (S : Set E) :
    (adjoin L S).restrictScalars F = (adjoin L' S).restrictScalars F
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun toSubfield using (fun K K' h ↦ by
    ext x; change x ∈ K.toSubfield ↔ x ∈ K'.toSubfield; rw [h])
  simp [hi]

name: adjoin_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem adjoin_induction {s : Set E} {p : ∀ x ∈ adjoin F s, Prop}
    (mem : ∀ x hx, p x (subset_adjoin _ _ hx))
    (algebraMap : ∀ x, p (algebraMap F E x) (algebraMap_mem _ _))
    (add : ∀ x y hx hy, p x hx → p y hy → p (x + y) (add_mem hx hy))
    (inv : ∀ x hx, p x hx → p x⁻¹ (inv_mem hx))
    (mul : ∀ x y hx hy, p x hx → p y hy → p (x * y) (mul_mem hx hy))
    {x} (h : x ∈ adjoin F s) : p x h
proof:
:=
  Subfield.closure_induction
    (fun x hx ↦ Or.casesOn hx (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ hx ▸ algebraMap x) (mem x))
    (by simp_rw [← (Algebra.algebraMap F E).map_one]; exact algebraMap 1) add
    (fun x _ h ↦ by
      simp_rw [← neg_one_smul F x, Algebra.smul_def]; exact mul _ _ _ _ (algebraMap _) h) inv mul h

name: adjoin_algHom_ext
statement:
theorem adjoin_algHom_ext {s : Set E} ⦃φ₁ φ₂ : adjoin F s →ₐ[F] K⦄
    (h : ∀ x hx, φ₁ ⟨x, subset_adjoin _ _ hx⟩ = φ₂ ⟨x, subset_adjoin _ _ hx⟩) :
    φ₁ = φ₂
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ adjoin_induction _ h (fun _ ↦ φ₂.commutes _ ▸ φ₁.commutes _)
    (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ ↦ by convert! congr_arg₂ (· + ·) h₁ h₂ <;> rw [← map_add] <;> rfl)
    (fun _ _ ↦ eq_on_inv₀ _ _)
    (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ ↦ by convert! congr_arg₂ (· * ·) h₁ h₂ <;> rw [← map_mul] <;> rfl)
    hx

name: algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin {S : IntermediateField F E} {s : Set E} (hS : S = adjoin F s)
    ⦃φ₁ φ₂ : S →ₐ[F] K⦄
    (h : ∀ x hx, φ₁ ⟨x, hS.ge (subset_adjoin _ _ hx)⟩ = φ₂ ⟨x, hS.ge (subset_adjoin _ _ hx)⟩) :
    φ₁ = φ₂
proof:
:= by
  subst hS; exact adjoin_algHom_ext F h

name: mem_adjoin_simple_self
statement: theorem mem_adjoin_simple_self : α ∈ F⟮α⟯
proof:

  subset_adjoin F {α} (Set.mem_singleton α)

theorem AdjoinSimple.coe_gen : (AdjoinSimple.gen F α : E) = α

name: AdjoinSimple.coe_aeval_gen_apply

theorem AdjoinSimple.coe_aeval_gen_apply (f : F[X]) :

name: adjoin_simple_adjoin_simple
statement: theorem adjoin_simple_adjoin_simple (β : E) : F⟮α⟯⟮β⟯.restrictScalars F = F⟮α, β⟯
proof:
:=
  adjoin_adjoin_left _ _ _

name: adjoin_simple_comm
statement: theorem adjoin_simple_comm (β : E) : F⟮α⟯⟮β⟯.restrictScalars F = F⟮β⟯⟮α⟯.restrictScalars F
proof:

name: adjoin_simple_le_iff
statement: theorem adjoin_simple_le_iff {K : IntermediateField F E} : F⟮α⟯ ≤ K ↔ α ∈ K
proof: := by simp

name: biSup_adjoin_simple
statement: theorem biSup_adjoin_simple : ⨆ x ∈ S, F⟮x⟯ = adjoin F S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_subtype'', ← gc.l_iSup, iSup_subtype'']; congr; exact S.biUnion_of_singleton

name: adjoin_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_eq_bot_iff : adjoin F S = ⊥ ↔ S ⊆ (⊥ : IntermediateField F E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff, adjoin_le_iff]

name: adjoin_simple_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem adjoin_simple_eq_bot_iff : F⟮α⟯ = ⊥ ↔ α ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField F E)
proof:

proof:

  adjoin_simple_eq_bot_iff.mpr (zero_mem ⊥)

name: adjoin_one

@[simp]

name: adjoin_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_intCast (n : ℤ) : F⟮(n : E)⟯ = ⊥
proof:

name: adjoin_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_natCast (n : ℕ) : F⟮(n : E)⟯ = ⊥

name: fg_adjoin_finset
statement: theorem fg_adjoin_finset (t : Finset E) : (adjoin F (↑t : Set E)).FG
proof:
:=
  ⟨t, rfl⟩

name: fg_def
statement: theorem fg_def {S : IntermediateField F E} : S.FG ↔ ∃ t : Set E, Set.Finite t ∧ adjoin F t = S
proof:
:=
  Iff.symm Set.exists_finite_iff_finset

name: fg_adjoin_of_finite
statement: theorem fg_adjoin_of_finite {t : Set E} (h : Set.Finite t) : (adjoin F t).FG
proof:
:=
  fg_def.mpr ⟨t, h, rfl⟩

name: fg_bot
statement: theorem fg_bot : (⊥ : IntermediateField F E).FG
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, by simp only [Finset.coe_empty, adjoin_empty]⟩

name: fg_sup
statement: theorem fg_sup {S T : IntermediateField F E} (hS : S.FG) (hT : T.FG) : (S ⊔ T).FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hS; obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hT
  classical rw [← adjoin_union, ← Finset.coe_union]
  exact fg_adjoin_finset _

name: fg_iSup
statement:
theorem fg_iSup {ι : Sort*} [Finite ι] {S : ι → IntermediateField F E} (h : ∀ i, (S i).FG) :
    (⨆ i, S i).FG
proof:
:= by
  choose s hs using h
  simp_rw [← hs, ← adjoin_iUnion]
  exact fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_iUnion fun _ ↦ Finset.finite_toSet _)

name: _root_.Field.fg_iff_fg_top_bot
statement:
theorem _root_.Field.fg_iff_fg_top_bot :
    Field.FG F ↔ (⊤ : IntermediateField (⊥ : Subfield F) F).FG
proof:
:= by
  simp [Field.fg_iff, fg_def, Set.exists_finite_iff_finset,
    ← toSubfield_inj, Subfield.algebraMap_ofSubfield, Subfield.closure_union]

name: induction_on_adjoin_finset
statement:
theorem induction_on_adjoin_finset (S : Finset E) (P : IntermediateField F E → Prop) (base : P ⊥)
    (ih : ∀ (K : IntermediateField F E), ∀ x ∈ S, P K → P (K⟮x⟯.restrictScalars F)) :
    P (adjoin F S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on' S ?_ (fun _ _ ha _ _ h => ?_)
  · simp [base]
  · rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.insert_eq, Set.union_comm, ← adjoin_adjoin_left]
    exact ih (adjoin F _) _ ha h

name: induction_on_adjoin_fg
statement:
theorem induction_on_adjoin_fg (P : IntermediateField F E → Prop) (base : P ⊥)
    (ih : ∀ (K : IntermediateField F E) (x : E), P K → P (K⟮x⟯.restrictScalars F))
    (K : IntermediateField F E) (hK : K.FG) : P K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := hK
  exact induction_on_adjoin_finset S P base fun K x _ hK => ih K x hK

name: map_comap_eq
statement:
theorem map_comap_eq (f : L →ₐ[K] L') (S : IntermediateField K L') :
    (S.comap f).map f = S ⊓ f.fieldRange
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range

name: map_comap_eq_self
statement:
theorem map_comap_eq_self {f : L →ₐ[K] L'} {S : IntermediateField K L'} (h : S ≤ f.fieldRange) :
    (S.comap f).map f = S
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [inf_of_le_left h] using map_comap_eq f S

name: map_comap_eq_self_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_comap_eq_self_of_surjective {f : L →ₐ[K] L'} (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (S : IntermediateField K L') : (S.comap f).map f = S
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective (Set.image_preimage_eq _ hf)

name: comap_map
statement: theorem comap_map (f : L →ₐ[K] L') (S : IntermediateField K L) : (S.map f).comap f = S
proof:
:=

name: extendScalars_self

name: algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin
statement: theorem algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin : Algebra.adjoin F S ≤ (adjoin F S).toSubalgebra
proof:
:=
  Algebra.adjoin_le (subset_adjoin _ _)

name: coe_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_algebraMap (x : Algebra.adjoin F S) :
    (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin F S) (adjoin F S) x : E) = x
proof: := rfl

name: algebraMap_eq_gen_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_eq_gen_self {x : E} :
    algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin F {x}) F⟮x⟯ ⟨x, Algebra.self_mem_adjoin_singleton F x⟩ =
    AdjoinSimple.gen F x
proof: := rfl

name: adjoin_eq_algebra_adjoin
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_algebra_adjoin (inv_mem : ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin F S, x⁻¹ ∈ Algebra.adjoin F S) :
    (adjoin F S).toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin F S
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (show adjoin F S ≤
        { Algebra.adjoin F S with
          inv_mem' := inv_mem }
      from adjoin_le_iff.mpr Algebra.subset_adjoin)
    (algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin _ _)

name: eq_adjoin_of_eq_algebra_adjoin
statement:
theorem eq_adjoin_of_eq_algebra_adjoin (K : IntermediateField F E)
    (h : K.toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin F S) : K = adjoin F S
proof:
:= by
  apply toSubalgebra_injective
  rw [h]
  refine (adjoin_eq_algebra_adjoin F _ fun x ↦ ?_).symm
  rw [← h]
  exact K.inv_mem

name: adjoin_eq_top_of_algebra
statement: theorem adjoin_eq_top_of_algebra (hS : Algebra.adjoin F S = ⊤) : adjoin F S = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_le_iff.mp (hS.symm.trans_le <| algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin F S)

name: fg_top_iff
statement:
lemma fg_top_iff :
    (⊤ : IntermediateField F E).FG ↔ Algebra.EssFiniteType F E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨s, hs⟩
    have : Algebra.FiniteType F (Algebra.adjoin F (s : Set E)) := .adjoin_of_finite s.finite_toSet
    have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (Algebra.adjoin F (s : Set E)) (adjoin F (s : Set E)) :=
      .of_isLocalization _ (nonZeroDivisors _)
    have : Algebra.EssFiniteType F (adjoin F (s : Set E)) :=
      .comp _ (Algebra.adjoin F (s : Set E)) _
    rw [hs] at this
    exact .of_surjective IntermediateField.topEquiv.toAlgHom IntermediateField.topEquiv.surjective
  · intro _
    use Algebra.EssFiniteType.finset F E
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (Algebra.EssFiniteType.submonoid F E) x
    have hs : s.1.1 ≠ 0 := (IsLocalization.map_units E s).ne_zero
    have H : IsLocalization.mk' E x s = x / s := by
      simp [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul, hs]
    rw [H]
    exact div_mem (IntermediateField.algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin _ _ x.2)
      (IntermediateField.algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin _ _ s.1.2)

name: fg_top
statement: lemma fg_top [Algebra.EssFiniteType F E] : (⊤ : IntermediateField F E).FG
proof:
:= by
  rwa [fg_top_iff]

name: essFiniteType_iff
statement:
lemma essFiniteType_iff {K : IntermediateField F E} :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType F K ↔ K.FG
proof:
:= by
  suffices (∃ s : Finset E, (s : Set E) ⊆ K ∧ adjoin F ↑s = K) ↔
      ∃ t : Finset E, adjoin F ↑t = K by
    simpa [IntermediateField.FG, (Equiv.finsetSubtypeComm _).exists_congr_left,
      ← (IntermediateField.map_injective K.val).eq_iff, ← IntermediateField.fg_top_iff,
      adjoin_map, ← Set.range_comp, Function.comp_def, ← AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_map] using! this
  exact ⟨fun ⟨s, _, hs⟩ ↦ ⟨s, hs⟩, fun ⟨s, hs⟩ ↦ ⟨s, hs ▸ subset_adjoin _ _, hs⟩⟩

name: _root_.Field.fg_iff_essFiniteType
statement: theorem _root_.Field.fg_iff_essFiniteType : Field.FG F ↔ Algebra.EssFiniteType (⊥ : Subfield F) F
proof:
:=
  Field.fg_iff_fg_top_bot.trans fg_top_iff

name: AdjoinSimple.isIntegral_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AdjoinSimple.isIntegral_gen : IsIntegral F (AdjoinSimple.gen F α) ↔ IsIntegral F α
proof:
:= by

  rw [isIntegral_algebraMap_iff]

name: adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic {S : Set E} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, IsAlgebraic F x) :
    (adjoin F S).toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin F S
proof:
:=
  adjoin_eq_algebra_adjoin _ _ fun _ ↦
    (Algebra.IsIntegral.adjoin fun x hx ↦ (hS x hx).isIntegral).inv_mem

name: adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic (hα : IsAlgebraic F α) :
    F⟮α⟯.toSubalgebra = F[α]
proof:
:=
  adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic <| by simpa

name: adjoin_toSubalgebra
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_toSubalgebra [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (S : Set E) :
    (adjoin F S).toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin F S
proof:
:=
  adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x

name: adjoin_eq_top_iff_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_top_iff_of_isAlgebraic {S : Set E} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, IsAlgebraic F x) :
    adjoin F S = ⊤ ↔ Algebra.adjoin F S = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic hS,
      ← IntermediateField.toSubalgebra_inj,
      IntermediateField.top_toSubalgebra]

name: adjoin_simple_eq_top_iff_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_simple_eq_top_iff_of_isAlgebraic {x : E} (hx : IsAlgebraic F x) :
    F⟮x⟯ = ⊤ ↔ F[x] = ⊤
proof: := adjoin_eq_top_iff_of_isAlgebraic (by simp [hx])

name: adjoin_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoin_eq_top_iff [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] {S : Set E} :
    adjoin F S = ⊤ ↔ Algebra.adjoin F S = ⊤
proof:
:=
  adjoin_eq_top_iff_of_isAlgebraic (fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x)

name: _root_.Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
lemma _root_.Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType F E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    Module.Finite F E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := fg_top F E
  have : Algebra.FiniteType F E := by
    use s
    rw [← adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic fun x hx ↦ Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x]
    simpa [← toSubalgebra_inj] using hs
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.finite

name: le_sup_toSubalgebra
statement: theorem le_sup_toSubalgebra : E1.toSubalgebra ⊔ E2.toSubalgebra ≤ (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra
proof:
:=
  sup_le (show E1 ≤ E1 ⊔ E2 from le_sup_left) (show E2 ≤ E1 ⊔ E2 from le_sup_right)

name: sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right
statement:
theorem sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E2] :
    (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra = E1.toSubalgebra ⊔ E2.toSubalgebra
proof:
:= by
  have : (adjoin E1 (E2 : Set L)).toSubalgebra = _ := adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic fun x h ↦
    IsAlgebraic.tower_top _ (isAlgebraic_iff.mp (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (⟨x, h⟩ : E2)))
  apply_fun Subalgebra.restrictScalars K at this
  rw [← restrictScalars_toSubalgebra, restrictScalars_adjoin] at this
  
  
  simp only [← coe_type_toSubalgebra] at this
  rw [Algebra.restrictScalars_adjoin] at this
  exact this

name: sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_left
statement:
theorem sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_left [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E1] :
    (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra = E1.toSubalgebra ⊔ E2.toSubalgebra
proof:
:= by
  have := sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right E2 E1
  rwa [sup_comm (a := E1), sup_comm (a := E1.toSubalgebra)]

name: sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E1 ∨ Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E2) :
    (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra = E1.toSubalgebra ⊔ E2.toSubalgebra
proof:
:=
  halg.elim (fun _ ↦ sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_left E1 E2)
    (fun _ ↦ sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right E1 E2)

name: sup_toSubalgebra_of_left
statement:
theorem sup_toSubalgebra_of_left [FiniteDimensional K E1] :
    (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra = E1.toSubalgebra ⊔ E2.toSubalgebra
proof:
:=
  sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_left E1 E2

name: sup_toSubalgebra_of_right
statement:
theorem sup_toSubalgebra_of_right [FiniteDimensional K E2] :
    (E1 ⊔ E2).toSubalgebra = E1.toSubalgebra ⊔ E2.toSubalgebra
proof:
:=
  sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right E1 E2

name: adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic (L : IntermediateField F K)
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E ∨ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L) :
    (adjoin E (L : Set K)).toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin E (L : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  let i := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E K
  let E' := i.fieldRange
  let i' : E ≃ₐ[F] E' := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField i
  have hi : algebraMap E K = (algebraMap E' K) ∘ i' := by ext x; rfl
  apply_fun _ using Subalgebra.restrictScalars_injective F
  rw [← restrictScalars_toSubalgebra, restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv i' hi,
    Algebra.restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv i' hi, restrictScalars_adjoin]
  dsimp only [← E'.coe_type_toSubalgebra]
  rw [Algebra.restrictScalars_adjoin F E'.toSubalgebra]
  exact E'.sup_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic L (halg.imp
    (fun (_ : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E) ↦ i'.isAlgebraic) id)

name: adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_left
statement:
theorem adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_left (L : IntermediateField F K)
    [halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] :
    (adjoin E (L : Set K)).toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin E (L : Set K)
proof:
:=
  adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic E L (Or.inl halg)

name: adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right
statement:
theorem adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic_right (L : IntermediateField F K)
    [halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L] :
    (adjoin E (L : Set K)).toSubalgebra = Algebra.adjoin E (L : Set K)
proof:
:=
  adjoin_intermediateField_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic E L (Or.inr halg)

name: fg_of_fg_toSubalgebra
statement: theorem fg_of_fg_toSubalgebra (S : IntermediateField F E) (h : S.toSubalgebra.FG) : S.FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
  exact ⟨t, (eq_adjoin_of_eq_algebra_adjoin _ _ _ ht.symm).symm⟩

name: fg_of_noetherian
statement: theorem fg_of_noetherian (S : IntermediateField F E) [IsNoetherian F E] : S.FG
proof:
:=
  S.fg_of_fg_toSubalgebra S.toSubalgebra.fg_of_noetherian

name: induction_on_adjoin
statement:
theorem induction_on_adjoin [FiniteDimensional F E] (P : IntermediateField F E → Prop)
    (base : P ⊥) (ih : ∀ (K : IntermediateField F E) (x : E), P K → P (K⟮x⟯.restrictScalars F))
    (K : IntermediateField F E) : P K
proof:
:=
  letI : IsNoetherian F E := IsNoetherian.iff_fg.2 inferInstance
  induction_on_adjoin_fg P base ih K K.fg_of_noetherian

name: algHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem algHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq (h : RingHom.comp f (algebraMap A K) = (g : A →+* L)) :
    f.fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin F g.range
proof:
:= by
  apply IntermediateField.toSubfield_injective
  simp_rw [AlgHom.fieldRange_toSubfield, IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
  convert! ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq h using 2
  exact Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_left fun _ ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨algebraMap F A x, by simp [← hx]⟩

name: algHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem algHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq_of_range_eq
    (h : RingHom.comp f (algebraMap A K) = (g : A →+* L))
    {s : Set L} (hs : g.range = Algebra.adjoin F s) :
    f.fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin F s
proof:
:= by
  apply IntermediateField.toSubfield_injective
  simp_rw [AlgHom.fieldRange_toSubfield, IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
  refine ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq_of_range_eq h ?_
  rw [← Algebra.adjoin_eq_ring_closure, ← hs]; rfl

name: liftAlgHom_fieldRange
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_fieldRange (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    (liftAlgHom hg : K →ₐ[F] L).fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin F g.range
proof:
:=
  algHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq (by ext; simp)

name: liftAlgHom_fieldRange_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem liftAlgHom_fieldRange_eq_of_range_eq (hg : Function.Injective g)
    {s : Set L} (hs : g.range = Algebra.adjoin F s) :
    (liftAlgHom hg : K →ₐ[F] L).fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin F s
proof:
:=
  algHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq_of_range_eq (by ext; simp) hs
